jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social - Canada
jobs.excerpt: At Jobscan, we’re passionate about empowering job seekers to land more interviews with AI.
jobs.description:
At Jobscan, we’re passionate about empowering job seekers to land more interviews with AI. We have helped millions of job seekers get more interviews in 100+ countries. Jobscan’s platform benefits job seekers, employers, universities, and communities. We're a fast-growing startup 🚀. Since its founding in 2014, Jobscan has thrived for 11 years as a 100% self-funded company, achieving consistent profitability and rapid growth without VC investment. Recently, we’ve transformed into an AI-first company, leveraging cutting-edge tools to enhance operations and our product. This independence allows us to stay laser-focused on our customers, delivering impactful solutions for job seekers. Join us if you wish to be a part of a company that makes a real difference in people’s lives ❤️!

Summary

Join Jobscan as our Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social, and build our next major acquisition channel. Search has powered our growth for years. Now we’re investing in social, and you’ll be the person who makes it work.

This is a hands-on ownership role for a performance marketer who loves being in the ad account every day, not a passive management seat. You will own paid social end to end, starting with Meta: strategy, budget, creative testing, measurement and scale, judged on what matters, which is new paying subscribers at a healthy cost. You will also own our organic social presence: posting, community, and responding to the job seekers who talk about us. Partnering directly with the Head of Marketing, you will turn social from a channel we’ve tested into one we rely on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own paid social end to end, starting with Meta (Facebook and Instagram): strategy, account structure, audiences, bidding, budget pacing and daily optimization, then test and expand into TikTok, Reddit, YouTube and LinkedIn where the numbers support it.
  • Build and run a creative testing engine: concepts, hooks, scripts, UGC and short-form video, tested at a steady weekly cadence, with winners scaled and fatigue managed.
  • Own measurement: tie spend to registrations, trials and paid subscriptions using first-party data, set up and maintain the Meta Pixel and Conversions API with engineering, and run incrementality tests so we know what social truly adds.
  • Scale with discipline: grow budget as results prove out against our cost-per-subscriber and payback targets, and cut what doesn’t work quickly.
  • Own organic social across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube: content strategy, a consistent publishing rhythm, and a voice that sounds human and useful to job seekers.
  • Run community management: respond to comments, messages and reviews, and turn customer stories and feedback into content.
  • Bring our launches and seasonal moments to social, including new product features, our January job search peak, and promotions like Black Friday, in coordination with email and paid search.
  • Build retargeting and audience strategy across paid social, and coordinate with our email program so social and lifecycle work together.
  • Use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily to multiply creative output, speed up analysis and keep a high quality bar.
  • Report weekly on performance and learnings, and partner with the Head of Marketing on budget, channel mix and priorities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4 to 7 years of growth or performance marketing experience, with 3+ years hands-on in paid social (Meta Ads Manager)
  • Direct ownership of paid social budgets of $10K+ a month, inside the account, not only through an agency
  • A track record of optimizing to downstream conversions (purchases, subscriptions, CAC, ROAS) at a B2C product, ideally subscription, app or free-trial
  • Creative strategy skills: you can explain how you find winning ads, with real examples of hooks, UGC and short-form video that worked
  • Measurement fluency: Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, GA4, attribution windows, and a healthy skepticism of platform-reported results
  • Organic social experience: you have grown an account and managed a community
  • Strong writing: ad copy, hooks and posts that sound human and on brand
  • Strong AI/LLM fluency: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools in your daily workflow, with a clear quality check before anything goes live
  • Self-directed and high-judgment: you can take a budget and a target and run with it without daily oversight
  • Comfortable with data: you build your own reports and draw clear conclusions from them
  • Based in the Canada, with working hours that consistently overlap US Eastern time (EST, CT, or PT)

What will make you stand out!

  • Experience in career, HR or job-search related products
  • TikTok, Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn ads experience
  • Creator and UGC partnership management
  • Video editing (CapCut, Premiere) and light design skills (Figma, Canva)
  • Incrementality or geo-lift testing experience
  • SQL or BigQuery skills
  • HubSpot experience

Benefits

- Remote work - we trust you to get your work done and make it to your meetings👩‍💼👨‍💼
- Competitive salary + stock options - you should have a piece of what we're building here🏗️
- Flexible schedule - we make it easy to take care of the important things, like your family and health👪👩‍⚕️
- Unlimited PTO + Canadian Holidays + Paid Sick Days - we want our employees to have time to care for their personal wellness and mental health💆‍♀️💆
- Wellness stipend - use for yoga class, gym membership, or anything that improves your personal wellness🧘‍♀️
- $1000 home office stipend, education stipend, internet stipend
- Apple computer provided
- Bi-annual company retreats

jobs.description:
Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design.

You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Your systems have to handle spikes without losing a single event, scale without anyone stepping in, and stay cheap enough to run at volume.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are hiring someone who has run streaming pipelines in production, has been paged when they broke, and has made them better every time.

Job Description:

  • Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand.
  • Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream.
  • Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost.
  • Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics.
  • Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down.
  • Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • Senior backend engineer: 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years writing production Go. You understand goroutines, channels, and the concurrency patterns that hold up under load.
  • Streaming in production: You have built and operated streaming data pipelines with AWS Kinesis, or a comparable system such as Kafka, at meaningful scale. You understand ordering, partitioning, exactly-once and at-least-once delivery, and replay.
  • AWS IoT or device data: You have worked with AWS IoT Core or another device-telemetry ingestion platform, including MQTT, device authentication, and high-fan-in workloads.
  • Data warehouse experience: You have designed and optimized Amazon Redshift, or a similar warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery, for production analytics. You write strong SQL and know how to make slow queries fast.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: You are strong on AWS (Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and comfortable with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CDK, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain an architecture trade-off to a US product team in plain English and write design documents people actually read.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. About the Role:

Lyra is at the forefront of increasing access to evidence-based, efficacious mental health services on a large scale. Lyra has developed innovative blended models of coaching and psychotherapy that combine leading clinical expertise with routine outcomes monitoring and engaging clinical digital tools. Scientific publications on Lyra’s mental health coaching (Coaching Effectiveness), (Coaching Outcomes), psychotherapy [(Blended Care effectiveness), (Examining Blended Care impact)], (medication management), and overall workforce mental health programs [(Presenteeism impact), (Impact of psychotherapy)] provide strong evidence for the clinical effectiveness of these evidence-based treatment programs.

  • Receiving and incorporating significant feedback on your proposals and writing

  • Conducting trainings to help disseminate the use of digital clinical materials

  • Excellent writer with demonstrated writing experience, passionate about writing on clinical topics

  • 3+ years of postdoctoral clinical experience in providing evidence-based treatments for child mental health disorders

  • Experience with creating clinical materials for and training providers to deliver child mental health interventions is a plus

AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below:

Responsibilities:

  • Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design: Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Cooling System Selection: Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment.
  • Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis: Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project.
  • Redundancy and Fault Tolerance: Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems.
  • Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning: Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility.
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Implementing energy-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives.
  • Air Quality and Filtration: Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optimal levels by designing appropriate filtration systems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment.
  • Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree with 6+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education.
  • Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation.
  • P. E. registration is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management.
  • Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002
  • Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous.
  • Relocation is not available for this position
  • Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this role now or in the future.

jobs.title: PPC Marketing Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.

This member-facing role will serve as a primary point of contact for NPC members and will engage leaders and stakeholders across provider organizations, including supply chain, finance, clinical operations, value analysis, physician departments and other functional areas, to advance implementation, adoption, and value realization. Location: UK, central Europe, and Latin America

In this role, the designer will play a key part in designing and evolving the platform’s primary dashboard—where brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies explore trends, generate reports, and interact with LLM-powered features.

As the platform rebuilds around LLM-driven capabilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for defining not just how features look, but how complex data and AI experiences should function. The primary focus is transforming dense, aggregated trend data into clear, intuitive, and actionable insights.

This position joins a close-knit Frontend & UX team reporting directly to the Frontend Lead. The role is 100% remote and open to candidates based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). Candidates must be available during core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (2:00 PM–5:00 PM UK / 3:00 PM–6:00 PM CET).

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Design: Own features from initial framing to final launch, partnering closely with engineering leadership to deliver written proposals, user flows, prototypes, and Figma specifications.
  • Problem Identification & Solution Design: Independently identify user pain points through customer calls, interviews, user feedback, and usage data to build compelling product proposals.
  • AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content.
  • Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns.
  • UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead.

Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations.

Requirements

  • Qualifications
    • Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform.
    • Product Thinking: Strong strategic perspective with a proven ability to define what to build and why, backed by a portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing abilities.
    • Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools.
    • Design Systems: Proven track record of working within and contributing to scalable design component libraries.
    • Tools & AI Integration: High proficiency in Figma, with active integration of AI tools into day-to-day design workflows and a strong curiosity regarding LLM product experiences.
    • Communication: Excellent written English skills, capable of producing clear proposals and documentation in an asynchronous remote environment.
    • Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST).
  • Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
    • Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team.
    • Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams.
    • Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality.
    • Expertise in advanced data visualization patterns.
    • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food & beverage, or marketing intelligence platforms.
    • Capability to build rapid functional prototypes using AI-assisted tools to evaluate live outputs.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to experience.
  • Collaborative, high-impact environment with direct influence on core product direction.
  • Opportunity to work closely alongside senior design leadership.
  • Flexible starting timeline (target start date in January, with early onboarding available).

﻿

Interview Process

  1. Initial Video Screening: A brief introductory video conversation to discuss background, expectations, and role fit.
  2. Personality Assessment: An online assessment to evaluate working style and team dynamics.
  3. Design Leadership Interview: A 30-minute introductory chat with the Lead Designer.
  4. Screen-Recorded Case Study: A flexible, practical exercise (details currently being finalized) to demonstrate hands-on design methodology and execution.
  5. Final Interview: A concluding conversation with key stakeholders to review results and align on next steps.

Technical Sales Manager – Europe

Electrical Calibration and Software Solutions

Location: remote / in Europe
Reports to: Sales Director – EMEA

Company Overview:

Fluke Calibration (FCAL), a division of Fluke Corporation within the Fortive Group, is a global leader in calibration instruments, equipment, software, and services. Our products provide unmatched precision, reliability, and innovation, ensuring the highest standards of measurement accuracy. Fluke Calibration serves industries that demand excellence in calibration, including industrial manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace & defense, chemical, healthcare, and more.

Fluke Calibration Solutions focuses on electrical calibration, pressure calibration, temperature calibration, software and service solutions such as Fluke Premium Care.

As part of the Fortive family, we promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, empowering our teams to drive results and deliver impactful solutions to our customers worldwide.

Position Summary:

We are looking for an Applications & Key Account Manager to drive the growth of our electrical calibration, RF measurement, calibration services, and precision test & measurement solutions across Europe.

In this role you will combine technical application & metrology expertise with key account development, working closely with our European distributors and sales team to support strategic customers and expand our market presence, especially for electrical calibration and software solutions.

This position is ideal for a technical expert who enjoys working with advanced measurement technologies, supporting distributors, and building long-term customer relationships in high-precision technical environments. The role bridges technical expertise and sales leadership skills

You will engage with leading organizations in e.g. national metrology institutes, calibration laboratories, semiconductors, aerospace & defense, chemical and pharmaceutical industries, helping them implement high-accuracy measurement calibration solutions.

The Technical Sales Manager is also acting as a key link between the European market and the Fluke Calibration Business Unit, providing insights into market trends, customer needs, and product lifecycle management (PLCM). New product introductions are a vital part of this role.

.

Key Responsibilities:

Applications & Technical Expertise

  • Provide application and product support for electrical calibration, RF measurement technology, metrology, (cloud-based) software solutions and precision instrumentation.
  • Responsible for new product introduction (NPI) in the EMEA market, both from technical as commercial perspective.
  • Support customers and distributors with:
    • solution selection
    • measurement and calibration applications
    • system demonstrations and workshops
    • migration, installation, training of Fluke software solution, including cloud based.
  • Assist in the development of applications, demonstrations, and technical documentation.
  • Development of applications, best practices, and technical documentation.

Market Development

  • Identify and develop opportunities in key industries including:

    semiconductor industry

    aerospace & defense

    national metrology institutes
    calibration laboratories

  • Contribute to European market growth strategies together with the sales organization and distributor network.
  • Collect and communicate market feedback, customer requirements, and competitive insights into the Fluke Calibration Business Unit.
  • Identify emerging technology trends, application developments, and industry standards.
  • Contribute to product strategy and product lifecycle management (PLCM) discussions.
  • Provide information about market development, forecasting and proforma numbers for new products.
  • Contribute to product strategy and product lifecycle management (PLCM) and roadmap definitions.

New Product Introduction (NPI) Growth:

  • Drive the successful introduction and adoption of Fluke’s New Product Introductions (NPIs) in the market, promoting their value and differentiation.
  • Collaborate with the product management and marketing teams to effectively position NPIs in the market, ensuring alignment with customer needs and market trends.
  • Educate customers on new products, provide technical expertise and conduct demonstrations to showcase the features and benefits.
  • Work closely with the Sales Director and internal teams, including product management, marketing, and customer support, to align sales strategies and product positioning.
  • Monitor NPI performance, key sales metrics, funnel growth and market feedback, reporting insights and opportunities back to the product team for continuous improvement.

Account Development

  • Drive revenue growth and market expansion for Electrical Calibration, RF Calibration, and Calibration Software Solutions across Europe.
  • Develop and support key accounts across Europe in collaboration with our sales team and distributor network.
  • Work jointly with distributors to identify new opportunities and expand existing customer relationships.
  • Support key customer engagements involving precision measurement systems, electrical calibration, RF technology, calibration software and services, and metrology solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with technical decision makers, laboratory managers, and R&D, engineering & production teams. Aligning regional needs and contributing to the global product strategy.

Distributor & Channel Support

  • Act as a technical and commercial partner to European distributors
  • Support distributors during customer visits, demonstrations, and technical discussions.
  • Provide training and technical enablement on applications, products, calibration services, and metrology solutions.
  • Assist distributors in converting technical opportunities into successful commercial projects.
  • Lead technical presentations, training and demonstrations, and application discussions with high-level technical stakeholders.
  • Help accelerate complex deals, tenders, that require advanced application knowledge.

Qualifications:

Experience & Skills

  • More than 10 years of technical experience within a role in metrology or as product engineer, application management, product manager or technical sales manager in test & measurement market preferably in metrology, semiconductor or defense & aerospace.
  • The ideal candidate has a degree and strong background in electronics and metrology, and worked in a calibration laboratory.
  • Experience or knowledge of electrical calibration, multifunction calibration, RF calibration, or precision measurement systems.
  • Proven success in managing complex sales cycles, including product introduction.
  • Excellent in communication and presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Feels confident to present to customers.

Competencies

  • Sales-Driven: Results-oriented with a focus on meeting and exceeding sales and revenue targets.
  • Customer-Focused: Deep understanding of customer needs, with a passion for delivering value through tailored solutions.
  • Technical Expertise: Ability to effectively position Fluke’s technical solutions to address customer challenges.
  • Prospecting & NPI Leadership: Strong track record of identifying new business opportunities and driving the adoption of new products in the market.
  • Collaboration: Works well with cross-functional teams and partners to align sales strategies and deliver customer value.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced sales environment, quickly adapting to changes in the market or customer needs.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke

Fluke is leading the world in creating software, test tools and technology that will support customers today and in the future. We are a customer-obsessed market leader with a strong reputation for reliability, quality and safety.A wholly owned subsidiary of Fortive Corporation (www.fortive.com), Fluke is a global corporation headquartered in the greater Seattle area. Driven by the successful Fortive Business System, Fluke offers the passion of a startup with the resources of a Fortune 500 company. We are focused on the growth of our individual employees, teams and the Fluke brand.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Platform Engineer will work as part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, building, administrating, optimizing, configuring, maintaining, and governing the organization's Databricks Lakehouse Platform, enabling scalable data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities in support of the CMM Data Modernization & Governance program.

The Data Platform Engineer will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Design, configure, and maintain the enterprise Databricks Lakehouse Platform, including workspaces, Unity Catalog, and scalable data architectures.
  • Administer and optimize Databricks compute, clusters, SQL warehouses, serverless capabilities, and workload management for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop and optimize data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and ingestion frameworks using Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows.
  • Create, maintain, and govern Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, tables, roles/groups, and RBAC/access-control lists, aligned with AO security, IAM, and compliance policies.
  • Implement and manage Unity Catalog, RBAC, and data governance controls.
  • Automate platform provisioning, configuration, and deployments using Terraform, Python, SQL, Databricks Asset Bundles, and Databricks APIs.
  • Implement platform monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
  • Perform Spark and SQL performance tuning, scalability testing, and troubleshooting of platform, pipeline, and data-processing issues.
  • Implement cost optimization strategies, including autoscaling, auto-termination, right-sizing, workload isolation, and contribute to DBU consumption forecasting, financial reporting, and TCO analysis.
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, versioning, release management, and adoption of new Databricks capabilities.
  • Integrate Databricks with enterprise data sources, governance tools, BI platforms, and AI/ML environments.
  • Implement security, encryption, networking, auditing, compliance, and high-availability/disaster-recovery controls.
  • Support security audits, ATO activities, incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational reporting.
  • Establish platform standards, reusable engineering patterns, reference architectures, runbooks, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with architecture, security, governance, and data engineering teams and provide technical guidance and mentorship to platform users.
  • Maintain cloud monitoring dashboards, capacity planning, and KPI metrics; evaluate new Databricks features and recommend adoption to improve performance, cost, or operability.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data engineers and platform users.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree with 12+ years of general experience in information systems and 10+ years of specialized experience.
  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree as follows: HS (18+ years), AA/AS (16+ years), BA/BS (14+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (11+ years).
  • Strong, hands-on experience implementing and administering the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, including Unity Catalog, cluster and SQL warehouse management, and job/workflow orchestration.
  • Experience in performance engineering, scalability testing, and tuning of Databricks data platform.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, Spark performance tuning, and workload management.
  • Skilled with performance/observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Elastic).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, testing, and platform scripting; strong SQL skills.
  • Experience operating Databricks in AWS-based or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices patterns.
  • Experience with telemetry, logging standards, traceability, and root-cause analysis.
  • Ability to analyze large performance datasets to identify trends, issues, and optimization opportunities.
  • Experience with version control, build/release processes, and IaC automation.
  • Knowledge of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, lake/ware-house architectures, and distributed data processing.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, access control, networking, and resource governance within Databricks and Unity Catalog.
  • Familiarity with federal security, compliance, and audit processes (ATO, FedRAMP).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to optimize workload performance.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)

  • Databricks Certified Associate Platform Administrator
  • Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
  • Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a System Administrator Specialist to support the National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) under the Business Process and Information Management Branch (BPIMB) ServiceNow Support Services (SNSS) program.

In this role, you will perform daily system configuration and operational activities that support NIAID's ServiceNow environment and related platforms. You will optimize system performance, monitor resource utilization, assist users in accessing and using business systems, and support the stability, security, and efficiency of technical operations across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, SecOps, VR, and integrated systems.

This position requires hands-on operational support skills, familiarity with enterprise platforms, and experience delivering reliable system administration services in a large, complex environment.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Perform daily configuration and operational tasks for the ServiceNow platform and supporting systems.

  • Monitor and optimize system performance, including resource utilization, data throughput, and platform stability.

  • Conduct system capacity analysis and assist with long-term planning to ensure platform scalability.

  • Maintain and administer user accounts, roles, permissions, and access controls in accordance with NIH and NIAID security standards.

  • Support configuration updates, scheduled maintenance, patch application, troubleshooting, and routine system health checks.

  • Assist users in accessing and using business systems, providing Tier 2 support for ServiceNow and related tools.

  • Monitor integrations, jobs, and transactions for reliability and timely execution.

  • Coordinate with developers, architects, and business analysts to support deployments and validate operational readiness for releases.

  • Maintain documentation for system procedures, configurations, operational tasks, change records, and runbooks.

  • Perform log reviews, error analysis, and basic root cause analysis for operational incidents.

  • Support backup, restore, and disaster recovery testing as part of continuity-of-operations requirements.

  • Participate in formal and informal review checkpoints throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain NIH Public Trust.

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience).

  • 3 or more years of experience performing system administration in a large computer-based environment.

  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting ServiceNow, including configuration, operational maintenance, user management, workflows, or integrations.

  • Basic scripting skills, including JavaScript or equivalent scripting ability used within ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms.

  • Experience performing daily system operations, configuration updates, maintenance, patching, and monitoring.

  • Familiarity with ITSM or IT operations workflows.

  • Experience assisting users with system access, navigation, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience documenting procedures and following structured change management practices.

  • Ability to analyze system performance, resource utilization, and capacity trends.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, communication skills, and customer support competency.

Desired Skills:

  • ServiceNow certification such as CSA or related module-specific certification.

  • Experience supporting ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, or Integration Hub.

  • Experience configuring and supporting MID Servers.

  • Experience with REST or SOAP API interactions.

  • Familiarity with log analysis tools or platform monitoring dashboards.

  • Experience supporting compliance-driven federal environments.

  • Experience creating runbooks, SOPs, and operational checklists.

Manager, Sales Effectiveness
Department: Sales & Marketing
Reports To: EVP, Sales & Marketing
Location: Remote

POSITION SUMMARY
As the Manager of Sales Effectiveness, you are the engine that drives our street-level execution. In our lean, high-growth FTTH environment, we don't need a corporate presenter who just points at PowerPoint slides; we need a gritty, hands-on trainer and operational executor who gets in the trenches. You will be the trusted advisor to our sales force, wearing two critical hats: running the daily enablement lifecycle, from onboarding fresh Door-to-Door (D2D) and Inside Sales reps to coach them to their first sale, and executing strategic sales campaigns, SPIFFs, and market-rollout plays. Armed with field data from platforms like Spotio and Terros, you will identify exactly where our reps are struggling on the doors or phones, fix their pitches in real-time, and drive penetration in every neighborhood we light up.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales Enablement & Field Training
  • Execute the Onboarding Lifecycle: Run and refine our 30-60-90 day onboarding program for D2D and Inside Sales representatives. The #1 metric is decreasing time-to-first-sale through relentless roleplay, FTTH product education, and objection-handling drills.
  • Drive Tech Stack Mastery: Ensure 100% adoption of our field sales tool (Terros). Train reps to accurately log dispositions, drop pins, manage their daily turf, and prevent "pencil-whipping" so ops receives clean, actionable data.
  • Support Frontline Supervisors: Act as the ultimate wingman to our Sales Supervisors. Help them run structured 1:1s, conduct highly productive field ride-alongs, and show them how to coach reps out of slumps instead of just closing deals for them.
  • Continuous Education & Competitive Intel: Deliver ongoing, punchy training sessions on competitive intelligence. Teach our reps how to perform "bill teardowns" on the doorstep to counter legacy cable (exploding promos, upload bottlenecks) and DSL (copper unreliability).
Sales Programs & Campaign Execution
  • Implement SPIFFs and Contests: Execute data-driven SPIFFs that align with immediate company goals—whether that’s driving the highest take-rate in a newly lit fiber hood, reviving "dark doors," or pushing multi-gig tier adoption.
  • Support the Inside Sales Motion: Work directly with the Inside Sales team to refine call scripts, speed-to-lead cadences, and objection handling for inbound calls and warm leads.
  • Execute MDU Penetration Plays: Roll out specialized D2D tactics to accelerate sales and drive high-density subscriber growth in Multi-Dwelling Units with secured Right of Entry (ROE) agreements.
  • Drive the Re-connect Program: Train the team to execute targeted win-back campaigns, utilizing inside sales dialing and D2D door drops to recover non-pay disconnects and seasonal churners.
  • Deploy Demographic-Specific Initiatives: Train the field on our Home Tech Program, empowering reps to capture older demographics by leading with intuitive streaming education, cord-cutting confidence, and whole-home Wi-Fi solutions.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • 3-5 years of experience in B2C telecom, ISP, or FTTH sales, with a deep, practical understanding of direct sales motions (Door-to-Door and Inside Sales). You must have knocked doors or dialed leads in this industry.
  • Operational Fluency - High proficiency in D2D canvassing and territory management software (Spotio, Terros, SalesRabbit, etc.) and modern CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho). You must know how to read a turf map and spot where reps are skipping houses.
  • Proven Trainer - Track record of delivering sales playbooks, running energetic training classes, and coaching reps one-on-one in a fast-paced environment.
  • Influence Without Authority - Exceptional ability to hold reps and supervisors accountable to coaching metrics and operational standards without being their direct boss.
  • Data-Driven Mindset - Ability to translate raw door-knock data, contact rates, and conversion metrics into immediate, actionable coaching moments.
JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Moderate Travel – 25%: Ability to travel regularly for activities such as out-of-town meetings, trainings, projects, client meetings, or outreach activities up to 25% of the time.

The Opportunity:

About the Role

As Principal Architect for AI Security, you will define and lead the security architecture strategy for our AI platform, products, and infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to shape how a fast-moving organization thinks about security at the intersection of machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and product delivery. You will operate as a technical authority — influencing roadmap, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering with leadership to ensure our AI systems are trustworthy, resilient, and defensible.

What You'll Do

Architecture & Strategy

  • Define the end-to-end security architecture for AI/ML systems, including training pipelines, inference infrastructure, model storage, and APIs.

  • Develop and maintain a threat model for AI-specific attack surfaces: model poisoning, adversarial inputs, prompt injection, model inversion, and supply chain risks.

  • Lead design reviews for high-impact systems, setting standards for secure-by-default AI development.

  • Own the AI security roadmap, aligning it with product goals, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as an authority on AI security decisions across engineering, product, and research teams.

  • Partner with ML engineers to embed security controls throughout the model lifecycle — from data ingestion to deployment and monitoring.

  • Drive adoption of zero-trust principles, least-privilege access, and defense-in-depth across AI infrastructure.

Governance & Compliance

  • Translate evolving AI-specific regulations (NIST AI RMF) into actionable architectural requirements.

  • Partner with legal, privacy, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet internal policies and external obligations.

  • Produce executive-ready security assessments, risk summaries, and mitigation plans.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a bridge between security, platform engineering, data science, and product management.

  • Represent the organization in external forums, customer security reviews, and industry working groups.

  • Contribute to open-source tooling, publications, or speaking engagements to build the organization's credibility in AI security.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in information security, with at least 5 years focused on cloud or platform architecture.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in securing ML/AI systems, including LLMs, training pipelines, and model serving infrastructure.

  • Demonstrated experience with AI-specific threat vectors: adversarial ML, data poisoning, model extraction, and prompt injection.

  • Proficiency in cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and audit logging.

  • Strong background in application security, cryptography, and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC).

  • Experience leading architectural decisions in a large-scale engineering organization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex security risks to both engineers and executives.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks: NIST AI RMF

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or cloud security specializations.

  • Published research, conference talks, or open-source contributions in AI/ML security.

  • This position pays between $148,800 - 223,200 based on experience and geographical location.

  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

jobs.excerpt: What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you?  When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected.
jobs.description:
What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the world’s leading research and advisory company, achieving consistent double-digit growth by steering clients toward the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else.

When you join Gartner for Chief Sales Officers (CSO), you’ll set your career on track for outstanding achievement with a company that knows no limits. Gartner Executive CSO Partners serve as trusted advisors to our members (clients) who are CSOs or SVPs of Sales from Global 1000 organizations and government agencies. In this role, you’ll be further expanding your knowledge of cutting edge research and trends in the sales function along with your own experience base and personal network.

Our Associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional career development as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team and remarkable clients, Gartner is where you want to be.

About this role:

The Executive Partner’s(EP) role is to serve as a trusted advisor to our senior-most Sales executive clients (Chief Sales/Growth/Revenue/Commercial Officers) and deliver exceptional value by orchestrating the full capability of Gartner (research, analysts, events and peer networking) to help each member-client, define and exceed their specific enterprise goals.

Executive partners work with clients to define develop, prioritize and/or critique sales strategies (including go-to-market) and tactics; develop and/or transform overall skills and capability within the sales organization; assist with the development and execution of functional elements like channel design, compensation architecture, etc; aggregate and deliver Gartner research insights on key initiatives, priorities, and implementations; and in general, becoming a trusted advisor for the SVP, EVP or CSO. The Executive Partner (EP) also partners with the client to develop and execute a workplan and timeline to deliver the client’s most critical initiatives. With the support of their EP, our clients are able to achieve their top and bottom line targets more quickly, cost effectively and with a higher assurance of success.

What you’ll do:

Relationship Management

  • The EP manages 20 to 30 senior executive member relationships and participates in account planning with Senior Client Managers and Senior Account Executives. These three individuals collectively and individually have responsibility for each assigned account.
  • The EP actively participates in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.
  • The EP performs annual workshops for client member and leads CSO/SVP, Sales breakout sessions during annual Sales Forums.

Success is defined by:

  • Executing a smooth hand-off from the sales team
  • Regularly engaging the member in a substantive manner
  • Creating a complete member profile
  • Partnering with Sales, Research and Service to delight the client
  • Accurately identifying and documenting the member’s Mission Critical Priorities
  • Developing an engagement (value) plan for each client
  • Participating (with Sales and Client Managers) in quarterly account reviews
  • Preparing value-added on-site engagements and member meetings
  • Operational rigor in maintaining client activity in our CRM and scheduling systems

Sales and Sales Support

The EP is responsible for member retention and for contributing to growth through support of sales in prospect cultivation, account planning/development and value demonstration activities delivered through proof-of-concept (POC) engagements

Client Interactions

The EP is responsible for hosting and /or participating in periodic virtual member activities, including workshops,, roundtables and webinars (in collaboration with Gartner Research)

Research Support

The EP supports research activities, such as facilitating member participation in research studies or case panels. The EP will be aligned with and leverage Gartner research positions and initiatives as well as provide feedback from the member base to the research organization. The EP works with research analysts to develop and deliver CSO/SVP Sales relevant research.

Program Delivery

  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Gartner Sales strategy and Gartner Sales product deliverables.
  • Work with members to further their levels of Sales maturity through delivery of research, peer networking, and coaching.
  • Critique client strategies, guide clients in building their organizations, and assist in developing Sales strategies, establishing priorities, and planning for implementation around key Sales initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain working relationships with various internal groups to create a comprehensive, well designed sustainable set of key deliverables for clients (including targeted research, personal coaching sessions, scripted analyst sessions, involvement with appropriate events, etc.)
  • Direct and facilitate member peer group calls and/or meetings

What you’ll need:

Subject Matter Expertise

  • The EP must be a senior business executive and have demonstrated topic knowledge in developing and delivering overall Sales strategy, execution and performance improvement.
  • The EP will be an accomplished current or former SVP, EVP of Sales, CRO, CCO or CSO that has successfully led a sales function with a minimum addressable revenue base of $1 billion and a minimum headcount of 500 people within their Sales organization.
  • As a C-Suite executive, the EP must have a broad base of expertise that has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • The EP is responsible to retain clients in accordance with established Gartner Retention Metrics. In addition, to work closely with Sales to vet and close new business.

Other requirements

  • A university graduate (Masters preferred) with 10+ years' experience working as a SVP, EVP, CRO, CGO, CCO or CSO with an addressable revenue base of at least $1 billion and a team of at least 500 people within their Sales org.
  • An in-depth understanding of the Sales Function and the role of the CSO/CRO/CGO/CCO (including leadership, enablement, operations management, compensation, strategy and trends, use of metrics, etc.)
  • In depth understanding of the business value of Sales and the alignment of Business, Marketing and Sales strategies.
  • Critical thinking and problem solving skills to assess member situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business advice, and the ability to leverage
  • Appropriate (Gartner and other) resources to help clients achieve business results
  • Ability to lead and manage ambiguous situations
  • Candidates must have excellent interpersonal skills; with a healthy dose of humility and experience working with C level executives. This individual should have strong reflective listening skills and the ability to adjust to client cues and needs
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills and strong facilitation and presentation skills
  • Energetic
  • Sales savvy
  • Collaboration and team leadership
  • Sales and / or business development experience or ability with CXO level executives
  • Strong time/project management skills
  • Experience as a Gartner client is preferred

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 188,000 USD - 225,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan.
