jobs.excerpt: TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team.
jobs.description:
TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team. The Support Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an ITIL-aligned Managed Services team, delivering high-quality support across Microsoft cloud-focused solutions including Azure, .NET-based applications, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

The role requires proactive ownership of support operations, identifying and addressing service risks, customer concerns, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets and potential escalations before intervention is required. The Support Manager is responsible not only for monitoring and reporting service performance, but for analysing trends and underlying issues, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions and driving those actions through to completion. The role will ensure service stability, effective incident and problem management, high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement across service operations.

The role holder can work remotely, but the position is open to applicants in either Ireland or the UK only.

TEKenable is a leader in digital transformation, specialising in Microsoft cloud solutions and recognised for excellence in AI and Data. With a global presence and a remote-first policy, we deliver innovative managed services to clients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Service Coordination & Delivery

  • Act as the operational bridge between the Service Delivery Manager and functional delivery teams.
  • Ensure service levels, KPIs, and contractual obligations are consistently met.
  • Support the Service Delivery Manager in contractual compliance, reporting, and client satisfaction initiatives.
  • Serve as the point of coordination for internal teams, ensuring smooth communication between technical functions and service management.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, KPI metrics and presentations for internal stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.
  • Analyse service performance data to identify trends, underlying causes, risks and areas requiring action, providing clear recommendations rather than reporting metrics in isolation.
  • Engage with client operational stakeholders on service delivery matters, while the Service Delivery Manager retains responsibility for overall client relationship, governance, and commercial performance.
  • Participate in client service reviews, governance meetings, and operational reporting sessions alongside the Service Delivery Manager.
  • Provide service performance insights, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships with client operational leads, ensuring alignment between business needs and service delivery.

Operational Ownership

  • Own day-to-day ticket operations including prioritisation, assignment, and SLA adherence
  • Own operational issues and escalations through to resolution, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, tracked and followed through to completion.
  • Proactively identify service risks, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets, customer concerns and potential escalations, taking appropriate action before management or customer intervention is required.
  • Manage backlog, ageing tickets, and escalation handling
  • Coordinate Major Incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely internal and customer communication, clear ownership of actions, and appropriate RCA and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure Problem Management activities reduce repeat incidents
  • Manage service delivery across multiple clients, balancing competing priorities and ensuring effective allocation of shared resources
  • Manage prioritisation between BAU support activities and minor enhancements (run vs change)
  • Establish and maintain regular ticket quality reviews, ensuring appropriate documentation, customer communication, troubleshooting, categorisation and adherence to agreed support processes.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor incident and request volumes, escalation trends, and service performance.
  • Provide input into dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to support proactive service management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager and Director of Managed Services.
  • Ensure ITIL-aligned processes are embedded and followed across delivery teams.
  • Identify gaps in process adherence and recommend improvements.
  • Understand, comply with and actively promote adherence to ISO27001 and ISO9001 policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed services delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using Delivery Platforms (FreshService, Datadog)

Key Competencies

  • Proactive Ownership & Accountability – takes ownership of service operations, identifies risks and issues early, takes appropriate action and drives activities through to completion without requiring continual management intervention.
  • Leadership & People Development – able to motivate, coach, and manage diverse teams across geographies.
  • Process-driven mindset with attention to compliance and governance.
  • Collaborative leadership—able to influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical and Data-Driven Thinking – able to interpret service data, identify trends and underlying causes, assess risks and translate findings into meaningful insight and clear recommendations.
  • Resilience and adaptability in managing escalations and shifting priorities.
  • Continuous improvement orientation—always seeking efficiency and service quality gains.
  • Initiative & Tooling for Improvement – proactively identifies opportunities to enhance delivery and leverages automation, dashboards, and service management tooling (e.g., ITSM platforms, monitoring, reporting, and analytics) to drive measurable improvements in performance, transparency, and client value.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication – communicates clearly with customers, technical teams and management, and is comfortable challenging, escalating and influencing where appropriate.

Why apply

  • Remote-first flexibility anywhere from Ireland or the UK with global collaboration across Spain, Hungary, and UAE.
  • Industry-leading transformation challenges using Microsoft tech in AI, Dynamics, and Data solutions.
  • Professional recognition, including Deloitte Fast 50, Microsoft Business Applications Partner of the Year, and more.
  • Career growth through coaching, structured development, and international exposure.

Requirements

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed service delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using ITSM Platform

TEKenable's culture is built upon the values of resilience, heartfelt service, always striving and insatiable curiosity. You can learn more about our values at www.tekenable.ie. Candidates applying for this role need to be able to demonstrate how they have applied these values in other roles and how they'll contribute to them, should they be successful.

At TEKenable we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion as we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, disability, sexual orientation, generation, ethnicity, religion, family or parental status, neurodiversity or belief.

Hiring Process

Once you are successfully selected for interview a dedicated talent acquisition manager will reach out and arrange a short pre-screening call. We want to learn more about you and the experience you can bring to the position. The interview process will have 2-3 stages and we will work around your availability. You will the opportunity to talk with our recruitment team at various points throughout the process. All interview stages will be conducted remotely via video calls and arranged at a time that fits with your schedule. We will close the position once the role is filled.

Remote working & sustainability - Experience the flexibility to work from Ireland or the UK, avoiding the stress of being stuck in car jams, saving valuable commute time to an office, while actively contributing to a lower carbon footprint and the fight against climate change.

Sports & Social Events - Join a vibrant community through regular sports activities, team outings, and social events that bring colleagues together and foster meaningful connections beyond work.

jobs.description:
Who We Are & What We Do:

Branching Minds’ mission is to empower all educators to effectively, efficiently, and equitably support the holistic needs of their students; and to create a path to academic and personal success for every learner. Already supporting over 2,000,000 students across 400+ districts from over 40 states, our vision is to be the most effective national K12 school district solution for achieving high-fidelity MTSS/RTI; consistently demonstrating our ability to save teachers' planning/documenting time, improve outcomes of our students, and eliminate achievement gaps.

We don’t play by the rules of traditional organizations. We get to be innovative in the solutions we develop for our partners and the way we conduct our business for ourselves. Branching Minds is also a Benefit Corporation. We prioritize mission alongside profit. We embrace self-management, transparency, collaboration, initiative, and making a difference in the world.

If using innovation to reimagine education in service of equity energizes you -- join our team!

The Calling:

Engaging the full scope of your skills, passion, and creativity in sales, you’ll get to build partnerships with district leaders and help them achieve student success for all learners.

We’re looking for an Account Executive who can succeed across the full sales cycle, from the first outbound touch to signed contract, and who takes ownership of building and advancing a healthy pipeline. You'll own new business with large K-12 districts in your territory and spend meaningful time in the field with prospects and customers.

Selling to school districts requires more than a great product. It takes curiosity, persistence, and the ability to understand complex challenges, connect our solutions to district priorities, and build a compelling case for investment. You’ll navigate multiple stakeholders, manage complex buying processes, and bring the strategic thinking and sales discipline needed to move opportunities forward and close business.

As part of the Revenue team, this role reports to the Director of Sales.

What You Will Achieve:

Keeping your pipeline full

  • Proactively identify and pursue new client relationships with large districts (10,000+ students in size) in your sales territory.
  • Book 1-2 new meetings of your own every week, whether through engagement in the field, email and phone outreach, or other creative approaches. You’ll also receive meetings from inbound leads and our Sales Development Representative, but you won’t succeed in this role without booking your own.
  • When your calendar is light in a given week, spend the majority of your working hours focused on booking meetings.
  • Start and finish your prospecting sequences and campaigns. No random acts of prospecting!
  • Consistently bring new ideas to your 1:1s with your manager: campaigns, sequences, territory trips, and conference ideas.

Winning complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Ask excellent discovery questions to understand prospect needs, challenges, and goals, and tie Branching Minds’ products and features directly to school and district pain points.
  • Strategically map accounts and engage with key decision-makers across multiple stakeholders.
  • Prepare thoroughly for every meeting and follow up promptly afterward.
  • Leave nothing to chance: set a scheduled next step on every deal, and work your pipeline in between scheduled meetings.
  • Develop accurate proposals and contracts that reflect both the client’s needs and the capability of Branching Minds, and negotiate and close with skill.
  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas, pipeline growth, and activity metrics.

Building relationships with district leaders

  • Spend ample time in the field with prospects and customers alike.
  • Represent Branching Minds at industry conferences and networking events to expand market presence and deepen industry knowledge.
  • Earn referrals. You’ll know you’re an expert relationship-builder when the district leaders you’ve sold to or spent time with refer you to their peers.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure a smooth transition post-sale, high client satisfaction, and long-term partnerships within your accounts.

Executing with operational excellence

  • Manage your pipeline and performance independently, with a data-driven approach that uses key metrics to guide decisions.
  • Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date records of all customer interactions in HubSpot, including deal stages, close dates, qualification information, timelines, and next steps.
  • Quickly learn our product, our space, and the problems our buyers need to solve, and stay informed of industry trends and the competitive landscape.
  • Work independently, but never be afraid to ask for help if it increases the chances you win a deal.
  • Contribute to the refinement of sales processes, tools, and methodologies, and support the growth and development of other Account Executives on the Large Market team.

Requirements

Why We Want You:

  • 5+ years of K-12 ed-tech sales experience selling to public school districts.
  • You have prior experience as an SDR/BDR and succeeded. You know the power of prospecting and never feel above the work that made you successful.
  • A track record of moving up through the ranks (for example, SDR to SMB to large market) at a reputable K12, ed-tech company.
  • You bring a proven record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing deals with districts of 10,000+ students.
  • Demonstrated success in an outbound motion. You can describe in detail a specific campaign or approach that led to booked discovery meetings.
  • Experience engaging with senior district decision-makers, with a strong ability to build rapport and trust.
  • Strong organizational systems that let you consistently finish the sequences and campaigns you start, prepare well for every meeting, follow up on time, and manage your pipeline with limited supervision.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions effectively.
  • Experience using HubSpot or an equivalent CRM, and a commitment to keeping it accurate.
  • Comfortable traveling at least 40% to meet with prospects and customers and attend industry events (especially during higher-volume times of year like fall and spring).

Lucky Us If You:

(No biggie if you don’t)

  • Have experience selling RTI/MTSS, Analytics, or Assessment SaaS products

Interview Process:

If we are a match, you can expect a total of 3 steps in the interview process after the initial application

  • 30-minute initial conversation with the Director of Sales
  • 45-minute panel discussion with a member of Sales Team Leadership & a peer Account Executive
  • 30-minute final conversation with the Director of Sales

Benefits

What We Offer You:

  • Check out our Benefits & Perks
  • Fully remote!
  • An awesome, cross-disciplinary, mission-driven team solving meaningful problems that improves the lives of educators and students.
  • Compensation for this position ranges from $90,000 to $105,000 annually, based on experience, expertise, and geographic location, with additional bonus and commission opportunities for total on-target earnings (OTE) of up to $210,000.

Studies show that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented individuals tend to hesitate applying for jobs unless they meet all listed qualifications. At Branching Minds, we prioritize cultivating a diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture. Therefore, if you're passionate about the role but your previous experience doesn't perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we still urge you to apply. You may be a strong fit for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

In Our Own Words, We Are...

Independent, Relaxed, Ownership, Flexibility, Always Learning, Casual, Adaptable, “Best Idea Wins,” Passionate, Dedicated, Very Capable/Competent, Efficient, Communicative, Welcoming, Caring, Scrappy, Friendly, Co-operative, Agile, Supportive, Principle-Driven, Respectful, Practical, Attentive, Funny, Self-Motivated, Silly Parrots.

Our Commitment to People with Disabilities

jobs.description:
ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
In this technical role, you will be responsible for the architecture of JD Edwards solutions, how systems are configured, extended, integrated, and deployed, and for ensuring those designs are implemented correctly through delivery.
Success in this role requires strong technical and functional knowledge. You must understand the business processes and the technology behind them so you can create, review, explain, and defend effective solutions.
Solution Architects at ERP Suites own the solution lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, proposal development, technical design oversight, implementation guidance, and post-project review.

Key Responsibilities
Solution Architecture & Design

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client business processes, objectives, challenges, and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, practical solution architectures and functional designs.
  • Design integrated solutions across enterprise platforms, including JD Edwards, Salesforce, AI technologies, and related business applications.
  • Evaluate solution alternatives by considering business value, implementation complexity, risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce solution architecture documents, workflow diagrams, technical specifications, and implementation roadmaps.
Client Engagement & Presales
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during presales engagements, helping clients identify the best solution for their business needs.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops and requirements sessions with executives, business users, and technical stakeholders.
  • Present solution recommendations with clear business and technical justification.
  • Support proposal development, project estimation, and implementation planning.
  • Set realistic expectations regarding project scope, timelines, costs, and delivery approach.
Delivery Leadership
  • Maintain architectural ownership throughout project delivery to ensure solutions are implemented as designed.
  • Collaborate with project managers, consultants, developers, and client teams to resolve design questions and implementation challenges.
  • Identify risks, technical constraints, and scope changes early, recommending practical solutions when adjustments are needed.
  • Review implementation progress to ensure alignment with architectural standards and client objectives.
  • Participate in post-implementation reviews and continuously improve delivery methodologies and best practices.

You enjoy solving business problems just as much as technical ones. You're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and quickly understand how technology can improve business operations.
You communicate effectively with both executives and technical teams, translating complex concepts into language that builds confidence and trust. You take ownership of your work, make informed decisions, and remain engaged throughout delivery to ensure your solutions achieve the intended outcomes.
You thrive in consulting environments where every client presents a unique challenge and where your ability to think strategically, collaborate effectively, and adapt quickly makes a meaningful impact.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences and influence decisions through collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Experience across both presales solution architecture and post-sales implementation.
  • Experience with JD Edwards Orchestrator, AIS, or automation and low-code extension frameworks.
  • Experience with JD Edwards upgrades, code-current programs, retrofit strategy, or cloud migrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and enterprise application infrastructure, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Experience architecting solutions that combine JD Edwards with adjacent platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP Cloud, or reporting and analytics tools.

  • Certifications in Oracle, JD Edwards, cloud platforms, or enterprise architecture. ERP Suites supports professional development and will contribute toward relevant certifications for the right candidate.

You'll work directly with clients, collaborate with experienced consultants and technical experts, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact across a wide variety of industries and technologies. jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Solution Engineering leader who is ready to lead teams that build reliable, production AI products for customer service. You lead engineering teams, including Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who integrate foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components into products that customers and service employees use every day.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams will be embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You set the standard for how your team work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI product engineering programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as resolution, average handle time, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Lead delivery of production AI applications for service: conversational AI agents across voice and digital channels, human agent-assist copilots, knowledge assistants, interaction summarization and quality automation, and analytics agents that let leaders ask questions of their service data in plain language.
  • Hold your FDEs to production-grade standards: tested Python and TypeScript services, eval suites that catch regressions, observability, and clear cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs, so solutions run reliably after handoff.
  • Set engineering standards for how AI components work together, including RAG design, prompt and context engineering, evals and guardrails, model selection, and when fine-tuning is worth the investment.
  • Originate use cases with clients, prioritizing by measurable value and shaping engagements that ladder to a real product, not a proof of concept.
  • Turn conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes into production code, co-creating from early concepts and feeding back what data and model behavior reveal so the experience keeps improving.
  • Ensure what ships is secure, monitored, and responsible, partnering with specialists in MLOps, AI security, and responsible AI.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and crafting proposals that win work our teams are proud to ship.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on the service AI products that matter most to clients, such as agentic customer service and analytics agents, advancing Song Service as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with AI and service platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow FDEs and the engineers around them, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across use case discovery & prioritization, story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify delivery patterns, eval suites, and reusable components, and feed field learnings back into our offerings to make delivery repeatable.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders. Experience should include:
    • A hands-on background moving AI products into production (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails).
    • Working fluency with the FDE technical stack, including LLM APIs across frontier and open-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral), agentic frameworks and MCP, RAG pipelines and vector databases, Python and TypeScript, REST and GraphQL integration, and model and prompt evals, so you can inspire and challenge your teams' technical designs.
  • Delivery experience on at least one enterprise agent platform in production, such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure, Google Gemini, or Databricks Mosaic.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

Bonus points if you have:

  • A product-led mindset that connects AI and data work to product strategy and the design-to-product pipeline.
  • Experience leading delivery of conversational AI in production, such as virtual agents, voice bots, agent-assist copilots, and knowledge assistants, spanning conversation design, dialog and intent management, and LLM-based agents across voice and digital channels.
  • Experience embedding AI into contact center and CRM platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect, and into the workflows service agents use every day.
  • Experience with conversation intelligence, such as speech and interaction analytics, sentiment, and automated quality assurance, turning service conversations into insight at the enterprise level.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.
  • Experience with conversational AI and agent platforms such as Google Customer Engagement Suite, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Salesforce Agentforce, or ServiceNow AI Agents.
  • A full-stack engineering background in web, mobile, or API development.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams spanning design, advisory, and technology, turning research insights and design recommendations into engineered solutions.
  • Experience working in management consulting or a professional services environment.
  • You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewEncoura is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our One Stop and Help Desk offerings.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our One Stop and Help Desk offerings. These solutions enable colleges and universities to deliver accessible, responsive support to students, faculty, and staff across voice, chat, and digital channels. This role owns the evolution of a differentiated, scalable service experience—combining contact center operations, Amazon Connect (AWS Connect), AI-powered voice and chat assistants, intelligent self-service, and seamless human-agent support. You will translate institutional needs, operational insights, and emerging technology into a prioritized portfolio strategy, aligning engineering, service delivery, client-facing teams, and executive stakeholders around measurable improvements in customer experience, operational performance, and growth.

A Day in the Life

  • Own and communicate the One Stop and Help Desk product vision, strategy, multi-quarter roadmap, and prioritized backlog, balancing client needs, competitive differentiation, commercial opportunities, technical investment, and operational efficiency
  • Set product direction for Amazon Connect-based omnichannel experiences, including IVR, intelligent routing, queue management, agent desktop/workflows, integrations, reporting, workforce management, and quality assurance; partner with engineering on architectural tradeoffs and scalability
  • Lead the strategy and delivery of conversational AI across voice and chat—including virtual agents, knowledge-grounded answers, automated resolutions, intent recognition, escalation to human agents, and conversation analytics—with explicit quality, safety, and performance measure
  • Conduct market and customer discovery with higher education institutions, frontline agents, service operations, implementation, sales, and client success; map end-to-end service journeys and translate unmet needs into differentiated product opportunities
  • Define business cases, success metrics, and performance targets; own product-level accountability for CSAT, NPS, customer effort, digital containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, call abandonment, agent productivity, and SLA performance, in partnership with operating teams
  • Use contact center analytics, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, financial/operational data, and competitive intelligence to evaluate opportunities, prioritize investments, monitor AI accuracy and escalation effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead discovery through launch and adoption: define outcomes and requirements, guide UX and technical decisions, make scope and priority tradeoffs, ensure release readiness, and equip go-to-market, implementation, and service teams with positioning and enablement
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority; proactively manage dependencies, delivery risks, vendor/platform relationships, and roadmap decisions while mentoring less-experienced product colleagues as appropriate

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Assess the One Stop and Help Desk business, customer segments, economics, service workflows, current roadmap, Amazon Connect architecture, AI capabilities, partner dependencies, and operational scorecard; establish relationships with key leaders and identify immediate risks and opportunities.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Present a clear portfolio assessment, prioritized multi-quarter roadmap, and measurable outcome framework; align product, engineering, operations, and commercial leaders on strategic priorities, AI automation opportunities, and delivery tradeoffs; lead an initial high-value initiative.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Be accountable for execution and demonstrated progress against agreed product KPIs; deliver and measure a material portfolio enhancement, advance the voice/chat AI and self-service strategy, and establish a repeatable process for customer discovery, roadmap governance, and post-launch optimization.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience, including significant ownership of SaaS or technology product strategy and delivery; prior experience with contact center platforms, customer service technology, or managed service-enabled products strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of contact center operations and service delivery, including omnichannel engagement, IVR, routing and queues, workforce management (WFM), quality assurance (QA), service-level agreements (SLAs), and reporting/analytics
  • Hands-on product experience with Amazon Connect (AWS Connect) or a comparable cloud contact center platform; able to make informed decisions about platform capabilities, integrations, vendor dependencies, architectural constraints, and total cost of ownership
  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling conversational AI, chatbots, voice assistants, or automated self-service; understands knowledge management, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, agent handoffs, AI evaluation, and responsible deployment
  • Proven ability to define and improve measurable product and operational outcomes, including CSAT, NPS, customer effort, containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, abandonment, agent productivity, and service quality
  • Strong product leadership skills in discovery, market assessment, strategy, business cases, roadmap prioritization, agile execution, stakeholder influence, and written and executive-level communication; comfortable using Jira, Confluence, and analytics tools
  • Sound commercial and technical judgment; able to work independently through ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, negotiate tradeoffs, and align diverse teams around outcomes rather than feature requests
  • Experience in higher education or EdTech is a plus; commitment to improving the student support experience and using AI to augment—not simply replace—effective human service
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process
    • CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $160,000 - $175,000 andreflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary.Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

About  Us

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. Since 1972, the Company has evolved its products and services to better represent the link between students and higher education institutions and to create the highest probability of student success. 

Encoura’s expertise now spans enrollment, research, marketing, student success, and advancement and provides an unmatched combination of higher education experience and innovative solutions for colleges and universities. The Company also offers Encourage® — the nation’s largest free college and career planning program used by millions of high school students and educators nationwide.

jobs.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.

Essential Job Duties

  • Enterprise Quality Leadership: Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
  • Standardize Testing Processes: Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
  • Tooling Ownership: Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
  • Automation Strategy: Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
  • Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:
  • Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
  • Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
  • Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
  • Security & Compliance Testing Support: Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
  • Customer UAT Support:
  • Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
  • Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
  • Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
  • Quality Metrics & Reporting: Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
  • Shift-Left Quality Practices: Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
  • Incident & Defect Management: Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
  • Organizational Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
  • Release Governance: Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
  • Coding agent advocacy: Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.

Other Job Duties

  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
  • 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
  • Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
  • Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
  • Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
  • AI/ML fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.
The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

Who Are You?

You're a product marketer with an editor's eye. You like talking to customers, and you care about words and the details of positioning at a fine grain. You can read a one-pager an AI agent produced and spot the claim that's slightly wrong, the competitor detail that's out of date, or the line that doesn't sound like us. Then you fix the agent so it doesn't happen again, not just the page.
You use AI every day, and you work in Claude Code. That's the expectation here. You've already built something with it that other people use: a skill, an agent, a workflow, a review checklist. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be precise about what good looks like and unrelenting in making sure the customer's voice comes through at high quality.
You care about accuracy and volume. Agents let one person ship a lot, and you hold every piece to the same bar, so reps never have to double-check what you send them. You notice a gap and fill it before anyone assigns it to you.
You're curious. You keep up with how restaurants and their guests are changing, especially as AI reshapes what operators expect and how they talk about their problems, and you can't help bringing what you learn back to the team.
Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

Position Overview

Thanx ships a lot. Our customers do interesting things with the platform. A brand switches from another loyalty platform and more than doubles the share of guests it captures. A chain turns on RecoveryAI and wins back guests who had a bad experience before they're gone for good. A franchise system moves digital orders away from a third-party ordering vendor and onto its own app, and cuts its discounting while visits go up. That work only counts if the market, our prospects, and our own teams understand it.
Product marketing at Thanx runs on AI agents. Our competitive intelligence hub reads every competitor's public documentation and drafts comparisons and one-pagers. Other agents draft release notes, build case studies from a single customer interview, and write enablement. The agents do the first draft of most assets. Your job is everything around the draft: the planning, the inputs that go in, and the review before anything ships.
That's this role. You own the work that gets Thanx credit for what we've built: the steady drumbeat of customer communications, case studies, and the information sales, CS, and partners need. You make sure what our agents produce is accurate, on-message, and in front of the right person at the right time, and you tune the agents so each draft needs less of your time. You also own our competitive content in search and AI answer engines, so that when a restaurant brand asks ChatGPT or Google how Thanx compares, the answer is right.
This is an individual contributor role. You report to the VP of Marketing and Partnerships and work day to day with sales, customer success, product, design, and partnerships.

How We Work With AI

With great power comes great responsibility.” Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.
These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan the work and set up the inputs.Decide what gets made and when, based on the launch calendar, what sales is running into, and where our proof is thin. Give each agent what it needs to get the draft right: the customer interview, the source data, the messaging, and the goal the asset has to hit.
  • Review and approve what our agents produce. Case studies, one-pagers, competitive comparisons, release notes, and enablement all pass through you before they reach sales, customers, or the public. Check every claim against its source, and make sure it matches our messaging and how we want to show up as a company. Review high-stakes assets line by line; spot-check routine ones and widen the check when you find a problem.
  • Tune the agents.When an asset is wrong, fix the cause: the instructions, the examples, the source data, or the quality checks. Keep a running log of the errors you catch, and use it to cut the review each asset needs over time.
  • Customer lifecycle communications.Own our customer lifecycle comms program: every email that goes out to our customers, from onboarding and feature announcements to the monthly product newsletter, plus release notes, customer webinars, and the promotion around them. We ship fast, and your job is to make sure customers know what we've released and start using it. Release notes go out within 48 hours of release, every channel stays on schedule, and emails are measured on the feature activation they drive, not open rates.
  • Voice of the customer and the market.Stay close to what customers and operators are saying, and to how the market is changing as AI reshapes what restaurants expect from their technology. Bring it into the company, to product, sales, CS, and the exec team, and back out as content that earns attention: the stories, points of view, and formats that get operators reading, watching, and sharing.
  • Case studies and proof.Run case study production start to finish. Interview newly launched customers and the internal teams behind them, find the compelling angle, and validate the data. Our case study builder turns one interview into a web page, PDF, sales slide, and social-ready content; you make sure every version is accurate and worth reading.
  • Get sales, CS, and partners the right information at the right time. Know what a rep needs at each deal stage and against each competitor, and make sure our competitive and product hubs deliver it where they already work, before they have to ask. Keep CSMs informed on customer launches so they can speak to them with other customers. Track what gets used, retire what doesn't, and close the gaps you hear about on calls.
  • Customer-win content. Keep a steady flow of customer-win and launch content ("this brand launched this week, here's why it's interesting") for internal channels, partner channels, and our social team to publish.
  • Competitive content for SEO and AEO. Write and publish the comparison and alternative content that wins bottom-of-funnel searches and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude, and Google's AI Overviews. Work with Growth on which queries to target and how to measure results.
  • AEO-ready help center. Make sure our public help center articles answer the questions buyers and AI engines actually ask: clear questions, direct answers, current facts, and the context for when and why to use a feature, not just how. Embed video where it helps, and find stale or missing articles before a prospect or a competitor does.

How We Will Know It's Working

At six months:you're shipping high-quality content at volume: release notes, the newsletter, webinars, case studies, help center updates, and competitive pieces, without hand-holding and without anyone needing to double-check it. Customers hear about what we release as we release it, even at the pace we're shipping. You know which features have the biggest gap between value and adoption, and you have campaigns running against them.

At twelve months:customers know what we've released and how to use it, and it shows: adoption of the features you've focused on has moved meaningfully in the right direction. Your output has grown while the quality bar has held, because the agents you tune need less review than when you started. Your content draws an audience: operators read, watch, and share it. Our competitive content ranks and gets cited by AI answer engines for the queries that matter.
We'll measure you on three things: the quality and volume of what you ship, whether customers know what we're releasing, and whether adoption moves.

What We’re Looking For

We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS, including 2-3 years in product marketing, content marketing, customer marketing, or a closely adjacent role.
  • A sharp editor's eye for factual accuracy, tone, and claims you can defend.
  • Hands-on, daily use of Claude Code, with something you built or improved that other people use. You don't need to be an engineer.
  • SEO or AEO content experience: you know how comparison and alternative pages win, and how AI answer engines choose what to cite.
  • Experience conducting customer interviews and finding the story inside them.
  • A track record of working productively with sales and customer success, and of getting them information they actually used.
  • Experience running a customer lifecycle email program or other recurring customer communications, such as a newsletter, webinar series, or release notes, and shipping on schedule.
  • Experience with LaunchNotes, Ortto, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams you don't manage, and presenting to executives.
  • A habit of keeping up with your market and turning what you learn into content people actually seek out.
  • A structured approach to quality, such as rubrics, checklists, and spot-checks, rather than relying on gut feel.
  • Comfort with video and multimedia formats, not just written content.
  • Restaurant, retail, or hospitality technology experience is a plus, not a requirement.

We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level
  • Develop a performance cadence with the team to review key metrics (e.g., activity, conversion, etc.) and identify specific areas for improvement.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Roll out a focused industry strategy to align the team around clear goals, tactics, and go-to-market priorities across the CMET.
  • Scale growth with existing clients and have a defined strategy to procure high-potential net-new clients.
  • Engage with services stakeholders to develop coordinated strategies designed to accelerate and diversify growth while strengthening client relationships.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Secure initial traction within the CMET sector by closing new enterprise logos and expanding opportunities with existing clients, laying the groundwork for accelerated growth.
  • Assess current team structure and capabilities, making necessary changes to ensure the right team is in place to support near-term opportunity and long-term growth goals.
  • Establish clear team and individual performance objectives, aligning efforts around pipeline generation, sales velocity, and account development to drive early momentum.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual growth objectives by setting clear performance expectations across the team, leading business reviews, and coaching through deal cycles.
  • Demonstrate your ability to coach and develop the team to achieve ambitious goals while continuously improving pipeline health, close rates, and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Expand the team’s portfolio by securing five or more new Fortune 500 clients, deepen relationships with existing clients, and promote growth through Toptal’s suite of offerings.
  • Partner with Toptal Leadership to design and operationalize a 12-month growth plan for CMET through focused industry segmentation, strategic account targeting, and effective resource alignment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in Professional Services, including 5+ years leading sales teams in Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • 5+ years of in-market experience running and managing an industry business unit. Must have current, deep industry relationships at the leadership level within CMET.
  • Experience establishing high-impact, revenue-generating commercial relationships, with a proven track record of success in building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years experience building client portfolios of $20M+ with a blended team of hunters and farmers
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Recent experience selling large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • P&L experience with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Skilled at fostering positive internal relationships to align stakeholders, build consensus, and drive forward key strategic initiatives.
  • Experience at a technology or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an operationally rigorous environment with competing deadlines and fast-paced work product turnaround.
  • Ability to thrive and excel in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  • Professional maturity, solid EQ skills, and executive presence – you’re an adept storyteller with experience building long-term client relationships and influencing senior-level buyers.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel and engage with Toptal clients both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

Role Overview

Medispend's government pricing business is growing, and this is the senior addition that allows it to scale. The Director, Government Pricing is accountable for the accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of government pricing, Medicare, and VA/federal program deliverables across our client portfolio — and for building the capability of the team that produces them.

This is a hands-on role. You will personally perform the most complex calculations and historical corrections, approve client-ready output, and make the regulatory determinations behind both. You will hold approval authority alongside the Senior Director, and extending that depth across the team is a priority — we are targeting three qualified approvers within twelve months.

We deliver these services as a managed service to pharmaceutical manufacturers, predominantly small and mid-size companies without the scale to build government pricing depth in house, so you will be a senior client-facing figure as well as an internal leader.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical execution and regulatory authority

  • Personally perform complex calculations, variance analyses, and historical corrections across AMP, Best Price, URA, PHS/340B ceiling price, ASP, NFAMP, and FCP.
  • Develop and approve calculation methodologies and reasonable assumptions jointly with the Senior Director, ensuring positions are defensible, documented, and consistently applied.
  • Interpret CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program regulations and guidance — line extension, 5i versus standard AMP treatment, brand, generic and authorized generic classification, baseline AMP, prompt pay treatment, and UPPS reporting.
  • Determine transaction eligibility and treatment across AMP, Best Price, ASP, and NFAMP, including returns, chargebacks, rebates, administrative fees, bona fide service fee exclusions, and class of trade.
  • Own program-level positions and approve submissions for Medicare (Part B ASP reporting and certification, Part B inflation rebate, Part D Manufacturer Discount Program) and VA/FSS (65IB, NFAMP, FCP, IFF, quarterly VA sales reporting, TRICARE).
  • Lead historical recalculation and remediation engagements end to end — scope, correction methodology, liability impact, client communication, CMS change requests, and resubmission approval.
  • Review bona fide service fee eligibility and fair market value support, including PBM administrative fee structures, and determine their Best Price, AMP, ASP, and NFAMP implications in partnership with Legal.
  • Monitor CMS, HRSA, and VA policy developments and translate new requirements into calculation, reporting, and system changes.

Review, approval, and quality

  • Review and approve client-ready deliverables across all programs in scope, applying consistent quality control standards and internal controls.
  • Establish a tiered, risk-based review framework so review depth matches exposure, and maintain a documented sign-off record.
  • Monitor CMS, VA, and client deadlines across the portfolio, resolve capacity constraints before they threaten a deadline, and investigate root cause whenever an error reaches a client.

Building capability

  • Manage, coach, and develop Government Pricing Analysts and Team Leads — setting priorities, allocating workload, and ensuring coverage across competing deadlines.
  • Develop at least one additional qualified approver from within the team inside twelve months and develop the Medicare and federal program leads to independent ownership of their programs.
  • Establish and maintain a documented position log of regulatory determinations, alongside methodology documentation, SOPs, and review criteria.
  • Lead technical development, performance management, succession planning, and hiring for the team.

Client partnership, commercial support, and operating performance

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex client issues and disputed results, lead quarterly business reviews, and explain calculation outcomes and rebate liability exposure to client Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders in clear business terms.
  • Support Sales and Account Management with scoping, statements of work, and level-of-effort estimates, and advise clients on Medicaid inflation penalty exposure and proposed WAC increase impacts.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs and service-level targets — timeliness, exception and rework rates, backlog aging, and team utilization — and manage to project budgets and account-level cost to serve.
  • Build the business case for automation and partner with IT, Product, and Development on government pricing logic, configuration, and calculation testing.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical government pricing experience, the majority gained inside a manufacturer or in a role directly accountable for manufacturers' reported prices and certifications.
  • Personal, hands-on ownership of AMP, Best Price, and URA methodology and calculation — not oversight alone. This role performs the work as well as directing it.
  • Deep expertise in the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program, PHS/340B ceiling price, and federal pricing requirements, sufficient to review and approve any calculation the team produces.
  • A record of establishing, documenting, and defending reasonable assumptions and regulatory positions that withstood audit or client scrutiny, including multi-period historical recalculations and corrected CMS submissions.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Part B ASP reporting and certification, the Part D Manufacturer Discount Program, and VA FSS 65IB contracting, NFAMP, FCP, and IFF obligations.
  • 3+ years leading analysts or technical staff, with a demonstrated record of raising people's technical capability — not only managing workload.
  • Experience with government pricing platforms such as iContracts, Model N, IntegriChain, EVERSANA, Vistex, or comparable solutions, and advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and compliance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Managed services, consulting, or outsourced provider experience supporting multiple pharmaceutical manufacturers.
  • Experience in a smaller or scaling organization where process, documentation, and controls had to be built rather than inherited.
  • Experience building a methodology or regulatory position library used by a team, and establishing KPIs, service-level targets, and quality metrics.
  • Experience advising on line extension, 5i treatment, authorized generic relationships, class of trade, and UPPS corrections.
  • Working knowledge of Public Law pricing compliance and Trade Agreements Act (TAA) requirements.
  • Experience applying AI or automation tooling to regulatory research or calculation workflows, and working proficiency with SQL, Power Query, Alteryx, or comparable data tooling.

What we provide:

  • Merit-based compensation – Competitive base salary plus bonus
  • Work from anywhere – Roles are open to candidates located anywhere in the US (United States)
  • Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off), including Paid Holidays and Sick Leave
  • 401k+ Match
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Health and wellness perks including life & disability insurance, healthcare funding options like FSAs (Flexible Spending Accounts) and HSAs (Health Savings Account), Dependent Care, an EAP (Employee Assistance Program) program, discounts, Learning and Development

Working Conditions/Physical Demands:

This position is fully remote, with limited travel that may be required for occasional team meetings, training sessions, or business events. Work is performed primarily in a home-office environment using standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone. Employees are expected to maintain a safe, ergonomic, and confidential workspace with reliable high-speed internet access suitable for professional remote work.

The role generally requires extended periods of sitting, viewing a computer screen, and communicating through written and verbal means. Occasional light physical activity (e.g., lifting materials or equipment up to 20 pounds) may be necessary.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Employees working remotely must ensure their workspace meets company standards for safety, ergonomics, and data security as outlined in organizational policy.

Responsible for planning, producing, and leading a high volume of coordinated promotion and engagement communications across print, digital, email, web, events, and social channels. Integrated Donor Communications & Journey Management
