The Opportunity

We are hiring a Digital Content Specialist to help us tell those stories well and tell them consistently. You will interview our engineers, turn their work into thought leadership and project features, and keep kpff.com current. You will manage the website content calendar and contribute the project stories, employee spotlights, and video assets that feed our social channels. You will work day -to-day with our communications team, web developer, regional marketing teams, and engineers across the country.

This is a new role. The person who takes it will help shape what it becomes.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the website content calendar. Build and maintain the editorial calendar for kpff.com, tracking topics, subject matter experts, and publish dates so content moves on a steady rhythm.
  • Establish the process. Help establish the intake process for thought leadership, content standards, and workflows for our content as it moves from office to publication.
  • Interview our engineers. Sit down with structural and civil engineers across our offices, ask good questions, and turn their expertise into blog posts and project features that speak to our clients and our peers in the industry.
  • Keep the website current. Maintain project pages, news, people pages, and thought leadership content so the site reflects the work we are doing right now.
  • Support thought leadership. Work with firm leadership to identify the topics where KPFF has expertise worth sharing, then coordinate the content that puts our people forward as the experts they are.
  • Produce employee spotlights. Tell the stories of the people behind the work, from new graduates to principals, in support of recruiting and firm culture.
  • Coordinate video. Plan and shepherd video content for project and people highlights, working with internal staff and outside videographers. You will oversee the production process rather than edit the footage.
  • Feed the social calendar. Supply project stories, spotlights, photography, and video to the communications team, who owns the social media calendar, and make sure each piece arrives with the context and assets it needs.
  • Support Office touchpoints. Serve as a consistent content contact for Reporting Centers, gathering material and keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Partner with the web developer. Publish finished content in the right format with the right images, tags, and metadata.
  • Help carry the national brand. Support a consistent KPFF voice, look, and standard across all 36 offices, whether the content originates in Seattle or Nashville.
  • Track performance. Monitor traffic and engagement on published content, report on it clearly, and use what you learn to shape the calendar.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experience. Three or more years in content, editorial, communications, or marketing, with writing samples you are proud to share.
  • Curiosity. You are comfortable walking up to a busy engineer, earning their trust quickly, and finding the detail that makes the story. Interest in how things get built matters more here than a technical background.
  • Strong writing and editing. You can take a dense technical explanation and make it clear while keeping it accurate. Our readers are engineers, architects, contractors and owner clients who know the difference.
  • Organization and follow-through. You have run an editorial calendar before. You chase down contributors, hold deadlines, and move work through review.
  • Digital fluency. Hands-on with a CMS (WordPress preferred), comfortable with SEO fundamentals, and current on LinkedIn and Instagram as professional channels.
  • Video coordination. You have organized shoots, managed vendors, or produced short-form video for a brand.
  • Collaboration. Much of this role is earning time and material from people who do not report to you. That takes patience, persistence, and a good sense of humor.
  • Travel. Much of this work happens virtually, but the best stories often mean being there. Expect regular travel to KPFF offices and project sites to connect with engineers in person, as well as attending firmwide events such as the Winter Convention and the P&A meeting.
  • Education. Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, English, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry, or another technical professional services environment
  • Familiarity with photography direction and digital asset management
  • Basic design skills in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva
  • Experience working across a distributed, multi-office organization

Why KPFF

KPFF is a collaborative, people-centered organization that values connection, curiosity, and long-term growth. In this role, you will help shape how the firm adopts one of the most significant technology shifts of our time — responsibly, practically, and in a way that empowers our people.

If you enjoy building order out of ambiguity, supporting people, and turning strategy into everyday practice, we’d love to hear from you.

Work Environment and Flexibility

This is a work-from-home position, not a location-independent position. Candidates must be based in the United States and able to work standard business hours aligned with the Pacific or Mountain Time Zones. Team members who live near a KPFF office may have the option to work onsite or in a hybrid arrangement. Occasional travel for team meetings, recruiting activities, and office visits may be required.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Primarily a work-from-home role requiring prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, and participation in virtual meetings.
  • Requires a reliable internet connection and a professional environment appropriate for virtual meetings and candidate conversations.
  • Regular use of standard office technology, including a computer, headset, phone, and video conferencing tools.

Benefits and Compensation

We believe that supporting our people goes beyond the work itself. That’s why we offer a flexible, comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Benefits include:

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer contribution
  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Life insurance
  • KPFF Paid Family Leave
  • Short-term and Long-term disability insurance
  • Paid Holidays (including two Floating Holidays)
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, jury duty)

Compensation & Recognition

The expected range for a qualified candidate is $78,000 – $95,000. Additionally, we offer performance-based bonuses to recognize and reward outstanding contributions in each Reporting Center. During the interview process, we'll address any questions you may have about the overall compensation package and benefits.

Work Authorization

jobs.description:

About Osano:

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build and improve Osano AI, our intelligent privacy assistant. As part of the Osano AI team, you will take capabilities from first idea to production, with an emphasis on delivering capabilities that are reliable, measurable, and trustworthy.

This role goes beyond wrapping APIs or building chat interfaces. We are looking for an engineer who has shipped LLM-powered systems that real users depend on. That means that you’ve dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost, evaluation, and tricky edge cases within agentic systems, and you know what it takes to keep these non-deterministic systems working after launch.

You will often work on problems that aren’t well-defined. Success here depends on how you think, communicate, and work with others as much as on what you build. This position is ideal for someone who is highly technical, thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of 0→1 initiatives, wants to have an outsized impact, and believes responsible AI is non-negotiable.

Responsibilities:

Build and ship production AI

  • Design, build, and maintain agentic features across our products, from early prototype to scaled production deployments.
  • Build retrieval (RAG) systems that build trust through verifiable sources.
  • Build agentic and multi-step workflows with guardrails, observability, and structured outputs.
  • Balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost in production.

Measure and improve AI systems

  • Build thorough evaluation frameworks that cover accuracy, grounding, latency, and reliability, utilizing both offline evaluations and real-world production signals.
  • Deploy data-driven methods to decide what to ship, how to fix it, and what to stop doing.
  • Continuously refine deployed systems based on measurable outcomes.

Collaborate and communicate

  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, privacy experts, and other stakeholders to decide what to build, how to build it, and why.
  • Write clear design documents and run effective technical discussions.

Privacy-First Development

  • Embed privacy-by-design principles across the AI stack.
  • Ensure compliance, data sovereignty, and secure handling practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align AI capabilities with regulatory standards.

About You:

  • You’re curious, self-directed, and motivated to learn quickly.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and creating clarity for others.
  • You’re excited about privacy, responsible AI, and building trustworthy technology.
  • You are willing to relentlessly pursue the best, most responsible ways to leverage AI—without overselling its capabilities or ignoring its limitations.

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering or AI/ML experience
  • Demonstrated experience building and running agentic systems in production with real users, not just prototypes or internal demos.
  • Deep technical understanding of LLM usage and orchestration beyond prompt engineering.
  • Proven experience building complex RAG systems and autonomous AI agents.

HubSpot is hiring a Senior Sales Strategy Analyst to shape how we grow in Australia and New Zealand. You will sit in the JAPAC Strategy and Operations team, with your time focused on ANZ across both Upmarket and Downmarket. You will be the strategic and operational partner to our ANZ sales leaders: setting strategy, owning the operating rhythm, and bringing them insight before they ask for it.

ANZ Downmarket sits within HubSpot's Global SMB organisation. You will stay connected to the global team's strategy, tools and best practice and bring them into ANZ.

You will also work on JAPAC projects and initiatives with regional reach. This role reports to the JAPAC Strategy and Operations Manager.

What you'll do

  • Set the strategy. Define the go-to-market strategy for ANZ Upmarket and Downmarket with the ANZ Executive and Sales Leadership teams.
  • Deliver proactive insights. Spot risks and opportunities in the data and bring them to leaders before they ask.
  • Build models leaders can use. Go deep in the data, build robust models, and turn them into simple outputs leaders can use to explore scenarios.
  • Own the operating rhythm. Run weekly forecasting, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and annual planning.
  • Build with AI. Turn HubSpot data into tools leaders use every week, using Breeze and other AI tools alongside Hex and Looker.
  • Design the system. Shape territories, coverage models, capacity and quota inputs with Sales Ops, Finance and Comp, and run programs that lift pipeline and rep productivity.
  • Join up the demand engine. Work with Marketing, Sales, Partner, BDR and Enablement teams to turn insights into actions.
  • Drive decisions across teams. Share recommendations to executives based on analysis and an outside-in perspective, and align cross-functional teams on the recommendations without formal authority.
  • Connect ANZ to the wider business. Bring Global SMB playbooks into ANZ Downmarket, and contribute to JAPAC projects with regional and global reach.

Problems you'll work on

Examples of the questions this role answers:

  • How should new rep books balance customers and new business?
  • Which verticals justify a dedicated sales play, and how big is the opportunity?
  • How can we build sufficient pipeline coverage for the next quarter?
  • What does the right operating cadence look like as ANZ scales?
  • Which playbooks from other markets should we bring to ANZ, and what needs to change to make them work here?
  • How do we lift productivity per rep across the business, and does the approach need to differ by tenure?
  • How do we build tools that scale globally, so leaders get to insight faster and we deliver insights before they ask?
  • How do we successfully navigate the shift from the SaaS curve to the AI curve?

Who you are

  • A deeply curious self-starter. You find the problem, scope it, and drive it to an answer without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong modeller. You go from raw data to a working model yourself, then turn it into a simple tool leaders use to test scenarios and make the call.

  • A builder with AI. You use Breeze and other AI models to create scalable tools, not just to answer one-off questions.
  • Highly analytical. You know which metrics matter and keep asking why until the answer is useful.
  • A strong storyteller. You own the narrative behind the numbers, sell a recommendation to senior leaders, and defend a view under challenge. You bring strong opinions, loosely held, and know when to disagree and commit.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace in a high-growth SaaS business.
  • Typically 8+ years of professional experience.

  • Sales Ops, Sales Strategy, Customer Ops and FP&A professionals

  • Data scientists

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone).

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Pressable is managed WordPress hosting for agencies and businesses that can’t afford slow sites or slow answers. Our customers have enough on their plates, so we make hosting the part they never have to think about. That same standard applies to everything we put our name on, from a support reply to a blog post to a landing page.

We’re hiring a Content & Website Marketing Manager to create content that breaks through to new audiences and to own how all of it lives on pressable.com. Pressable’s MCP and our AI workflows that save agency owners and businesses time are a huge part of that story, and this role will find the angles that matter and publish them on a site that reflects the quality of our platform. At Pressable, you’ll work with a small group of genuinely good people, doing your best work. We believe in being curious, kind and accountable, so most days you’re figuring out what work matters most to the business and the output that will get us there.

About the Role

You’ll write articles and guides, produce demo videos, and run our webinar program. You’ll also own every page published on pressable.com, from blog posts to landing pages to the resource library. If it goes live on our website, it goes through you. The work covers multiple formats, so this role suits someone who enjoys variety and takes pride in a well-run website. You’ll work with Product Marketing, Brand, and Demand Gen on projects across the marketing team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Creation: Write and edit SEO/AEO (answer engine optimization) optimized blog posts, white papers, and thought leadership articles for agencies and growing businesses. Use research to find new stories worth telling, written from a human-first perspective, and repurpose each piece across channels like social, sales enablement, and Slack.
  • Webinars: Plan and run Pressable’s webinars from start to finish. That includes scheduling, speaker coordination, platform setup, registration pages, promotion, hosting the live session, and follow-up afterward.
  • Demo Videos: Script and record short product demos that show how Pressable features work, and publish them where they’ll do the most good.
  • Content Operations: Manage the content calendar and the website publishing calendar, and keep projects moving through review.
  • Website Publishing & Ownership: Build and launch landing pages, product pages, resource pages, and blog posts in the WordPress block editor. Act as the single point of contact for website requests from across the company, set priorities with marketing leadership, and keep a clear publishing queue so nothing stalls.
  • Site Quality & Governance: Maintain a library of block patterns and page templates so pages stay on-brand and are quick to build. QA every page before launch for layout, mobile, links, forms, and accessibility. Run regular content audits to update, consolidate, or retire outdated pages.
  • On-Page SEO & Site Health: Manage titles, meta descriptions, schema, internal linking, image optimization, and redirects. Partner with Demand Gen to track how campaign and landing pages perform, from load speed and Core Web Vitals to form completions, and fix issues on pages you own.
  • Cross-Team Support: Partner with Product Marketing on launch content and launch-day page updates, with Demand Gen on campaign landing pages, forms, and conversion, and with Brand on voice and visual standards. Work with Engineering when a page needs functionality beyond the block editor.

  • Performance Tracking: Report on how content and key pages perform across channels like webinars, social, blog, and site traffic, and use what you learn to decide what we make and update next.

You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 4–6 years of experience in content marketing, web publishing, or a related role, ideally in B2B or SaaS.

  • Are comfortable with HTML and CSS for fixing layouts and making small tweaks without waiting for a developer.

  • Write clearly and can explain technical topics in plain language.
  • Have helped run webinars or virtual events, or are eager to learn how.
  • Can record and edit simple videos and are comfortable on camera.
  • Use AI tools in your daily work and know when your own judgment matters more.
  • Can juggle a publishing queue and several projects at once without dropping details.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in web hosting, WordPress, or another developer-focused product.
  • Experience with HubSpot (forms, landing pages, or CMS integrations).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and site performance tools.
  • Experience with webinar platforms and video tools like Descript.
  • Involvement in the WordPress community, such as WordCamps, meetups, or contributing to the project.

What You’ll Work On Initially

  • Launch and host Pressable’s next webinar series.
  • Publish new guides and articles tied to upcoming product launches.
  • Produce a set of short demo videos covering key Pressable features.
  • Take ownership of pressable.com publishing, and set up an intake and prioritization process for website requests.
  • Audit the site’s existing pages and build a plan to update, consolidate, or retire outdated content.
  • Build a starter library of block patterns and templates for landing and resource pages.

Why Join Pressable?

You’ll have real influence over what Pressable publishes, how our website shows up, and how we show up in the WordPress community. The team moves quickly and gives people room to own their work.

See the perks & benefits of joining Pressablehere.

We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

This isn’t your typical work-from-home job—we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves.

jobs.description:
About AmeriPharma

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.

AmeriPharma’s Benefits

  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life that fits your lifestyle and goals
  • Great pay and general compensation structures
  • Employee assistance program to assist with mental health, legal questions, financial counseling etc.
  • Comprehensive PTO and sick leave options
  • 401k program
  • Plenty of opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Company sponsored outings and team-building events
  • Casual Fridays

Job Summary

The Infusion Supply Coordinator supports safe and efficient home infusion therapy by managing patient-specific infusion supplies and equipment in coordination with Pharmacy, Nursing, and other operational teams. This role is responsible for reviewing and adjusting supply quantities based on patient therapy needs, nursing requests, utilization, and established workflows, ensuring that supplies are sent correctly for the specific catheter line in use to support safe infusion therapy. The coordinator serves as a primary resource for infusion supply questions and is expected to validate that requested supplies are appropriate for the patient's therapy and administration method before changes are made. The role also assists with identifying alternative products, researching new supply options, and submitting requests for new items when current inventory does not meet patient or operational needs. This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and an understanding of home infusion supplies, equipment, and patient-specific therapy requirements.

Job Details

  • 100% remote position
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm PST
  • Salary Range: $25 to $30 Hourly, DOE

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage patient-specific infusion supplies and adjust quantities based on therapy requirements, frequency of administration, patient utilization, and nursing or pharmacy requests.
  • Review and validate supply requests to ensure the item and quantity requested are appropriate for the patient's therapy, vascular access, administration method, and frequency of use.
  • Identify potentially excessive, insufficient, duplicate, or inappropriate supply requests and clarify discrepancies with Pharmacy, Nursing, or other appropriate team members before processing changes.
  • Collaborate with pharmacists and nursing staff when supply needs require clinical clarification or when requested changes may affect medication administration, vascular access care, or patient safety.
  • Research alternative or substitute supplies when requested products are unavailable, discontinued, backordered, or no longer preferred.
  • Compare alternative products for intended use, compatibility, packaging, availability, and operational feasibility before recommending options for review.
  • Submit requests for new supplies or products when existing inventory does not adequately meet patient, nursing, pharmacy, or operational needs.
  • Maintain and update patient supply profiles to accurately reflect current therapy requirements and prevent unnecessary or outdated supplies from continuing to ship.
  • Review recurring supply quantities and utilization to identify opportunities to reduce waste, prevent shortages, and improve supply standardization.
  • Coordinate with Pharmacy, Nursing, Intake, Production, Shipping, and other departments to resolve supply-related questions and ensure patients receive the appropriate supplies for treatment.
  • Assist with urgent or same-day supply needs by evaluating the request, determining what is required, and coordinating appropriate fulfillment or escalation.
  • Monitor supply inventory concerns and communicate anticipated shortages, unusual utilization, or product needs to the appropriate Production or Supply Chain leadership.
  • Assist with supply standardization initiatives by identifying commonly used products, unnecessary variation, and opportunities to establish preferred supply options.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient-specific supply changes, special requirements, substitutions, and relevant communications in the pharmacy system.
  • Support equipment management, including coordinating equipment needs, replacements, returns, and pickups as applicable.
  • Assist with equipment recovery efforts and collaborate with Specialty Pharmacy or other departments when demand letters or additional follow-up are required.
  • Participate in inventory audits, supply utilization reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and workflow development to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary supply costs.
  • Escalate clinical questions to a pharmacist or nurse when a supply request requires clinical judgment beyond the scope of the coordinator role.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-need basis or determined by management
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.
  • Take primary ownership of: Patient-specific supply quantities and adjustments, review and validation of supply requests, supply utilization and waste reduction, alternative product research, new supply/product requests, patient supply profile accuracy, supply and equipment issue resolution, and cross-department coordination of infusion supply needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in home infusion, specialty pharmacy, medical supplies, DME, pharmacy operations, healthcare supply chain, or a related setting preferred.
  • Familiarity with infusion supplies, vascular access supplies, administration sets, pumps, and related equipment.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate whether supply quantities and requests are reasonable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to research products, compare alternatives, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to manage multiple patient-specific requests while maintaining accuracy and appropriate prioritization.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with pharmacists, nurses, technicians, shipping personnel, and other interdisciplinary teams.
  • Attention to detail
  • Supply utilization and inventory awareness
  • Critical thinking and problem solving
  • Patient-specific supply management
  • Cross-functional communication
  • Research and product evaluation
  • Documentation accuracy
  • Prioritization and follow-through
  • Cost and waste awareness
  • Understanding of role boundaries and appropriate clinical escalation

Education and Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or healthcare-related education preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using patient management or inventory systems such as CPR+ preferred.

AmeriPharma’s Mission Statement

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. At Pet Circle, we believe pets deserve the very best, and the people who love them deserve a better way to care for them. Since 2011, we've grown from that single idea into Australia's biggest online pet retailer, with around 700 Pet Circlers across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines, reshaping how pet parents discover, choose and receive what their pets need.

Pet care is a $15 billion industry in Australia, and as pet ownership continues to grow, so do the expectations of modern pet parents. They want expert advice, personalised experiences, convenience and reliability, all delivered seamlessly. That's where we come in. We're building the future of pet care through technology, innovation and a deep understanding of what pets and their people need. It's a big opportunity, and we're only just scratching the surface.

The role

Our mission is to engage with our community of pet families as their specialist for everything pet. This means we need our frontline Customer Specialist Team to be absolute specialists in our products, our business model and our customers. Our Customer Specialists are there to support our Customers through every stage of their journey with Pet Circle, from welcoming a new pet through to when things don’t go to plan.

Working Arrangements:

We are building a highly autonomous, empowered remote team - so you will be working from your home office. Specific working arrangements:

  • You must have a good home office set-up, including desk, laptop (and second screen), headphones / headset, phone and a fast and reliable internet connection. This includes antivirus and malware software installed on your device.

  • Full time, permanent role (38 hours per week), Monday - Friday

  • We work between 6:45am and 7:30pm on a rotational roster

What you’ll be working on

  • Deliver best in class customer service in a high-volume and complex, contact centre environment. You will be predominantly phone-based with some live chat and email response. You will be handling customer requests ranging from delivery enquiries to product recommendations.

  • Handle all customer queries with the goal of providing an efficient, effective resolution while delighting our customers, going above and beyond to build loyalty and advocacy

  • Be a relationship building expert, creating genuine connections with every pet parent and building the trust that turns a single interaction into a lasting relationship with Pet Circle

  • Be solutions focused, owning every customer problem through to resolution and always finding the best outcome for the customer and Pet Circle, not just the quickest workaround

  • Apply root cause analysis to recurring issues, digging into why problems happen and sharing your insights so we can fix things at the source

  • Champion continuous improvement, proactively identifying and suggesting better ways of working across our processes, tools and knowledge

  • Add a personalised, human touch to every interaction, tailoring your service to each customer and their pet so we add value where we matter most

  • Deliver on all team and individual KPIs, balancing productivity targets and customer satisfaction metrics (CSat, NPS, Customer Lifetime Value and Retention Rates)

  • Be open and receptive to feedback and coaching as we pride ourselves on living our continuous improvement mindset

  • Positively contribute to our passionate, pet-loving, customer-oriented, and results-driven team!

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 2 years’ professional experience in a fast paced, results driven environment where you were managing internal or external customer requests. This may have been a contact centre, customer services or a role with transferable skills

  • Fast learner and experience working with online systems and web technologies (CRM, ticketing systems, order management software is ideal)

  • Preference is someone that is Sydney-based

A few good things

  • Heaps of development opportunities - lunch & learns, secondments & unlimited learning courses via Go1

  • Flexible working environment

  • Up to 50% employee discount

  • Product sample giveaways

  • Pawrental leave

Why you'll want in

Looking after pets, and the pet parents who love them, is what gets us out of bed. That energy carries into how we work, and into what your days here would feel like.

You'll own your patch and have the room to act on it. We move fast and decide fast, and we'd rather test an idea and learn from it than sit on it. You'll have rich, real-time data at your fingertips to back your thinking, and the freedom to chase an opportunity the moment you spot one. The best idea wins, wherever it comes from.

What holds it together is what we stand for:

  • We're better together

  • We operate with humble hearts and hungry minds

  • Pets matter, so pets and pet parents always have a seat at our table

  • We're instinctively curious. Always

Everyone (& their pets) Welcome

We're better when we don't all think the same. Different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences make our work sharper and our days more interesting, so whoever you are, if this role excites you we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box. And if you need anything adjusted in the process to do your best, just say the word, we're happy to help.

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. Responsibilities

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes

  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

Your Role:

This position reports to the Vice President, Supply Chain.

You know that great logistics is more than moving product from one place to another. It is how we protect quality, deliver for our customers, support our farmers and crew, and grow responsibly. You bring a strong mix of strategy and operational leadership, and you are just as comfortable setting the direction for the network as you are working through a transportation disruption, a provider performance issue, or a difficult cost and service trade-off.

At Vital Farms, you will lead our end-to-end logistics network across inbound farm transportation, outbound customer transportation, warehousing, cold storage, and distribution. You will build the systems, partner relationships, operating rhythms, and team capabilities needed to deliver reliable service, preserve cold-chain integrity, manage cost, and scale with the business.

What You'll Do:

You will own the logistics strategy and lead the team and external partners responsible for moving and storing finished goods safely, reliably, and efficiently across the Vital Farms network.

Lead the logistics strategy and network

  • Set and execute a logistics strategy that supports Vital Farms’ growth, customer commitments, stakeholder model, and evolving supply chain operating model.
  • Own short- and long-range capacity planning across transportation, cold storage, warehousing, and distribution; identify constraints early and build practical contingency plans.
  • Evaluate network design, lane strategy, storage footprint, and operating models to improve service, resilience, scalability, and total delivered cost.
  • Translate logistics performance, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions into clear recommendations for Supply Chain and company leadership.

Own inbound and outbound transportation performance

  • Oversee inbound transportation from farms and suppliers and outbound transportation to customers and distribution points.
  • Lead governance for dedicated fleet and managed transportation partners, including routing, appointment scheduling, load building and optimization, tendering, carrier performance, freight claims, and special requests.
  • Use on-time pickup, on-time delivery, customer scorecards, freight performance, and exception data to set expectations, drive accountability, and improve service.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for transportation disruptions, balancing immediate recovery with root-cause correction and prevention.

Lead warehousing, distribution, and 3PL partnerships

  • Maintain overall accountability for receiving, storage, inventory handling, order fulfillment, and shipping of finished goods across the network.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with third-party transportation, distribution, and warehousing providers through clear governance, contracts, performance reviews, KPIs, and corrective action plans.
  • Partner with site, Quality, and distribution leaders to maintain food safety, cold-chain integrity, inventory accuracy, pallet and load quality, and consistent shipment standards.
  • Support new facility and distribution-capability readiness, including operating requirements, systems integration, launch planning, and transition into sustainable operations.

Build financial and operational discipline

  • Develop and own logistics budgets and forecasts, including transportation, warehousing, distribution, accessorial, claims, and related operating costs.
  • Identify cost drivers and loss areas, build fact-based recommendations, and deliver sustainable savings without compromising food safety, quality, crew safety, or customer service.
  • Establish a practical KPI and operating-review cadence that creates one shared view of service, inventory flow, capacity, cost, risks, and actions.
  • Partner with Finance and Supply Chain peers on forecasts, accruals, variance reviews, customer pickup economics, and business cases for logistics investments.

Advance systems, data, and continuous improvement

  • Improve the integration and effective use of D365, transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, 3PL platforms, automation, and reporting tools.
  • Connect operational data across internal and partner systems so teams can identify issues quickly and translate insights into action.
  • Lead continuous improvement across transportation and distribution, including standard work, exception management, claims, inventory handoffs, customer feedback loops, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with IT, Operations Development, and external providers to improve system reliability, visibility, controls, and readiness for future growth.

Lead the team and cross-functional partnerships

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Logistics team with clear roles, priorities, decision rights, and accountability for results.
  • Build strong working relationships across Farm Support, Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, IT, and commercial teams.
  • Create a culture of urgency, ownership, constructive challenge, learning, and recognition while modeling Vital Farms’ values.
  • Build team capability and succession depth across transportation operations, analytics, systems, partner management, and network leadership.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • You have 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or distribution, preferably in food, beverage, CPG, or another temperature-sensitive environment.
  • You have led a complex, multi-node logistics network and managed third-party transportation and warehousing providers.
  • You understand transportation markets, carrier and fleet operations, warehousing and distribution, cold-chain requirements, and relevant regulatory considerations.
  • You can manage budgets, analyze cost and service trade-offs, and deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.
  • You have experience with ERP and supply chain execution technology, such as D365 or a comparable ERP, TMS, WMS, warehouse automation, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • You use data and sound judgment to turn operational details and ambiguity into clear decisions and action plans.
  • You communicate clearly, influence across functions, negotiate effectively, and lead through external partners as well as direct teams.
  • You are a proven people leader who coaches, develops talent, and creates clear accountability.
  • You are available to travel approximately 20-30% based on business needs, provider reviews, facility support, and network initiatives.
  • Bonus points if you have launched or scaled logistics capabilities, facilities, automation, or major system integrations.
  • You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.
  • You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.
  • You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.
  • You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.
  • You don’t walk on eggshells – You’re not afraid to leave the bullsh*t behind and have honest conversations.
  • We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven’t yet considered!

What We Bring to the Table:

  • A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
  • Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
  • Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
  • Free eggs, along with friends and family discounts.
  • Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
  • Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

At Vital Farms, compensation decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to, skill level, experience, education, training, market demands, and business needs. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum end of the range would not be typical in order to allow for potential continued future salary growth.

Who We Are:

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms became a national consumer brand that works with 600 family farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in over 24,000 stores nationwide.

PaceMate is looking for an Associate Application Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you’ll help build and maintain the internal applications, automation systems, and AI-enabled workflows that power PaceMate’s clinical and operational functions. You’ll work closely with our Senior Director of AI & BI and cross-functional teams, developing APIs, integrations, and data pipelines while getting hands-on experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows.

You’ll work across analytics applications, automation systems, AI workflows, integrations, and operational tooling. This is a role built for someone who wants to grow from a junior-level developer into a well-rounded engineer capable of supporting applications, automation, and intelligent systems.

The ideal candidate naturally thinks: “How do we build this better, automate this, and scale this long-term?” , not someone focused solely on dashboards or manual reporting.

What You’ll Do

Application Development & Support

  • Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of internal applications and automation systems
  • Help improve application reliability and performance
  • Build APIs, integrations, workflows, and backend services supporting business operations
  • Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, system issues, and performance bottlenecks
  • Contribute to feature development, testing, and modernization efforts

Data & Platform Engineering

  • Develop and optimize data models, queries, and integrations across MySQL, PostgreSQL, Salesforce, and internal systems
  • Build scalable automation and data-processing solutions
  • Help ensure the integrity and reliability of operational and analytical data flows
  • Support AI-enabled workflows and automation pipelines
  • Implement monitoring, validation, and observability practices

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery
  • Identify opportunities to automate operational processes
  • Partner with leadership to prototype and deliver innovative solutions
  • Stay current on emerging technologies and recommend scalable approaches

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, data, or a similar technical role (internships, bootcamps, and hands-on project experience count!)
  • Experience supporting applications, scripts, integrations, or automation projects preferred
  • Familiarity with TypeScript, Vue, Python, JavaScript, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, APIs/integration frameworks, or cloud automation tooling is a plus
  • Comfort with (or curiosity about) AI-assisted coding tools like Claude and Cursor
  • Experience in healthcare technology or data-intensive environments is a plus

Nice to Have

  • AWS, EKS
  • Databricks or Snowflake
  • Docker / containerized applications
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR)
  • Experience with frontend frameworks and modern UI development

Logistics

  • Requires a dedicated home office space and reliable high-speed internet
  • Occasional limited travel may be required

As a Senior Renewal Manager, Enterprise at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our largest and most strategic customers. You will own the renewal process for a defined book of high-value accounts, managing complex, multi-year, multi-product renewals from early planning through close while delivering a thoughtful, value-driven customer experience.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Ops. You will partner closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers on every account: you own the renewal, CSMs own adoption and outcomes, and AEs lead expansion. Your work ensures renewal conversations start early, are grounded in the value customers have realized, and support Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers, guiding renewal conversations with procurement, security leaders, and executives with clarity, empathy, and confidence. Strong business acumen, comfort with complex negotiation, and cross-functional leadership are essential, as each renewal carries significant revenue and requires coordination across many stakeholders.

What you’ll do:

  • Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of enterprise customers, starting renewal planning 120+ days out and driving on-time renewals through account strategy, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation.
  • Value & Business Case: Partner with CSMs to build renewal business cases grounded in adoption, CVE reduction, and engineering time saved, and present them to economic buyers and executives.
  • Commercial Execution: Structure and negotiate multi-year terms, ramps, co-terms, and pricing changes, and coordinate with Finance, Legal, customer Procurement, and Deal Desk to ensure accurate and timely contract execution.
  • Account Team Partnership: Work with AEs to align renewals with expansion opportunities, so renewal and growth motions move together rather than compete.

  • Track record of renewing large, multi-year enterprise agreements at or above value, including through competitive displacement attempts and budget pressure.
  • Proven ability to drive complex renewals with predictability and deliver against gross retention targets.
  • Experience negotiating multi-year agreements, pricing, and contract terms with enterprise procurement teams while maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Comfort engaging senior stakeholders, including security, engineering, and procurement leaders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex renewal cycles simultaneously.
  • Comfort generating quotes, preparing order forms, and maintaining CRM hygiene, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to operate with full autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead the build-out of new processes where needed.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience working with large enterprises in regulated industries such as financial services or healthcare
  • Experience in a high-growth or early-stage startup environment
  • Familiarity with security, DevSecOps, or developer-focused products
  • Passion for technology and cybersecurity

Your Mission

You will be the bridge between SPARETECH and the manufacturers whose data powers our platform. Your mission is to find, win, and maintain data partnerships that expand our catalog data, so industrial companies can find and identify the spare parts that keep their production running.

Working closely with Product and Engineering, you will turn strong manufacturer relationships into lasting data connections and make sure our most important customers find their most valuable parts covered on SPARETECH.

We offer you the opportunity to

  • Own our data partnerships:Win new manufacturer and data partners and grow lasting relationships with existing ones.
  • Drive measurable impact:Expand our catalog coverage so our largest customers find their most valuable parts on SPARETECH.
  • Shape how we get data:Work with Product and Engineering to move partners from catalog files toward direct API connections.
  • Connect partners and customers:Handle data requests and follow up on partner inquiries that support our commitments to customers.
  • Think strategically:Decide where to focus your efforts and help build a partner approach that scales.
  • Work remote-first:Work from within Germany as part of an international team.

Become a part of the team if you

  • Bring experience:Have 3 to 5 years of experience in partner management, sales, business development, customer success, after-sales, or a comparable role at a large manufacturer.
  • Know the shop floor:Understand how a production site works from the inside.
  • Understand automation technology:Know the components manufacturers sell and how they work in practice.
  • Build trust:Communicate clearly and build lasting relationships with partners.
  • Follow through:Work diligently and follow up reliably across several projects at once.
  • Are technically competent:You don't need to be an engineer, but you are confident discussing technical topics with manufacturers.
  • Speak fluently:Are fluent in German and English (C1 or higher).

You can expect

  • A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany
  • A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program
  • Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk
  • An annual training budget of 1000 EURO for your professional development
  • In Germany: A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active
  • To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies
  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

jobs.description:
Infilla is looking for a Founding Partnerships Lead to build the network of allies, funders, and distribution partners that brings Infilla warm introductions, funded deployments, and deals that direct sales couldn't reach alone.

As our first partnerships hire, you'll build Infilla's relationships with the industry associations, consultants, and philanthropies that shape how cities and counties approve housing. We already know which organizations matter in each state. Your job is to turn that playbook into trusted relationships and a steady flow of warm introductions for our sales team.

Infilla's mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We're backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who've built products at scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

  • Infilla has trusted relationships in 15 priority states with the industry associations who shape permitting, housing, or municipal government

  • 3+ philanthropic partners run innovation-grant programs that fund municipalities to adopt Infilla

  • 3+ consulting partners have signed referral or co-sell agreements, write Infilla into their client proposals, and have each brought Infilla at least one qualified opportunity

  • Every ally, partner, and funder lives in one tracker with an owner, a next step, and the pipeline or dollars it produced

WHAT YOU'VE DONE BEFORE

  • Built partnerships that produced results you can name in deals, dollars, and dates, not just MOUs signed or events attended

  • Run complex projects and many stakeholder relationships at once, in consulting, chief of staff, policy, or startup roles

  • Ended or turned down partnerships that weren't working, and can explain why the partners you kept said yes and stayed engaged

  • Earned past partners or funders who would happily work with you again

  • Made AI a core part of how you work, not an occasional assist

WHAT YOU'RE GREAT AT

Relationship building is where you must be great; commercial judgment is a close second.

  • Relationship building: You earn trust fast and keep it. You're equally comfortable with homebuilders, planners, funders, and elected officials, across red and blue states. You learn what each ally needs and deliver it before asking for anything, and you turn one intro into three.

  • Commercial judgment: You know which relationships lead to deals and money. You pick allies by whether they reach our buyers, understand referral and co-sell terms, and can present Infilla as an outcome a foundation already wants.

  • Project management and follow-through: You run dozens of relationships at once without dropping anything. Every ally has a next step and a date, and every intro you hand to sales arrives with context.

  • Clear writing: Your intro emails, partner one-pagers, and grant applications lead with the point, use real numbers, and stay calm and nonpartisan.

  • Scrappy, AI-leveraged execution: You're a team of one who ships the good-enough draft now and improves it later. You use AI daily for research, drafting, and meeting prep, and you keep the CRM current without being asked.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

  • Existing relationships in housing and land use: Homebuilders Associations, Building Industry Associations, ULI, housing nonprofits, or YIMBY groups

  • Won foundation or grant funding

  • GovTech or public-sector experience

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don't meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we're ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

  • This is a remote US-based role, with a preference for candidates in Washington, D.C. We're open to a contract-to-hire or full-time arrangement.

    • Travel is on an as-needed basis for conferences and networking events

  • You will join the GTM team and report to the CEO

  • Full-time benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays

  • We cannot sponsor visas at this time

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 1-2 weeks:

  1. Initial call with Jenny, our CEO, to assess mutual fit (20 min)

  2. Past work deep dive with Jenny to assess relationship building and commercial judgment (60 min)

  3. Network-building session with Jenny on how you'd grow Infilla's relationships in one priority state (60 min)

  4. 3 reference checks, including at least one partner or funder you've worked with

HOW WE WORK

  • Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

  • Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

  • Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

  • Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not "eventually." Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

  • Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don't wait for someone else to.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

Overview

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the general supervision of the Operations Manager, the Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for the coordination of administrative processing of disability determinations for all in and out of state contracts. This position is responsible for making strategic decisions on case assignment and for keeping cases on timeline. The Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for work flow management and training of Disability Assistants as well as performing those front line functions when necessary to maintain unit production standards. This position is the primary hub for all incoming/outgoing correspondence, disability supplements, and is the primary interface with clients, agencies, and DES staff regarding incoming and outgoing medical information, mail, transportation and records. Decisions made in this area directly impact the timeline for the disability review process, the workload of review staff, and the determination of benefits for all in and out of state agency applicants. The Lead Disability Assistant is a primary customer service interface for DES' SPMP with clients and external agencies.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Manage unit work flow, assuring the proper numbers of Disability Assistants are assigned to each task on a daily basis.
  • Train new and existing Disability Assistants in work functions and job duties.
  • Monitor customer service phone queues for adequate coverage and provide call escalation response for front line staff.
  • Monitor unit key performance indicators.
  • Act as unit Disability Liaison for agency partner inquiries and issues.
  • Track priority case requests and ensure prompt completion of work on such cases.
  • Initial review of all disability supplements for accuracy, completeness, and alerting SPMP of priority cases and of important clinical information contained in cases.
  • Make complex decisions regarding privacy matters associated with the client’s case, including determination of who DES may exchange information with regarding the client’s case, what information may be mailed, and what is required, by HIPAA, to allow conversations to take place. These decisions are conveyed to SPMP through detailed case notes and individual consultation.
  • Determine if requests for information are legally complete, communicate with agencies about cases that do not meet HIPAA requirements for protected healthcare information and consult with SPMP about decisions regarding whether to return to cases to the agencies or clients for further development.
  • Telephone contact with clinical treating sources to assure timely receipt of clinical information at the request and direction of SPMP.

Accommodations Framework Development

Process Design & Governance

Required

  • Experience conducting compliance reviews, audits, or process assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and document HR processes and operational frameworks.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multi-state employers and Puerto Rico.

Accommodations
