Who We Are Looking For

WebPT is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Strategic Finance Manager to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, this is a highly visible position that will involve regular interactions with WebPT’s CEO, CFO, senior management team, Board of Directors, and prospective investors in the process of formulating and communicating the company’s strategic plan.

The Strategic Finance Manager will lead the company’s forecasting and budgeting processes while providing financial leadership across the organization. This role will build scalable planning processes, and serve as a key business partner to functional leaders. The ideal candidate will balance technical expertise with strong leadership and communication skills, thriving in a fast-paced SaaS environment where priorities shift quickly.

WebPT is the world’s leading practice management platform for physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology healthcare providers. With a full suite of solutions encompassing a purpose-built EMR, billing and claims management, and patient acquisition and engagement, WebPT empowers clinicians to focus on what they do best: deliver life-enhancing care for their patients. WebPT’s modern SaaS-based platform gives providers the data, insights, and tools they need to profitably run and grow their practices while enhancing patient satisfaction and experience. Founded in 2006 by practicing physical therapist Heidi Jennenga, WebPT became a portfolio company of venture capital firm Battery Ventures in 2014 before the global private equity firm Warburg Pincus purchased a majority stake in the company in 2019.

What You’ll Be Doing As A Part of Our Team

  • Lead the company’s financial planning processes, including long-term strategic planning, annual budgeting, and monthly reforecasting
  • Own and continuously enhance financial models across revenue, cash flow, and operating expense, ensuring scalability as the business grows
  • Partner with business leaders across Sales, R&D, and G&A to provide actionable insights that drive growth and margin expansion
  • Deliver presentations and analysis for executives, investors, and the Board of Directors, highlighting key financial trends and strategic implications
  • Drive analysis of SaaS metrics and unit economics, including ARR growth, retention, and sales efficiency
  • Support capital structure planning and scenario modeling, enabling effective decision-making around investment opportunities and resource allocation
  • Lead the FP&A team’s role in the monthly close process, ensuring accurate reporting and timely variance analysis
  • Champion process improvements, automation, and systems enhancements to increase FP&A efficiency and scalability
  • Conduct ad hoc financial analyses, including unit economics, pricing, cash conversion, public comp benchmarking, and capital structure alternatives to improve business visibility and decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather relevant data and insights for financial analyses

What You Should Have to Qualify

  • 5–7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance, with exposure to the SaaS industry
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build and troubleshoot complex and performant models with little to no direction
  • Deep understanding of SaaS metrics and drivers, as well as strong knowledge of financial statements and GAAP principles
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to distill complex financial information into clear insights for senior leadership and external stakeholders
  • Proactive, strategic thinker who can balance detail orientation with a broader business perspective

Ideally, You Would Also Have These

  • Proficiency with with financial systems, including ERPs (Sage Intacct), CRMs (Salesforce), and planning & budgeting software (Planful)
  • Data and analytics expertise, including ability to run SQL queries and create custom visualizations in tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, and others

Culture is at our Core

  • Service: Create Raving Fans
  • Accountability: F Up; Own Up
  • Attitude: Possess True Grit
  • Personality: Be Minty
  • Work Ethic: Be Rock Solid
  • Community Outreach: Give Back
  • Health and Wellness: Live Better
  • Resource Efficiency: Do Más With Menos

Here, we work hard—but we have lots of fun doing it. We believe in equal opportunity for all, autonomy, trailblazing, and always doing right by our Members. Most importantly, though, we believe in empowering rehab therapy professionals to achieve greatness in practice. So, if you’re a can-do kinda person who loves to help Members win and enjoys working from just about anywhere—then you’ll fit right in. We’ve got big plans, but we can’t achieve them without you. Join us, and let’s achieve greatness.

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are seeking a Lead Specialist, Applied AI Systems Engineer, to design, build, and continuously improve the intelligent systems that support Pearson’s work developing the next generation of K–12 assessment and learning.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Lead Specialist, Applied AI Systems Engineer, to design, build, and continuously improve the intelligent systems that support Pearson’s work developing the next generation of K–12 assessment and learning.

This role sits within the Measurement & Learning team and operates at the intersection of Content Development, Learning Science, Technology, AI Science, and Psychometrics, partnering closely with software engineers and the AI Data & Knowledge Architect to turn assessment and measurement expertise into testable AI capabilities within our assessment authoring system, which supports formative and summative assessment for Pearson and its partners.

This hands-on role joins in the early phases of this work, improving and extending complete AI systems built on a shared knowledge foundation, rather than focusing on prompts or chatbots. The work spans predictive machine learning, statistical methods, retrieval, graph-based approaches, generative and agentic AI, and deterministic software, chosen for reliability rather than novelty.

We are particularly interested in innovators who have built AI or machine-learning systems whose outputs must be rigorously evaluated against ground truth, expert judgment, or reliable evidence, such as scientific, healthcare, financial, cybersecurity, legal, or assessment applications. Candidates whose experience is mainly in conversational or customer-service AI should also show substantial experience evaluating systems against defined performance standards. Experience in education, learning, or assessment is strongly preferred when it involves the systems beneath products, such as domain and skill models, learner models, standards and competency frameworks as structured data, or adaptive and recommendation engines, rather than standalone tutoring, chatbot, or content-generation applications.

End-to-End AI Systems Design

  • Design complete, modular AI systems spanning knowledge and data inputs, retrieval, models, agents, tools, deterministic services, human review, evaluation, and integration
  • Break complex problems into the right combination of predictive ML, statistical methods, generative models, retrieval, graph reasoning, deterministic software, and human decision points
  • Build working systems and reference implementations, and partner with software engineers to bring them into the assessment authoring system
  • Design architectures that can evolve as models, data, domain knowledge, and evaluation evidence change

Agentic & Knowledge-Grounded AI

  • Design and implement agentic and multi-step workflows using models, tools, retrieval, state, structured outputs, and human decision points
  • Build knowledge-grounded systems that use graph, semantic, vector, and hybrid retrieval as appropriate
  • Co-design knowledge and graph architecture with the AI Data & Knowledge Architect, contributing substantively rather than treating the knowledge layer as a black box
  • Develop AI capabilities for content creation and revision, verification, alignment across frameworks, guidance, and analytic insights

Evaluation-Driven Development

  • Make evaluation part of how systems are built, not a final step
  • Build and maintain evaluation benches, including expert-adjudicated datasets, challenge sets, regression suites, and protected holdout data
  • Partner with psychometricians and content experts to turn domain expectations into measurable criteria
  • Analyze failure modes, critical errors, and performance across meaningful data and task slices, not only aggregate metrics
  • Monitor deployed systems for drift and emerging failures, and use findings to drive improvement

Machine Learning, Model Adaptation & Data

  • Develop predictive models, classifiers, and ranking methods where they outperform generative AI
  • Evaluate tradeoffs among prompting, retrieval, structured knowledge, model selection, and model adaptation, without locking the architecture to a single provider
  • Apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning and other adaptation methods when evaluation evidence shows they add value
  • Turn expert judgments and adjudicated examples into versioned evaluation and training assets, keeping training data strictly separate from protected evaluation data
  • Design synthetic-data approaches with rigorous quality controls, never treating generated data as ground truth by default

Innovation, Judgment & Responsible AI

  • Work with a high degree of autonomy on problems that have no established solutions
  • Prototype quickly, test assumptions empirically, and pivot when evidence warrants
  • Build AI that is accurate, transparent in its reasoning, auditable, and designed to support rather than supplant human expertise
  • Uphold responsible AI and data practices, including privacy, security, fairness, and appropriate use of student and content data

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Technology teams and software engineers to integrate AI capabilities into the assessment authoring system
  • Collaborate with AI Science colleagues and the AI Data & Knowledge Architect on shared architecture and methods
  • Work with psychometricians and learning scientists to translate measurement and learning requirements into evaluation criteria
  • Partner with content development teams to understand workflows, quality requirements, edge cases, and human-review needs
  • Communicate findings, tradeoffs, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience designing and building complete AI or machine-learning systems end to end, not only isolated models or prompts
  • Strong breadth across predictive ML, statistical learning, and LLM-based, agentic, and retrieval-grounded systems, with judgment about when each fits
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating probabilistic systems against ground truth or expert judgment, including evaluation datasets, error analysis, and regression testing
  • Experience with knowledge graphs and knowledge-grounded AI sufficient to contribute to architecture decisions
  • Strong Python proficiency, and experience with TypeScript or the ability to become productive quickly in a TypeScript codebase
  • Track record of innovating beyond established practice, with sound technical judgment and high autonomy
  • Ability to collaborate closely with engineers and domain experts, translating expertise into requirements and evaluation criteria

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building the knowledge and inference layers of education, learning, or assessment systems, such as skill or competency graphs, learner or domain models, standards alignment engines, adaptive or recommendation logic, or the inference behind learner insight reporting
  • Experience building AI or ML systems in evidence-sensitive domains such as scientific, healthcare, financial, legal, or assessment applications
  • Hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning or other model-adaptation methods
  • Experience designing, filtering, and validating synthetic data for evaluation or model improvement
  • Experience building expert-annotated datasets, adjudication protocols, or evaluation platforms
  • Experience with graph-grounded agents, hybrid retrieval, or other knowledge-intensive AI applications
  • Familiarity with ontologies, semantic models, or hybrid neural-symbolic architectures
  • Experience with calibration, uncertainty estimation, drift detection, or model monitoring
  • Experience with TypeScript, AWS, PostgreSQL, and graph data stores; our environment also uses Go, Python, and ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow
  • Familiarity with educational measurement, psychometrics, or learning science

Design Philosophy

  • Complete systems over isolated models
  • Evaluation as part of engineering, not an afterthought
  • Innovation at the edge of current practice, grounded in evidence
  • Transparent, auditable, and accurate AI
  • AI that supports rather than supplants human expertise
  • The right method for the problem, not the newest one

Why This Role Matters

This role will build the intelligent core of an industry-defining assessment system. The goal is not convincing AI output but systems whose quality can be measured, explained, and continuously improved. By inventing new approaches and proving they work, this engineer will help define what intelligent formative and summative assessment can become.

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by factors including skill set, experience, and location.

The full-time salary range for this role is $140,000 – $160,000. This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. Information on benefits can be found here.

Applications will be accepted through 20th November 2026. This window may be extended depending on business needs.

Apply today and imagine the impact you can make.

What are your "nice to have" technical competencies?

  • Experience designing or operating large-scale build infrastructure artifact registries, distributed build caches, hermetic build systems (e.g., Bazel), or developer platform tooling

jobs.description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

This is a pro bono volunteer position.

Join us in making a difference and empowering middle school kids in their STEM journey! Historically, JerseySTEM has operated with a Business-to-Business (B2B) relationship model with a few hundred stakeholders. As we scale our impact, we are building a higher-volume, Business-to-Consumer (B2C) growth engine capable of capturing, segmenting, and nurturing thousands of individual leads across three core audiences: College Students, Individual Donors, and Prospective Pro-bono Contributors.

We are looking for a "been-there, done-that" B2C marketer or growth strategist who knows how to build and run the entire lead lifecycle: Social Media/Web Outreach → Frictionless Lead Capture → Automated Nurturing → Lead Development → Conversion. You will partner directly with our leadership and technology teams—who manage our Salesforce, Web2Lead, Discord, and iCIMS infrastructure—to design the campaigns, messaging, and funnels that turn passive browsers into active contributors.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Depending on your background and focus area, you will lead and execute initiatives across three key growth verticals:

1. Full-Lifecycle Funnel & Lead Nurturing Architecture

  • Design and manage end-to-end B2C conversion funnels that move prospects smoothly from initial awareness to committed action.

  • Partner with our Tech and Operations teams to optimize lead capture (e.g., tiered QR codes, Salesforce Web2Lead forms, and community invites) so zero leads are lost across disconnected lists.

  • Build and manage automated drip nurturing campaigns (via email, SMS, and community platforms) tailored to where a prospect sits in the funnel.

  • Track conversion rates and drop-off points across channels, using data to continuously refine messaging and boost completion rates.

2. College Student Engagement (COLE)

  • Execute multi-channel digital and campus outreach campaigns to recruit college students as STEM program instructors and mentors.

  • Meet students where they are by combining peer-to-peer platforms (Discord, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn) with campus-specific channels (student clubs, career centers, and QR-code event activations).

  • Create low-barrier entry funnels (such as joining a campus Discord server or filling out a quick interest form) and nurture curious students into completed pro-bono Program Instructor applications.

3. Individual Donor Lead Generation (DEVT)

  • Transition JerseySTEM from a passive "Donate button" approach to active, campaign-driven individual fundraising.

  • Develop storytelling, social media, and digital outreach campaigns that attract prospective individual donors and capture their contact information.

  • Build donor-nurturing journeys that educate prospects on our impact, cultivate long-term engagement, and convert warm leads into recurring or one-time financial supporters.

4. Prospective pro-bono Member Recruiting (HUCA)

  • Move beyond passive job postings ("post and pray") to proactive talent marketing campaigns that attract skilled professionals and retirees.

  • Segment prospective members by professional background (e.g., Tech, Operations, Curriculum, Marketing) and run targeted outreach campaigns across LinkedIn and professional networks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Innovation Lab
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced and builder-minded Senior Product Manager to help Coforma’s Innovation Lab turn early-stage ideas into products people love to use.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and builder-minded Senior Product Manager to help Coforma’s Innovation Lab turn early-stage ideas into products people love to use.

The ideal candidate has at least 7 years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of taking technical SaaS products from a rough hypothesis to validated product-market fit in a cross-functional, agile environment. To be successful, this person needs a strong product strategy mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to make confident decisions with incomplete information. The role requires excellent communication, collaboration, leadership, and technical product skills. It is a customer-facing role: you will translate what users and the market tell you into focused bets, clear experiments, and product features.
If you want to build new products from the ground up, and care as much about whether a market exists as what to ship, Coforma is a great place for you.
$150,235 to $169,146 Annual Salary + Benefits + Growth Potential
Placement within this range will be based on the competency level of the candidate. An offer will be made at one of the following tiers:
  • Tier 1 — $150,235.80: Meets stated qualification and experience requirements. May need guidance and training beyond onboarding to perform the more complex functions of the role.
  • Tier 2 — $159,691.20: Experienced and fully competent. Will be able to independently perform key responsibilities of the role once onboarding is completed.
  • Tier 3 — $169,146.60: Highly experienced and can perform all responsibilities of the role at a higher level than expected once onboarding is completed.
To honor our company-wide equitable pay system, the posted salary range and corresponding tier salaries are non-negotiable.
This is a US-based remote position open to applicants in the states listed below. Some travel will be required.
To ensure we remain compliant with all state, county, and local employment and tax regulations, applicants must currently reside in one of the following states to be considered for employment with Coforma. This list will be updated periodically as our PeopleOps team works to open up hiring in additional states.
  • Arizona
  • California
  • District of Columbia
  • Florida
  • Georgia
  • Idaho
  • Illinois
  • Maryland
  • Massachusetts
  • Montana
  • Nevada
  • New Jersey
  • New York
  • North Carolina
  • Oregon
  • South Carolina
  • Tennessee
  • Texas
  • Virginia
  • Washington
  • Wisconsin

Where You'll Work:

You will join Coforma's Innovation Lab and report to the Head of Innovation. You will support multiple products at the same time, each at a different stage, from early discovery and concept validation to a first paying customer and scaling what works. Success is measured by evidence of product-market fit, such as customer demand, retention, revenue traction, and learning velocity, rather than by delivery of a fixed scope.
Occasionally, you will help prepare pitches and proposals for federal agencies where an Innovation Lab product fits a public-sector need. Federal work is the exception, not the default, but Coforma's deep experience in digital delivery for government agencies is an advantage you can draw on.


What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities):
  • Set product strategy and understand the market: Define and refine the problem, target customer, value proposition, and business model for each product. Research market size, segments, competitors, pricing, and buying behavior to shape positioning and go-to-market hypotheses. Articulate a clear point of view on why it can (or can't) win.
  • Drive toward product-market fit: Design and run experiments, customer interviews, pilots, and prototypes to test the riskiest assumptions first. Define the signals that mean a product should be scaled, pivoted, or stopped, and make that call with the Head of Innovation.
  • Develop and maintain roadmaps: Keep outcome-based roadmaps for each product that reflect its stage, prioritize the most important learning and customer value, and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.
  • Co-build with design and engineering: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and designers to prototype, iterate, and ship, not just define requirements and manage a backlog. Make informed technical trade-offs and help deliver products that meet expectations for availability, security, scale, and performance.
  • Take products to market and build investment support: Own pricing, packaging, launches, early customer acquisition, and partnerships in collaboration with marketing, sales, and leadership. Develop business cases, pitch to internal sponsors and venture capital investors, and pursue funding for promising products.
  • Track product performance: Define and monitor the metrics that matter at each stage, such as activation, retention, conversion, and revenue, and use data to make decisions.
  • Use AI to build and learn faster: Use AI-assisted coding tools to turn ideas into functional prototypes yourself, test them with customers, and co-develop product features with engineers. Apply AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Foster an inclusive environment: Ensure team members are empowered to do their best work and feel a strong sense of ownership and belonging.
  • Mentor and share what you learn: Coach teammates and peers on product practice, and share learnings across the Lab and the rest of Coforma.

Your First 30 Days:In your first 30 days, you’ll gain an understanding of each product in the Lab portfolio, what has been learned about its customers so far, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are. By day 30, you’ll have built trust with the Head of Innovation and the teams you will work with.
  • Get oriented: Complete new hire orientation and meet with the Head of Innovation to agree on expectations, decision rights, and how you will share progress with various audiences and stakeholders.
  • Immerse yourself in the portfolio: For each product or concept, review the current hypothesis, customer research, prototypes, roadmap, and metrics. Note its stage and what evidence exists for demand.
  • Meet the people: Meet the designers, engineers, and business partners on each product, and the Coforma leaders who sponsor or advise Lab work.
  • Talk to customers: Join or run a few customer conversations for our newest product to hear the problem in customers' own words.
  • Learn the market: Review what the team already knows about target segments, competitors, and pricing for each product, and note the biggest gaps.
  • Set up your own tools: Get set up with the AI-assisted coding and prototyping tools the Lab uses, and ship one small prototype or improvement so you understand the team's build workflow.
  • Write a first read-out: Share a short, candid assessment with the Head of Innovation: the stage of each product, the riskiest assumption in each, and a proposed order of priority for your time.

After 60 Days:By day 60, you’ll be making real product decisions and running experiments that produce evidence. The Head of Innovation should be able to see how you think and where you need support.
  • Propose a strategy for each product: Write a one-page strategy per product covering the problem, target customer, value proposition, business model, and the riskiest assumptions. Review each with the Head of Innovation.
  • Run the first experiments: Design and launch at least one experiment for our top products, such as customer interviews, a landing page test, a pilot, or a prototype test, with a clear success signal agreed in advance.
  • Build outcome-based roadmaps: Replace feature lists with roadmaps organized around what each product needs to learn next, and share them with the teams and sponsors. Align with existing research plans and learning objectives.
  • Define the metrics: Agree on the two or three metrics that matter for each product at its current stage, such as activation, retention, conversion, or revenue, and set up a way to track them (or revise what’s already in place).
  • Co-build with design and engineering: Prototype alongside engineers and designers, using AI-assisted tools to turn ideas into testable prototypes, and make the first technical tradeoff calls on your own.
  • Start the market work: Draft target-customer, competitor, and pricing hypotheses for the product closest to launch, and begin testing them with prospects.
  • Establish a rhythm: Set up a regular cadence for product reviews and for updates to the Head of Innovation.

After 90 Days:By day 90, you’ll own product strategy and day-to-day product decisions across the Lab portfolio and will be making recommendations on where the Lab should invest.
  • Make scale, pivot, or stop recommendations: Bring the Head of Innovation an evidence-based recommendation for each product, using the signals you defined, and act on the decisions.
  • Take products to market: For our newest product, own the pricing and packaging proposal, the early-customer plan, and any partnership conversations, working with marketing, sales, and leadership.
  • Collaborate on the investment case: Work with the Head of Innovation to draft a business case for at least one promising product that could be used with internal sponsors or outside investors.
  • Be ready for federal opportunities: Where a Lab product fits a public-sector need, prepare a pitch outline or short proposal with Coforma's government team, keeping it to a small share of your time.
  • Share what you learn: Coach teammates on experiment design and product strategy, and share a short write-up of what the first 90 days taught you about the portfolio and the Lab's process.
  • Take full ownership: Assume full responsibility and accountability for the outcomes of the role.

Who You Are and What You Know (Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Requirements):

  • A minimum of 7 years of professional experience in a Product Management role with meaningful experience on early-stage, 0-to-1 products or new ventures and practical use of AI-assisted development tools strongly preferred.
  • A track record of taking products from idea to market, validating demand, winning early customers, and finding product-market fit.
  • Strong product strategy skills, including market analysis, positioning, and pricing or business-model thinking in commercial markets, and the ability to articulate a vision, explain the reasoning behind a bet to executives, customers, and engineers, and pitch it to internal sponsors or venture capital investors.
  • Experience performing customer research, eliciting insight from diverse groups, and turning it into clear, actionable requirements and experiments.
  • Experience taking products from concept to launch, including building prototypes and collaborating directly with engineers on implementation.
  • Comfort managing several products at different stages at once, and prioritizing ruthlessly among them.
  • Prior experience in a client-facing consulting, startup, or venture-building role.
  • Full-time resident of the contiguous United States (must be legally authorized to work in the US now and in the future without sponsorship).
  • Must be able to successfully pass any background and/or security checks related to the role.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:
  • Experience launching and growing a commercial software product, including pricing, packaging, and early customer acquisition.
  • Experience in a rapidly growing small company, startup, or venture studio.
  • Familiarity with B2B or B2B2C markets such as health, fintech, civic tech, or other regulated spaces.
  • Experience building or pitching products for federal agencies.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security practices, including in health IT.
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with accessibility requirements.

Other:

  • Internet: Will prioritize and maintain access to strong, reliable internet for the remote nature of our work, except when on vacation or holiday.
  • Security: Will keep the highest security practices to ensure privacy and security of Coforma and client information, given the nature of our work, even when on vacation.
  • Travel Flexibility: On request and with advance notice, will attend in-person events such as meetings, workshops, and trainings as assigned for projects that require it.
  • Brand Representation: Will represent Coforma professionally and sincerely, modeling our Company Values in all interactions.

The company's mission is Unlocking Video for Business: empowering teams to deploy data-rich video programs that drive valuable outcomes. Our customers have achieved breakthrough results from personalized video including:

  • Healthcare: Member health engagement — personalized video communications driving participation in wellness programs, preventive care, and chronic condition management. Outcomes: 271% increase in response rates, 800% increase in digital engagement, 2x improvement in customer health scores.
  • Financial Services: Financial literacy and vesting education — explaining vesting schedules, catch-up contributions, and investment basics. Outcomes: 3x plan enrollment rates vs. traditional communications, 2x deferral increases.
  • Banking: Digital banking adoption — video education driving enrollment in online banking, mobile app, eStatements, and bill pay. Outcomes: 12–15% increase in digital enrollment.

Results like these are made possible by close partnership between SundaySky's customers and our Customer Success team. In this role, you'll work with some of our largest enterprise customers in health plans, financial services and insurance. You'll help them launch successful programs that are attributable to clear and defensible business value. The ideal candidate has a SaaS Customer Success background with experience defining and executing on strategic plans and working with strategic enterprise customers to repeatedly deliver measurable value in a high touch motion.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic consultant to enterprise customers, helping them design, deliver, and measure personalized video programs.
  • Build relationships across every level of the account: day-to-day users, program owners, and executive sponsors in the business unit.
  • Run the full lifecycle for new enterprise customers, from kickoff and onboarding through the first proof of value and on to renewal.
  • Find and launch the next use case in each account by bringing in new teams and new customer journeys.
  • Develop deep platform expertise and apply it to help each customer reach their goals.
  • Build the value case for each renewal from achieved and measured business outcomes such as renewal rates, enrollment, and call deflection, rather than from platform usage statistics.
  • Own renewals and add-ons for your book against a renewal quota. Keep your forecast current with confidence levels, start renewal planning 120 days out, and partner with Account Directors on larger expansion opportunities.
  • Partner with the product team to share market feedback to aid the development and prioritization of the roadmap.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years in customer success or account management, including 3 or more years managing enterprise accounts.
  • You've led executive business reviews with VP and C-level sponsors, built mutual success plans with them, and walked them through outcome data.
  • You prove value by measuring outcomes against a baseline or a comparison, not by reporting usage or adoption. You've designed A/B tests, holdout comparisons, or attribution methods that tie performance to business outcomes. We teach our specific approach in onboarding.
  • You've carried an individual renewal quota as a number in your own comp plan, not a target shared across a team. Experience carrying an upsell or add-on quota is a plus.
  • You've taken enterprise renewals through complex procurement, security reviews, and competitive RFPs.
  • You've worked with enterprise customers in regulated industries such as health plans, retirement and wealth management, insurance, or banking, and you understand how legal and compliance review shape what ships and when.

Nice to have

Customer Success experience at a creative software company (video, design, media/ads). Our customers build their videos using our creative tools, and you'll train them on it and answer their how-to questions.

Familiarity with video distribution and measurement including embeds, viewership metrics, and video engagement optimization (or a willingness to learn).

Compensation: $110,000–$130,000 plus variable compensation.

SundaySky is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven Safety AI is building the enterprise learning intelligence layer for safety. Co-founded with The AES Corporation and AI Fund, the venture studio founded by Andrew Ng, Haven helps high-risk organizations learn faster from what goes wrong so they can prevent what comes next.

Haven works alongside existing EHS enterprise systems to improve how organizations investigate, assess, and learn from incidents. INVESTIGATE guides evidence synthesis, timeline development, multi-threaded causal analysis, and corrective actions. ASSURE continuously reviews completed investigations for evidence quality, causal coverage, guideline adherence, and CAPA strength. LEARN reasons across incident history to surface recurring control failures, repeated corrective-action patterns, CAPA debt, and emerging signals.

The platform combines current incident evidence, company knowledge, historical cases, and an industry knowledge graph. A coordinated team of specialized AI agents examines evidence, controls, engineering factors, procedures, regulations, training, and organizational history, then produces one traceable assessment for human review. Customers have reported an 80% reduction in root cause analysis labor time using Haven.

About the Role:

You will work on the AI and LLM engineering layer that connects Haven’s evidence base and knowledge graph to the product experiences investigators and safety leaders use. This is a build-and-operate role reporting to the CTO. You will design the reasoning, ship it, instrument it, and improve it using production evidence.

The work is technically demanding and operationally consequential. Haven serves enterprise customers in regulated, safety-critical industries through multi-tenant and dedicated deployments. A plausible answer and a correct answer can look the same until someone acts on it, so precision, traceability, evaluation, and human oversight are core product requirements.

Haven Safety is a VC-backed pre-seed venture. This role will be a important member of the founding team and will require wearing multiple hats. This role is based in the US and relocation will not be considered.

What You Will Own:

    • Production reasoning systems. Build and operate multi-step LLM pipelines that coordinate model calls, tool calls, graph queries, retrieval, quality gates, and specialist-agent handoffs.
    • Agent orchestration. Extend Haven’s coordinated agent team and the orchestration layer that carries an incident from evidence through analysis, review, and enterprise learning.
    • Grounding and retrieval. Design the context layer across Neo4j graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid retrieval so every model call receives the right evidence and organizational knowledge.
    • Evaluation. Build datasets, scoring, regression suites, model comparisons, human-label loops, and per-stage quality attribution for extraction and reasoning tasks.
    • Production AI operations. Implement tracing, tool-call audits, cost and latency monitoring, failure handling, and quality dashboards; catch loops, hallucinations, and silent drift before customers do.
    • Technical direction. Select models by task across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google; partner with product and knowledge engineering; and help shape the AI roadmap.

Requirements For the Role Include:

    • Production LLM systems. AI or ML engineering, including shipping LLM systems that real users depend on.
    • Agentic workflows. Hands-on experience building and debugging multi-step, tool-calling workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent framework.
    • Evaluation discipline. A repeatable approach to LLM evaluation, including representative datasets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge techniques, or human review loops.
    • Retrieval judgment. Experience assembling context for LLMs and a clear point of view on what to retrieve, how much, and why.
    • Production ownership. A track record of owning systems from deployment through monitoring and incident response, including a strong story about a failure or regression you diagnosed and fixed.
    • Model judgment. Comfort working across model providers and explaining tradeoffs in quality, latency, cost, context, and operational risk.
    • Graph reasoning. Comfort with Neo4j and Cypher, or a comparable graph store, and the ability to ramp quickly on graph data modeling. Strongly preferred.
    • Strong Python. Production habits around FastAPI, asynchronous services, testing, observability, and maintainable interfaces are required.

Nice To Haves Include:

    • Deep graph experience. Cypher fluency, schema evolution, MERGE patterns, embeddings, and operating a live knowledge graph.
    • Enterprise AI security. Prompt-injection awareness, context-leak prevention, tenant isolation, role-based access, and policy-layer separation.
    • Azure and hybrid search. Experience running production AI services in Azure and using Azure AI Search, Pinecone, MongoDB Atlas, pgvector, Elasticsearch, or a similar platform.
    • B2B Enterprise SaaS. Prior experience operating in an enterprise-level environment is strongly preferred.

Why Join Haven Safety:

    • Meaningful reasoning problems. Work across evidence, causal pathways, controls, organizational history, and corrective actions in a domain where correctness matters.
    • An evaluation-first culture. Make quality measurable, observable, and improvable instead of relying on demos or intuition.
    • Visible customer impact. Build for safety teams in energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction, and manufacturing, with direct feedback from the people using the output.
    • Small team, high ownership. Work closely with the CTO, product, and knowledge engineering, make consequential technical decisions, and see your work reach customers quickly.
Sponsorship will not be provided for this role. Please no agency inquiries!

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The opportunity: Head of [Product] Design

Tilt is looking for a Head of [Product] Design — an existing team of 6 designers and 1 researcher embedded across the pods building Cash Advance, Credit Card, Thrive, and the rest of our everyday money products. You'll report directly to the Head of Product and own the craft, quality, and user and business impact of design across everything our users touch.

The foundations are in place: a recent rebrand, an evolved design system, and embedded, strong designers.

What hasn't been built yet is a design practice that consistently shapes what we build, not just how it looks, and is known across the enterprise.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead the design function: Set the vision, standards, and strategy for product design at Tilt in a manner that fits Tilt’s strategic objectives. Set the bar for craft and hold it across every surface we ship.

  • Operate with urgency for our users: Set ambitious timelines, but know when to afford space. We learn best from product in customers’ hands, and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • Grow the team’s impact: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 6 product designers and 1 researcher — and own hiring as we scale. Build the career paths, deliver regular feedback, and rituals that builds stronger designers and ensures top performers stay. Celebrate and showcase work at company-wide rituals, not just among the Design team.

  • Move design upstream: Push design into problem definition and roadmap-setting, not just execution. Partner with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional leadership to build better operating systems.

  • Champion the user for the enterprise: Be the vocal, evidence-based advocate for the people who use our products. Bring research, verbatims, and influence into decisions across credit, growth, engineering, and more.

  • Own how we learn: Build Tilt's research practice — today getting started with our first researcher — into a durable capability that gets the team real signal on real users.

  • Scale the design system: Steward the Tilt Design System — from illustrations, type, color, copy, and more — as products in their own right, so a growing multi-product surface stays coherent.

  • Put agents to work: Hold an informed point of view on where AI genuinely improves design work, and turn it into practice rather than pilots. Own automation efforts to unleash the Design & broader delivery team on highest value work.

  • Partner with Creative: Work closely with Marketing's Creative team so product experience and brand expression reinforce each other — make the seam invisible between the disciplines.

Why you're a great fit

  • Depth in consumer product design: 8+ years designing and shipping consumer-facing mobile products, ideally in fintech or another domain with real complexity sitting behind a simple surface.

  • Proven people leadership: 5+ years managing designers, with a track record of building teams, raising the bar on craft, and developing people into stronger designers than you found them.

  • A strategic partner, not a service provider: You've operated at the leadership table — shaping roadmap and strategy alongside Product and Engineering peers, not receiving requirements from them. You’re interested in the business mechanics and financial impact you’ll have, in addition to our user.

  • A portfolio with consequences: Work that shows craft and outcome. You can walk through the user problem, the decisions you made, and what changed in the business.

  • Evidence-driven, but comfortable in ambiguity: You use research and data to sharpen design judgment rather than substitute for it, and you know how to get signal when there's no dedicated research team yet.

  • Clear at the exec level: You can make a design argument to a CEO or a credit lead without translating it into design jargon first.

  • Fluent in modern tooling: Deep in Figma, and genuinely curious about where AI belongs in a design workflow.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial recruiter call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring manager interview: A deeper discussion about your background and approach to solving challenges.

  3. Skills panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach through real-world scenarios.

  4. Portfolio and leadership review: Walk the team through work you've led and how you build design organisations.

  5. Leadership conversation: A conversation with a leader to discuss our mission and how you could contribute to it (and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way).

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.description:
As vCluster Labs’ Staff Software Engineer, you will operate as a specialized technical leader, working directly with the CTO to explore new frontiers in our technology. You will bridge the gap between rapid prototyping, architectural research, and product evolution, taking on responsibilities that go far beyond standard coding to shape the future of our Kubernetes virtualization platform.

As a Staff Software Engineer, your role will include:

  • Rapid Prototyping & Innovation: Act as a specialized engineer who identifies interesting product opportunities, researches solutions, and quickly builds prototypes to validate if they work. You will report back on feasibility and guide the technical direction based on your findings.

  • Strategic Technical Leadership: Take ownership of responsibilities beyond coding, including managing complex technical projects, writing technical abstracts, and helping the wider engineering team navigate difficult challenges.

  • Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Work directly with the CTO and operate outside the traditional engineering organization boundaries to solve high-level problems and ideate on new product capabilities.

  • System Mastery & Evolution: Develop a deep understanding of our existing system while maintaining the agility to learn new things quickly. You will be responsible for integrating new technologies into our stack efficiently.

  • Customer & External Engagement: While primarily technical, this role includes customer-facing elements. You will occasionally engage with users to understand their deep technical needs and translate those into engineering solutions.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Deep Kubernetes & GoLang Expertise: You possess 3+ years of deep technical experience with Kubernetes and GoLang. You are comfortable diving into the internals of cloud-native infrastructure.

  • High Autonomy: You are a self-starter who can work on your own, figure out complex issues without hand-holding, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to manage your own time and priorities.

  • Beyond the Code: You have experience that extends beyond just writing software. You understand the broader picture of product development, project management, and technical communication.

  • Rapid Learning Agility: You are quick to prototype and even quicker to learn. You enjoy the challenge of picking up new tools, languages, or architectural concepts on the fly to solve immediate problems.

Bonus points for:

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native containers and the broader ecosystem.

  • Startup experience where you had significant technical influence and helped shape the product.

  • Experience writing technical content, such as abstracts, white papers, or blog posts.

  • Background in Platform Engineering or experience building internal developer platforms (IDPs).

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup striving to be the leading force in enabling platform engineers. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (+10k GitHub stars). Open source is part of our DNA.

The adoption of our commercial product based on vCluster has grown extremely fast (multi-million dollar revenue) and our customer base includes some of the biggest companies in the world, including 6 Global Fortune 500 companies as well as some of the fastest-growing tech unicorns and AI clouds (neoclouds).

Why join vCluster Labs?

Since we are a fast-moving startup, you will not be number 14,589 in our company but rather become an essential part of our team right from the start:

  • Fast Application Process: We will typically get back to you within a week. No need to polish your resume for us. Just send us some links (e.g. LinkedIn, etc.), answer a few questions about your previous experiences, and hop on a quick Zoom call with one of our team members to see if you’re a good fit. We will respond quickly and make hiring decisions within days rather than months.

  • Open-Minded Work Environment: You can always speak your mind - no company politics or unnecessary formalities. We are operating in a lean, honest, and efficient way and we are looking for different perspectives, constructive feedback and creative, motivated people who want to make a difference.

  • Grow With The Company: We are a small company right now but we are growing incredibly fast because we work on something that has a lot of value to engineering teams in large enterprises. Joining vCluster Labs early will give you the chance to advance much faster to the next step on the career ladder than in any larger company.

  • Responsibility From Day 1: You will see right from the start that your work will immediately have an impact in our company and you can shape the future of this company together with the rest of our team.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €75K - €145K

jobs.excerpt: 👋 Welcome to Hi Rasmus! At Hi Rasmus, people are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
👋 Welcome to Hi Rasmus!

At Hi Rasmus, people are at the heart of everything we do. Whether you're just joining us or have been part of our journey, we’re excited to have you on board!

We’re on a mission to make evidence-based autism care accessible to families everywhere. 🌍 Families shouldn’t have to uproot their lives to access support—that’s why we break down barriers while keeping the human touch at the center of our work. Our goal? To positively impact the lives of 1 million children with autism.

Rooted in a culture that values trust, collaboration, and balance, we foster a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered.

🎯 Our Core Values

  • Innovation 🧠 – We embrace creativity and seek better solutions.
  • Integrity ⚖️ – Honesty and trust guide everything we do.
  • Collaboration 🤝 – Together, we achieve more.
  • Growth 🌱 – We’re committed to personal and professional development.
  • Empathy ❤️ – We prioritize understanding and human connection.

🚀 What It’s Like to Work Here

At Hi Rasmus, we trust our team to do great work, their way. Flexibility, autonomy, and balance are key—we know that when life and work fit together, everyone thrives. 🏡✨
  • Flat structure, open doors – Every voice matters. Collaboration and shared decision-making drive us forward.
  • Balance is a priority – Recharge, make time for what matters, and do your best work in a way that works for you.
  • Real impact, real growth – Be part of a team making a difference for families worldwide, while growing your skills along the way.

Join us in shaping a future where exceptional autism care is within reach for all. 💡💙

📢 About the Role

The Head of Marketing will have end-to-end accountability for the marketing function at Hi Rasmus and serve as a close partner to the Chief Commercial Officer, CEO, Product, Clinical, Customer Success, and Sales teams.

This is a role for a leader who is equally comfortable developing the company narrative, reviewing a campaign creative, building an enterprise ABM strategy, shaping a product launch, working with PR, and sitting with Sales to understand why a deal is being won or lost.
You will be responsible for building a marketing organization that combines exceptional storytelling with measurable commercial impact.

We are looking for someone who understands that brand and growth are not separate disciplines. The strongest marketing makes people understand why a company matters and gives the right buyers a reason to act.

📍 Location: Fully remote - US
💼 Department: Marketing
🤝 Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer & Advocate for 1 Million Kids
⏳ Job Type: Full-time; Exempt
💰 Compensation: Range of $160,000 to $175,000 annually
🕜 Working Hours: Flexible within North American time zones

📌 What You’ll Own

Brand, Storytelling & Market Positioning

  • Own and evolve the Hi Rasmus brand, narrative, positioning, and voice.
  • Translate our mission, product differentiation, customer impact, and clinical vision into compelling stories for the market.
  • Ensure consistency and quality across every external touchpoint, including website, campaigns, events, press, social, sales materials, video, and executive communications.
  • Build a clear market narrative around why Hi Rasmus is different and where the autism care technology landscape is headed.
  • Maintain an exceptionally high bar for creative quality, messaging, and brand execution.

Growth, Demand Generation & Pipeline

  • Build a marketing strategy directly connected to company growth and revenue goals.
  • Partner closely with Sales and RevOps to develop measurable pipeline-generation programs.
  • Build and scale enterprise-focused account-based marketing strategies.
  • Develop integrated campaigns across paid, organic, content, events, partnerships, outbound, and community.
  • Establish clear attribution, funnel metrics, and reporting that connect marketing investment to commercial outcomes.
  • Continuously evaluate which channels deserve additional investment and which should be stopped.

Go-to-Market & Product Marketing

  • Partner with Product, Clinical, Research, Sales, and Customer Success to develop strong go-to-market strategies for new products and capabilities.
  • Establish clear positioning and messaging for our platform, products, and emerging AI capabilities.
  • Develop buyer personas, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and customer proof points.
  • Make sure Sales can clearly articulate why Hi Rasmus wins.
  • Turn customer insight and market intelligence into better positioning, campaigns, and inform product strategy.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Build a content engine that strengthens both brand authority and commercial demand.
  • Develop a differentiated point of view on autism care technology, clinical impact, AI, outcomes, access, and the future of care delivery.
  • Partner with internal clinical and research leaders to translate deep expertise into accessible, credible, and compelling content.
  • Build executive thought leadership for key members of the Hi Rasmus leadership team.
  • Along with the team, work cross-departmentally to develop customer stories, research narratives, case studies, white papers, and other proof that strengthens market credibility.

Communications & PR

  • Own corporate communications and public relations strategy.
  • Lead high-visibility company announcements, partnerships, funding communications, product launches, and media opportunities.
  • Serve as the internal quality bar for messaging associated with significant company moments.
  • Develop strong relationships with relevant media, analysts, industry organizations, and external partners.
  • Prepare executives for media interviews, conference appearances, and other public-facing opportunities.

Community, Events & Advocacy

  • Build on Hi Rasmus’s strong community and advocacy foundation.
  • Develop programs that elevate clinicians, customers, parents, researchers, and other voices within the autism care community.
  • Create a thoughtful event and conference strategy tied to company objectives.
  • Strengthen referral, ambassador, advocacy, and customer-marketing programs.
  • Ensure community initiatives remain authentically connected to Hi Rasmus’s mission rather than becoming traditional promotional programs.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Hi Rasmus marketing team.
  • Create clear ownership, accountability, priorities, and performance expectations across the function.
  • Evolve the team and capabilities required for the company’s next stage.
  • Develop the right mix of internal talent, agencies, contractors, and technology.
  • Build a culture of high standards, creativity, speed, accountability, and collaboration through clear feedback, coaching, trust, and team growth.
  • Own the marketing budget and make disciplined investment decisions.

🎯 What Success Looks Like

In your first year, we would expect you to:
  • Establish a clear and differentiated Hi Rasmus brand and category narrative.
  • Build a trusted marketing partnership with Sales that contributes measurable pipeline.
  • Raise the quality and consistency of every major external company communication.
  • Create a repeatable enterprise ABM and demand-generation engine.
  • Develop a strong GTM process for product launches.
  • Build a content and thought-leadership strategy that strengthens Hi Rasmus’s authority in the market.
  • Create clear marketing metrics and operating rhythms.
  • Develop a marketing organization capable of supporting the next several stages of company growth.
  • Help make Hi Rasmus one of the most recognized and trusted brands in autism care technology.

🧑‍💻 Who You Are

You are a strategic marketing leader who combines commercial instinct, exceptional storytelling, and strong creative judgment.

You likely have:
  • 8+ years of progressive B2B SaaS marketing experience, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Experience helping scale a growth-stage SaaS company.
  • Strong experience marketing to enterprise buyers, in addition to SMB.
  • Demonstrated success building marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.
  • Experience with ABM, demand generation, product marketing, content, brand, and GTM.
  • Experience leading teams and developing strong marketers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong visual and creative judgment, even if you are not a designer yourself.
  • Experience managing executive communications, PR, or significant company announcements.
  • The ability to move fluidly between high-level strategy and detailed execution.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the organization is still building processes as it scales.
Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, autism care, education, clinical SaaS, or another mission-driven industry is valuable but not required.
We care more about your ability to deeply understand a complex market and translate it into a compelling story than whether you have marketed to this exact industry before.

The Kind of Leader We’re Looking For

You have high standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
You create clarity and trust, give candid and caring feedback, and develop talented people through coaching, meaningful ownership, and clear expectations.

You know what excellent work looks like and are willing to challenge work that is not there yet.
You are intellectually curious and spend time with customers, Sales, Product, and the market rather than building marketing strategy from a spreadsheet.
You understand numbers and care deeply about pipeline, but you do not reduce marketing to lead generation.
You have strong taste.
You can look at a campaign, webpage, keynote, press release, customer story, or product launch and recognize whether it feels distinctive, compelling, and worthy of the company behind it.
You are comfortable working closely with executives and are willing to push back when the story, strategy, or execution can be better.
And you are motivated by the opportunity to build something meaningful.

Why Hi Rasmus

Hi Rasmus is at an unusual moment.
We have proven product-market fit, significant customer adoption, strong growth, and the resources to invest aggressively in what comes next.
At the same time, we still operate with the ambition, speed, and mission orientation of a founder-led company.
The opportunity for this person is not to inherit a mature marketing machine.
It is to build one.
And to build it around a company whose success ultimately means helping more clinicians, more families, and more children access better care.

💙 Perks & Benefits You'll Love

🏥 Health & Wellness:
  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision premium for employee-only standard plan (Family can join too, with a variable cost)
  • Employer Sponsored Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • Employer Sponsored Life Insurance
  • Optional group benefits: AD&D, long-term disability
  • Participation in a 401k plan through Empower
🎓 Growth & Development:
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Room for growth within the company
🏖️ Time Off to Recharge:
  • Paid Time Off: 10 vacation days, 5 sick days, 7 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays for ultimate flexibility
🐣 Parental Leave:
  • All Parents/Caregivers: 6 weeks fully paid
  • Birthing Parents: Up to 14 weeks paid
🏡 Work Style That Works for You:
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment—work from wherever feels right!
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the Autism healthcare space

📩 How to Apply

Use our applicant tracking system Pinpoint to answer the role-specific application questions. These questions were thoughtfully designed to give you more insight into the role and to give us more insight into you. Please write a thoughtful response—a human really reads these.
If you need accommodations during the application process, just let us know—we’re happy to help. 😊

jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
