jobs.description:
Trading Specialist

Reports to: Director, Trading
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt, Salaried
Location: Remote (U.S.)

About Mutual

Mutual Group is a mission-driven, independent financial services firm founded more than 40 years ago and headquartered in Southern California. Through our broker-dealer and registered investment adviser subsidiaries, we support more than 1,600 financial professionals nationwide and oversee in excess of $13 billion in assets. Our culture is grounded in our values: Personal, Authentic, Collaborative, and Knowledgeable. We take pride in serving our advisors and clients with integrity, expertise, and care.

Position Overview

The Trading Specialist plays a key role in supporting the daily trading operations of Mutual Group’s advisory and brokerage accounts. This position is responsible for executing trades across a range of financial instruments, including equities, fixed income, ETFs, mutual funds, and options, in accordance with advisor models and instructions. The ideal candidate is accurate, efficient under pressure, and eager to grow their skills in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a self-starter looking to grow within a dynamic team while deepening their trading expertise and directly supporting the success of our advisor clients.

Responsibilities

Trade Execution and Rebalancing

  • Execute, manage, and monitor trades during market hours across multiple custodians and platforms.

  • Trade and rebalance portfolios across multiple asset classes (equities, fixed income, ETFs, mutual funds, options, and UITs) in accordance with advisor models and instructions.

  • Use third-party trading systems to calculate rebalances, allocate assets, and execute trades.

  • Review trading reports to identify accounts requiring action and ensure portfolios remain aligned with assigned models.

Advisor Support and Process Improvement

  • Research and troubleshoot trade-related issues in coordination with custodians and internal teams.

  • Support onboarding of new advisors, accounts, and portfolio models, ensuring trading integration is seamless.

  • Assist with trading-related activities such as cash management, distributions, and tax-loss harvesting.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of trading procedures and documentation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Relevant experience in trading, operations, or investment support; three (3) or more years preferred.

  • Series 7 license.

  • Series 65 license, or willingness to obtain it within six months of hire.

  • Strong working knowledge of investment products and operational processes.

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to work efficiently under pressure during market hours.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and oral.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with the Orion Eclipse trading platform.

  • Experience with custodians such as Fidelity, Schwab, and NFS.

  • Understanding of advisory account structures, 401(k) and 529 rebalancing, and annuity platforms.

Cultural Fit

The ideal candidate brings energy, accountability, and a service-oriented mindset to everything they do. They thrive in an environment that values collaboration over silos, candor over politics, and follow-through over flash. Specifically, the Trading Specialist embodies our values:

  • Personal: Builds genuine relationships with colleagues and advisors and treats every interaction as an opportunity to add value.

  • Authentic: Communicates honestly, owns mistakes, and is comfortable raising issues before they become problems.

  • Collaborative: Brings others along, shares credit generously, and works across functions without ego.

  • Knowledgeable: Demonstrates curiosity, asks thoughtful questions, and invests in learning the business they support.

Why Mutual

Joining Mutual means joining a financial services firm where the work you do has visible, tangible impact. We are big enough to support an established platform and small enough that individual contributions are seen, valued, and rewarded. We invest in our people through competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, ongoing professional development, and a leadership team that takes its responsibility to our employees as seriously as its responsibility to our advisors and clients.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) participation with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonus

  • Wellness initiatives

  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a supportive team.

Salary Range

Annual base salary range (full-time equivalent):$75,000 to $95,000.

Final offer will be commensurate with the selected candidate’s experience and demonstrated capabilities. The position is also eligible for discretionary performance-based bonus consideration.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a current resume and a brief cover letter describing their interest in the role and relevant trading, operations, or investment support experience to the firm at mutual.group/careers-join-our-team. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Mutual Group is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates who need an accommodation during the application process may contact .

Salary: 75K - 95K USD a year

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in translation, English literature, linguistics, your native language, or similar.
  • Must be a native speaker of the target language, with impeccable grammar and spelling

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking a licensed Group Therapist to join our remote, multidisciplinary behavioral health team. In this specialized role, you will exclusively facilitate virtual, evidence-based psychoeducational groups for parents and caregivers of children with behavioral health needs, primarily ADHD and anxiety.

Our parent groups equip caregivers with practical, evidence-based strategies they can use at home to support their child and strengthen family functioning. About You

    • A master’s degree in a relevant behavioral health field and active licensure as an LMFT, LCSW, or LPCC; or

Salesforce Engineering & Platform Development

Integrations & Distributed Systems

jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.
  • A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance

Perks & Benefits:

  • Learning is a way of life. Unlock your full potential backed with cutting-edge tools and mentorship (Macbook for Engagers!)
  • Get the best in class medical insurance (with Covid Care facilities), programs for taking care of your mental health, and a Contemporary Leave Policy (beyond sick leaves)

jobs.excerpt: Why We ExistYour car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s.
jobs.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

  • Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

  • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

  • Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

  • Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

  • Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

  • Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

  • Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

Who You Are

  • Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

  • Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

  • Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

  • Owner: You take ownership of outcomes and are comfortable building process where none exists yet.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining 2+ years at a reputable investment bank, corporate development group, or private equity firm with 2+ years in strategic finance or FP&A at a high-growth company.

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a similarly quantitative field.

  • Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based operating models, three-statement mechanics, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and a working command of accounting concepts and GAAP.

  • Experience with unit economics in a consumer or marketplace business, including CAC, LTV, payback, cohort retention, and contribution margin.

  • A track record of translating complex analysis into a clear narrative for an executive or investor audience.

  • Startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred, including building financial processes from scratch.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for analysis, research, and workflow automation.

Nice to have:

  • Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or marketplace experience;

  • CFA certification;

  • vendor negotiation or procurement exposure;

  • finance tech stack experience (NetSuite, Ramp, planning tools).

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

jobs.description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

As Lead Technical Recruiter, you will lead critical technical searches, raise recruiting quality across the team and help build ActAI's technical recruiting capability.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead Act's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile.

  • Build search strategies and talent maps for scarce technical talent across global AI and engineering markets.

  • Personally source, engage, assess and close senior and difficult-to-hire candidates.

  • Set a high bar for technical profile assessment, ensuring recruiters understand candidates' actual work, technical depth and relevance before progressing them.

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to define hiring profiles, calibrate interview standards and diagnose gaps in the recruiting funnel.

  • Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing.

  • Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly.

  • Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as Act scales.

What You Will Need

  • 7+ years of technical recruiting experience, including significant ownership of senior and difficult engineering searches.

  • Strong track record hiring high-quality engineers through direct sourcing and headhunting.

  • Deep familiarity with technical talent markets and strong understanding of software engineering and AI/ML profiles.

  • Ability to distinguish exceptional technical work from strong branding, titles or CV keywords.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior engineering leaders on hiring strategy and calibration.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach recruiters and improve the quality of their sourcing and assessment.

  • Strong judgement, urgency and willingness to remain deeply hands-on.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or leading technical recruiting at an AI company or high-growth technology startup.

  • Existing networks across AI/ML and engineering communities.

  • Experience hiring across multiple markets including the US, Europe and Asia.

This role is accountable for defining the product vision and roadmap, translating customer and business needs into prioritized outcomes, and guiding a cross-functional product team from discovery through delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. The role serves as the voice of the customer and connects Digital Product Management, Engineering, UX, Commercial, Customer Success, Operations, Legal, Privacy, Security, Quality, and other partners to create a coherent, secure, and intuitive portal experience.


What you’ll be doing


Product Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Define and communicate the customer portal product vision, modernization strategy, value proposition, and multi-horizon roadmap in alignment with customer needs, enterprise priorities, and platform direction.
  • Own product outcomes and lifecycle priorities across discovery, modernization, migration, launch, adoption, optimization, and sustainment.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify customer journeys, improve self-service, reduce friction, and create a consistent experience across portal capabilities and touchpoints.
  • Develop business cases, value hypotheses, financial assumptions, and decision frameworks that support investment, sequencing, capacity, and long-range planning.
  • Maintain a clear view of scope boundaries, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and decisions, ensuring stakeholders understand what is being prioritized and why.

Customer Experience and Discovery

  • Serve as the voice of the customer, grounding decisions in customer research, journey insights, usage data, service feedback, market needs, and operational realities.
  • Lead discovery with UX, research, analytics, Commercial, Customer Success, and regional partners to define problem statements, target users, desired outcomes, and measurable success criteria.
  • Champion an accessible, intuitive, and consistent portal experience, with appropriate consideration for localization, market variation, and diverse customer workflows.
  • Validate product concepts and assumptions with customers and internal users before significant investment, and incorporate learning into roadmap and release decisions.
  • Ensure modernization efforts address both the visible customer experience and the underlying process, content, data, and support model required to sustain it.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead and guide the core product team across the customer portal value stream, partnering closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Lead, UX, Architecture, PMO, and functional stakeholders.
  • Own the “what” and “why” for the product, while partnering with the Product Owner and technical team on solution shaping, decomposition, sequencing, and execution feasibility.
  • Author and sponsor epics, and ensure epics and features are ready enough for planning with a clear problem statement, intended outcome, scope, value, dependencies, and business acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in product and agile operating rhythms, including discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, program increment planning, and daily ceremonies as needed.
  • Make timely priority and trade-off decisions, remove ambiguity, help unblock progress, and provide one coherent direction to the delivery team.
  • Coordinate across adjacent products, shared platforms, content owners, identity and access services, data teams, and enterprise systems to manage dependencies and avoid fragmented customer experiences.

Modernization, Migration, and Operational Readiness

  • Define the phased modernization and migration approach, balancing customer value, technical risk, regulatory obligations, operational continuity, and speed to learning.
  • Partner with technical leaders to shape platform capabilities that are scalable, maintainable, observable, and reusable across markets and customer segments.
  • Lead cross-functional readiness for releases, including customer communications, support processes, training, content readiness, service transition, and escalation pathways.
  • Ensure legacy experiences and capabilities are rationalized deliberately, with clear criteria for migration, coexistence, decommissioning, and customer transition.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, Quality, Regulatory, and data governance stakeholders early and throughout the lifecycle to embed required controls and evidence into product decisions and delivery.
  • Establish governance mechanisms that support rapid decisions while maintaining traceability, risk management, and accountability in a regulated environment.


Adoption, Measurement, and Continuous Improvement

  • Define a product KPI framework that connects customer experience, adoption, operational performance, reliability, and business value.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate product performance, identify friction and unmet needs, and recommend roadmap adjustments.
  • Partner with Analytics, Customer Success, Commercial, and Operations to create transparent reporting and dashboards for product, leadership, and regional stakeholders.
  • Lead post-launch reviews and continuous improvement, ensuring customer feedback, support trends, product analytics, and retrospective learning translate into prioritized action.
  • Promote disciplined product experimentation and outcome-based decision-making, distinguishing activity and feature delivery from measurable customer and business impact.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication

  • Build alignment across senior leaders, regions, functions, and delivery teams around product direction, priorities, investment needs, and critical trade-offs.
  • Translate complex customer, business, regulatory, and technical considerations into clear recommendations for executive and cross-functional audiences.
  • Create an effective stakeholder engagement model for customer and regional input, roadmap communication, decision-making, and escalation.
  • Represent the customer portal product internally and, as appropriate, in customer advisory, research, and co-creation settings.
  • Mentor product team members and model strong product management practices, including customer-centered discovery, economic prioritization, outcome measurement, and continuous refinement.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree such as an MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, product strategy, customer experience, digital platforms, software, or related areas.
  • 5+ years of experience leading change management and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, discovery, prioritization, and translating business needs into executable product plans.
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing customer-facing digital platforms, including migration, adoption, phased implementation, and legacy transition.
  • Strong experience working across Product, Engineering, UX, Architecture, Data, and program leadership in agile/product operating models.
  • Strong analytical, executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills within complex global organizations.
  • Experience in healthcare, MedTech, digital health, life sciences, or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
  • Experience with CRM, customer portals, identity/access, personalization, commerce/ordering, analytics, content management, and enterprise integrations is a plus.
  • Open to applicants across the country, this is a remote position

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back.   • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.

At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.

About the role

The Senior Director, Full-Service Sales is a senior field leader responsible for the performance, talent, and strategic direction of a large, complex Full-Service region. This role leads a team of Full-Service Leaders to deliver sales growth, profitability, customer retention, and new business development while building organizational capability across the region.

The Senior Director operates as the regional general manager for Full Service—translating company strategy into regional execution, developing leadership bench strength, strengthening vendor and cross-functional partnerships, and driving consistent performance standards across multiple markets. In addition to owning regional results, the Senior Director is expected to influence the broader field organization through best-practice sharing, leadership of key initiatives, and contribution to organizational design, training, and talent planning.

Typical span of control: 6–8 Full-Service Leaders leading a large, multi-state region with elevated business, people, and market complexity.

Responsibilities

Grow the Business – 45%

  • Own the performance of a large Full-Service region, delivering against sales, gross margin, new customer acquisition, customer retention, productivity, and profitability targets.
  • Translate company strategy into a regional operating plan, including priorities by market, account segmentation, talent deployment, and focus areas for growth.
  • Lead through Full-Service Leaders to drive execution of sales plans, promotional priorities, key account strategies, and new business development across the region.
  • Review monthly and quarterly regional performance, identify performance gaps, and direct corrective action plans across territories and leaders.
  • Ensure regional forecasting accuracy through disciplined review of sales trends, pipeline opportunities, risks, and productivity indicators.
  • Coach Full-Service Leaders to use Salesforce, Tableau, and other business tools to identify opportunities related to customer growth, order trends, assortment gaps, event participation, returns, and vendor opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior regional partner for vendor/manufacturer relationships, including strategic market planning, education alignment, business development days, and key customer engagement.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders in stores, merchandising, supply chain, pricing, and finance to resolve issues, improve execution, and unlock growth.
  • Lead the regional business narrative for Quarterly Business Reviews, including performance, key risks, talent health, and recommended actions.

Lead the Team and Build Organizational Capability – 45%

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Full-Service Leaders, holding them accountable for territory performance, recruiting, onboarding, coaching, talent development, and execution consistency.
  • Build and maintain a strong regional leadership bench by identifying succession candidates, accelerating high-potential leaders, and addressing performance gaps decisively.
  • Own regional talent planning, including org design recommendations, territory leadership needs, and hiring plans in partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition.
  • Establish a consistent leadership operating rhythm across the region, including one-on-ones, performance reviews, field coaching, business reviews, and development planning.
  • Spend meaningful time in market with Full-Service Leaders to assess leadership effectiveness, coaching quality, customer engagement, and territory execution; provide direct feedback and action plans.
  • Drive accountability for associate experience, retention, engagement, and culture across the region.
  • Partner with Full-Service Leaders to address underperformance, performance management actions, and associate relations matters in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Lead onboarding and development standards for Full-Service Leaders across the region and contribute to broader field leadership training where appropriate.
  • Share best practices across regions and play an active role in shaping field leadership standards, role clarity, and productivity expectations.

Enterprise Leadership / Strategic Projects – 10%

  • Lead or contribute to enterprise and cross-regional initiatives such as organizational redesign, pilot execution, capability building, field training, productivity improvement, or vendor acceleration programs.
  • Provide input to the VP of Full-Service on organizational design, role effectiveness, regional coverage, talent moves, and long-term growth opportunities.
  • Model enterprise leadership by balancing regional priorities with broader company goals and acting as a visible culture leader across the Full-Service organization.

Knowledge, skills & abilities requirements

“The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S.”

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.

  • 10+ years of progressive sales leadership experience, including multi-unit or field leadership responsibility.

  • Demonstrated success leading leaders and managing a complex, multi-state field sales organization.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret sales, margin, productivity, and customer data to drive action.

  • Experience building high-performing teams, coaching leaders, and managing performance.

  • Strong strategic thinking, planning, prioritization, and change leadership skills.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration, communication, and vendor partnership skills.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, Microsoft Office, and field productivity tools.

  • Beauty industry or adjacent B2B sales experience preferred.

  • Ability to travel overnight and weekends as business needs require.

Competencies & attributes

  • Strategic thinker with strong enterprise perspective
  • Talent builder and coach of leaders
  • Results-oriented with strong commercial and financial acumen
  • Change leader who can simplify complexity and drive adoption
  • Strong communicator and cross-functional partner
  • Decisive problem-solver with sound judgment
  • Customer- and field-focused operator
  • Inclusive leader who builds trust, accountability, and engagement

Working conditions & physical requirements

The work environment involves normal business travel and office/field conditions typical of meetings, stores, customer visits, and travel by automobile or air. The role requires regular travel across the assigned region and periodic overnight stays. Standard sedentary and mobile physical requirements apply, including driving, computer work, walking stores or salons, and attending meetings and events.

jobs.excerpt: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds.  We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how.
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Who You Are

  • Customer-Centric: You excel at building and maintaining strong customer relationships, understanding each customer’s unique needs, and identifying how PermitFlow can support their success and growth. You are comfortable and thrive at connecting with customers virtually – spearheading meetings and serving as the face of PermitFlow in all your interactions.

  • Construction Permitting Expert: You have extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting directly, with a thorough understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle. You’re excited about this space and the construction industry at large.

  • Team Player: You’re a key contributor to the pilot process, ensuring a seamless customer journey from software adoption to full implementation. Collaboration is your strength, and you thrive in a cross-functional environment.

  • Analytical Thinker: You’re data-driven in your decision-making. You know how to gather, interpret, and leverage data to enhance customer conversations and improve processes.

  • Tech-Forward & Adaptable: You’re comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve workflows and customer outcomes. You’re eager to learn and implement new software features, and you adapt quickly — ready and able to pivot to new processes at a moment’s notice.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Point of Contact: Serve as the primary resource for customers, keeping them informed on permit status, timelines, and requirements.

  • Team Development: You are comfortable providing clear training, coaching, feedback, and direction to junior team members and oversee their work. You have the skillset to effectively manage a team, hold 1:1s with them, and empower them to learn more.

  • Manage the Permit Process: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of permit applications, including researching requirements, preparing forms, gathering documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant authorities.

  • Generate Reports: Produce detailed reports on permit progress, delivering regular, clear updates to customers and stakeholders.

  • Optimize Processes: Continuously identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices that streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance and Accuracy: Guarantee that all permit applications are complete, accurate, and compliant with jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Monitor and Expedite Approvals: Track permit statuses proactively, engaging with authorities to move applications forward as efficiently as possible.

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience: Proven track record in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role—ideally within a SaaS or tech-driven environment.

  • Local Permitting Knowledge: Hands-on, working knowledge of the permitting landscape across the Midwest, with priority given to candidates deeply familiar with Minnesota, Michigan, Iowa, and Wisconsin specifically, plus general familiarity with permitting practices across other Midwest states.

  • Established Municipal Relationships: Existing relationships with municipalities and inspectors in these states — someone who brings local trust and rapport on day one rather than having to build it from scratch.

  • Regional Escalation Point: Comfortable acting as the on-the-ground point of escalation when local jurisdictions push back on remote or third-party submissions.

  • Expediter Unblocking: Demonstrated ability to identify and unblock restrictions that municipalities place specifically on third-party permit expediters, and a track record of working through (or around) those restrictions to keep permits moving.

  • Exceptional project management skills: Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • Outstanding communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally, manage customer relationships, and collaborate with AHJs.

  • Leadership experience: Preferred 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

The role must be self-directed and comfortable supporting the needs of multiple teams, systems, and products of the domain. jobs.description:
Overview

Our client is a rapidly growing federal contractor. They are seeking a AWS Cloud Developer. In this role you will design, develop, automate, and secure scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS GovCloud and Azure Government, supporting the federal client through Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipeline development, cloud security, and administration of enterprise applications within a SAFe Agile environment.

This role is remote, with occasional required travel to the DMV if a non-local candidate, or occasional onsite needs if a DMV local candidate. Per our client contract, Active Secret Clearance is required.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments within AWS GovCloud and Azure Government.

  • Develop and manage cloud infrastructure using AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, VPCs, Lambda, and IAM.

  • Administer, configure, and optimize the Atlassian Data Center Suite, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and Crowd.

  • Automate cloud provisioning and infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Packer, and AWS CloudFormation.

  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and Bamboo to support secure and continuous infrastructure delivery.

  • Monitor system performance, availability, and security using AWS CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.

  • Implement cloud security best practices, including IAM policy management, data encryption, network configuration, MFA, and AWS Security Hub integration.

  • Manage enterprise identity integrations, including Active Directory, LDAPS, and Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as SAML and OAuth.

  • Leverage containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon ECS, to deploy and manage infrastructure services.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure issues, perform system patching, and execute upgrades in accordance with enterprise release schedules while minimizing service disruptions.

  • Ensure Section 508 accessibility compliance across web-based enterprise applications and collaboration tools.

  • Collaborate with systems engineers, software engineers, security personnel, Product Owners, and Scrum Masters to prioritize infrastructure requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Retrospectives, and System Demos.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience in cloud development, cloud engineering, or infrastructure engineering.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and managing secure cloud environments within AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, VPCs, Lambda, and IAM.

  • Experience administering and configuring the Atlassian Data Center Suite, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and Crowd.

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Packer, and AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and Bamboo.

  • Familiarity with cloud monitoring, logging, and performance management tools such as CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.

  • Knowledge of cloud security principles, including identity and access management, encryption, MFA, network security, and AWS Security Hub.

  • Experience with enterprise identity management and authentication technologies, including Active Directory, LDAPS, SAML, and OAuth.

  • Working knowledge of Docker and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Amazon ECS.

  • Understanding of Section 508 accessibility requirements and their application to enterprise web-based tools.

  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments and collaborating with cross-functional technical teams.

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher required.

jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Doncaster, covering Doncaster or surrounding areas such as Mexborough, Thorne or Bawtry (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Engineer, Cyber Engineering to design, build, automate, and operate scalable security infrastructure across endpoint, network, cloud, and enterprise security platforms.

This role is intended for an engineering-minded security professional who treats infrastructure as code, automation as the default, and manual configuration as technical debt. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering principles to cybersecurity, replacing traditional ClickOps with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and repeatable, self-service security capabilities.

You will help advance Riot's cybersecurity engineering maturity by modernizing how security services are planned, built, deployed, operated, and continuously improved—delivering secure, reliable, observable, and highly automated platforms that scale with our growing AI/HPC and data center infrastructure.

This position will be remote with travel to Riot office locations as needed.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise security capabilities across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity platforms, including EDR/XDR, SASE, firewalls, and security telemetry.
  • Embed security into infrastructure, cloud, and application delivery pipelines using reusable, standardized security architectures.
  • Establish GitOps as the default operating model, with version-controlled configurations, peer reviews, automated testing, and approved deployment pipelines.
  • Build reusable IaC modules and templates with policy-as-code, configuration validation, and automated drift detection and remediation for repeatable, auditable deployments.
  • Eliminate toil by automating the security Plan, Build, and Run lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment through monitoring, troubleshooting, and remediation.
  • Improve platform reliability with SRE practices, including health checks, automated alerting, self-healing, rollback, and disaster recovery.
  • Measure engineering performance through deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, recovery time, configuration drift, and automation coverage.
  • Lead complex initiatives from architecture through production, set engineering standards, mentor engineers, and evaluate emerging tools such as AI-assisted and agentic automation.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, platform, or software engineering, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise security systems.
  • Hands-on expertise with enterprise security platforms such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Microsoft Defender, and SIEM/SOAR.
  • Advanced proficiency in Terraform, GitOps, and CI/CD, with a track record of replacing manual administration with code-driven infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and REST APIs, applying software engineering best practices such as testing, code reviews, and documentation.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable platforms.
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001, including compliance automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and cross-team collaboration skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives independently.
  • Preferred: cybersecurity, cloud, or Terraform certifications and experience with AI-assisted engineering, AI/HPC, or large-scale data center environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $160,000-$175,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

This role must be based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area.

Who You Are

  • Customer-Centric: You excel at building and maintaining strong customer relationships, understanding each customer’s unique needs, and identifying how PermitFlow can support their success and growth. You are comfortable and thrive at connecting with customers virtually – spearheading meetings and serving as the face of PermitFlow in all your interactions.

  • Construction Permitting Expert: You have extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting directly, with a thorough understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle. You’re excited about this space and the construction industry at large.

  • Team Player: You’re a key contributor to the customer journey from software adoption to full implementation. Collaboration is your strength, and you thrive in a cross-functional environment.

  • Analytical Thinker: You’re data-driven in your decision-making. You know how to gather, interpret, and leverage data to enhance customer conversations and improve processes.

  • Tech-Forward & Adaptable: You’re comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve workflows and customer outcomes. You’re eager to learn and implement new software features, and you adapt quickly — ready and able to pivot to new processes at a moment’s notice.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Point of Contact: Serve as the primary resource for customers, keeping them informed on permit status, timelines, and requirements.

  • Team Development: You are comfortable providing clear training, coaching, feedback, and direction to junior team members and oversee their work. You have the skillset to effectively manage a team, hold 1:1s with them, and empower them to learn more.

  • Manage the Permit Process: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of permit applications, including researching requirements, preparing forms, gathering documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant authorities.

  • Generate Reports: Produce detailed reports on permit progress, delivering regular, clear updates to customers and stakeholders.

  • Optimize Processes: Continuously identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices that streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance and Accuracy: Guarantee that all permit applications are complete, accurate, and compliant with jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Monitor and Expedite Approvals: Track permit statuses proactively, engaging with authorities to move applications forward as efficiently as possible.

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience: Proven track record in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role—ideally within a SaaS or tech-driven environment.

  • Bilingual: English and French

  • Location: Based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area

  • Permitting Expert: Experience with residential or commercial permitting in Quebec, including direct work with municipalities. Strong understanding of permitting processes, regulations, and compliance standards, with awareness of jurisdictional differences.

  • Exceptional project management skills: Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • Outstanding communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally, manage customer relationships, and collaborate with AHJs.

  • Leadership experience: Preferred 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Customer-centric mindset: Background in customer success, customer experience, or sales, with a demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality service throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Critical thinker and problem-solver: Able to stay calm under pressure, quickly assess challenges, and identify effective solutions.

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation Range: $70K - $100K
