jobs.excerpt: NOTE: The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees.
jobs.description:
NOTE: The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees. Staff hired on local payroll would follow the respective Country pay range. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Job Summary

CRS strives to promote the health, safety and well-being of all staff. As part of this approach, CRS considers health and well-being an integral aspect of our success. This role will be responsible for strategically designing, leading, and implementing staff care and well-being strategies at both the individual, group and organizational levels. As part of the Health, Safety and Security Unit (HSSU) and member of the HSS Senior Management Team, the Senior Advisor, Staff Well-Being and Workforce Resilience will oversee capacity strengthening in staff care and resilience practices, psychosocial critical incident response, and global well-being initiatives.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Lead the technical development, implementation, and continuous improvement of CRS’ Staff Care and Well-Being strategy, procedures, standards, and frameworks to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, duty of care commitments, risk management strategies, workforce needs, and operational effectiveness.
  • Develop and oversee a psychosocial risk assessment framework, including standardized assessment and documentation tools that can be adapted and scaled across countries and regions to identify, monitor, and address emerging psychosocial risks.
  • Advise country and regional teams, and leadership on strategies and practices that promote staff well-being, resilience, and operational effectiveness, with particular attention to high-risk, insecure, emergency, humanitarian, disaster, and other high-stress operating environments.

Crisis Response:

  • Facilitate preparedness activities and psychosocial risk mitigation efforts for country programs operating in high-risk, insecure, and crisis-affected contexts.
  • Lead agency-wide Family Liaison Program, including liaison training curriculum development, program oversight, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Translate clinical knowledge into technical/operation guidance to country and regional teams, and leadership during and following critical incidents, emergencies, security incidents (road traffic accidents, detentions, physical or sexual violence, etc.), and other situations that may adversely affect staff well-being.
  • Coordinate referrals during/after critical incidents to appropriate resources

Capacity Building and Technical Assistance:

  • Design and deliver in-person and remote training and capacity-strengthening initiatives for CRS staff, managers, and leaders, with particular emphasis on strengthening preparedness, resilience, psychosocial support, and stress management in high-risk and high-stress operating environments.
  • Develop evidence-informed guidance, tools, and resources grounded in psychological science, mental health care research, and trauma-informed principles and adapt them for use across CRS organizational and operating contexts.
  • Strengthen leadership and manager capacity to recognize, address, and mitigate psychosocial risks affecting individuals, teams, and organizational performance.
  • Facilitate agency-wide learning opportunities, community of practice, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that promote effective staff care and well-being practices across CRS and, where appropriate, partner organizations.

Supervision, Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting:

  • Supervise and provide technical direction to Technical Advisor and/or consultant responsible for supporting agency-wide staff care and well-being activities.
  • Monitor and track progress toward strategic objectives and key performance indicators and recommend adjustments to strengthen effectiveness, sustainability, and organizational impact.

Key Working Relationships

  • Internal: HSSU, Regional and Deputy Regional Directors, Sr. Director of Health, Safety and Security, Country Representatives and Managers, Heads of Operations, Heads of Programs, HSS Focal Points, HR, Program Quality (including Health programming team), Ethics Unit, General Counsel, and Humanitarian Response Department.
  • External: International and local mental health providers, Employee Assistance Program vendors, contracted medical service providers and peers/peer networks in public and private sector.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrates ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed team with strong relationship building skills to work collaboratively and effectively with key stakeholders across functions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience working in sensitive situations with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in virtual collaboration and communication technologies (e.g., Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, intranet, email, phone, text messaging, webinar platforms, and shared workspaces),
  • Self-motivated to meet deadlines with evidence of problem solving and critical thinking
  • Ability to train and convey information to a variety of personnel on various skill and language levels
  • Able and willing to work flexible hours when needed, including off-hours and weekends for critical incident response
  • Provide effective remote supervision and/or coaching, and support to staff, consultants, and stakeholders worldwide.
  • Language Required: Fluency in English required; Fluency in another language such as French, Spanish or Arabic preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience transferring knowledge to diverse audiences through training, mentoring, and other formal and informal methods

Required Languages: Fluency in English required; Fluency in another language such as French, Spanish or Arabic preferred.

Travel:Approximately 15% of the time, primarily to/within the various regions, and sometimes in remote areas with minimal amenities available.

Supervisory Responsibilities:Yes

jobs.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experienced with kids and families. You have 3+ years of clinical or community nutrition experience, ideally in pediatric or family-focused settings.

  • Skilled in weight and metabolic health. You've supported patients with obesity, overweight, or metabolic conditions, and you know how to talk about weight in ways that build trust instead of shame.

  • A confident group facilitator. You can keep a virtual room of kids or caregivers engaged, and you enjoy it.

  • Comfortable with virtual care. You use EMRs and telehealth platforms with ease and document efficiently.

  • Culturally responsive. You've worked with families from diverse backgrounds and tailor your recommendations to their culture, resources, and goals.

  • A builder at heart. You're energized by a fast-growing startup and happy to iterate on new care models.

  • Ready to serve our Medicaid families. You're enrolled in California or Texas Medicaid, or willing to enroll.

Bonus points

  • State dietitian licensure, or openness to obtaining licenses with support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group.

  • Spanish fluency.

Compensation, Schedule and Benefits

The pay range for this role is 40–50 per hour, depending on experience. You're paid for all time worked, including visits, group sessions, prep, and documentation.

This is a part-time, hourly W-2 role, fully remote. You choose your hours within our operating window of Monday through Friday, 2pm–8pm PT. This role is eligible for sick leave and 401k participation.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Clarity, we believe every family deserves care that sees and understands them, and that starts with the team we build. Our patients and their families come from every background, community, and walk of life, and we're at our best when our team reflects that diversity. As a female-led company, we know firsthand that different perspectives lead to better decisions, better technology, and better care for kids.

We're building a workplace where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong, and where trust is earned and extended to all. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those whose experience doesn't match every line of this description. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Operations Associate – HubSpot CRM, Deal Pipeline & Excel Reporting | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Operations Associate to keep a high-value deal pipeline accurate, structured, and consistently moving forward.

This is not a traditional finance, investment banking, or sales role. You won’t be responsible for complex financial modeling, sourcing deals, or hitting sales quotas. Instead, your focus will be on execution, HubSpot CRM management, reporting, deal coordination, and consistent follow-through.

You’ll own the operational details behind long, 6–12 month deal cycles, ensuring every opportunity, follow-up, next step, meeting, and task is properly tracked and completed.

If you’re experienced with HubSpot, comfortable with Excel, and naturally make sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Deal Pipeline & HubSpot Management – 50%

  • Own and maintain the deal pipeline within HubSpot CRM
  • Track:
    • Inbound interest
    • Responses
    • Follow-ups
    • Deal stages
    • Next steps
  • Manage consistent follow-up across 6–12 month deal cycles
  • Keep CRM records accurate, complete, and current
  • Maintain clean:
    • Notes
    • Tasks
    • Deal stages
    • Follow-up dates
    • Next actions
  • Flag urgent, stalled, or unattended opportunities for leadership
  • Ensure no deal or important communication is overlooked
  • Monitor overdue tasks and outstanding actions
  • Keep leadership informed of priorities and next steps
  • Maintain reliable pipeline visibility at all times

Deal Execution & Operations Support – 50%

  • Maintain and update Excel and Google Sheets deal trackers
  • Organize raw information into clear:
    • Summaries
    • Reports
    • Graphs
    • Visuals
  • Support the preparation and organization of:
    • Pitch materials
    • Client-facing documents
    • Internal deal materials
  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and deal-related calls
  • Track action items and ensure timely completion
  • Organize deal information so it is easily accessible to leadership
  • Provide administrative and operational support throughout deal execution

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
    • Deal tracking
    • CRM updates
    • Tasks
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline management
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Formatting
    • Templates
    • Basic data handling
    • Reporting
  • Strong written English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage professional follow-ups
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Comfortable managing repetitive follow-ups across long deal cycles
  • Strong execution discipline and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Must be based in South Africa or Latin America

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to:
    • Finance
    • M&A
    • Investment banking
    • Deal-based environments
  • Experience supporting founders or senior executives
  • Familiarity with pitch decks and client-facing materials
  • Experience creating simple charts and data visualizations
  • Familiarity with HubSpot workflows or CRM automation
  • Experience supporting long-cycle transactions or opportunities

Tools & Technology

HubSpot | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Calendar & Scheduling Tools | Internal Deal Tracking Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented
  • Follow through without needing repeated reminders
  • Are comfortable managing high-volume, repetitive follow-ups
  • Notice when deals, tasks, or communications are becoming stale
  • Enjoy maintaining clean systems and structured processes
  • Communicate professionally and clearly in writing
  • Are dependable with recurring operational work
  • Proactively flag issues instead of waiting for someone else to notice them
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Understand that small operational details can have a significant impact on long-cycle deals

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You’ll start by reviewing HubSpot for new activity, overdue tasks, outstanding follow-ups, and deals requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll send professional follow-ups, update deal stages and notes, maintain Excel and Google Sheets trackers, coordinate meetings, organize deal information, and prepare reports or materials for leadership.

You’ll also regularly review the pipeline for opportunities that have stalled and proactively ensure the appropriate next step happens.

In short: you keep the deal pipeline clean, organized, and moving so leadership never has to chase updates or wonder what happens next.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM data accuracy and completeness
  • Percentage of follow-ups completed on time
  • Number of overdue or missed tasks
  • Deal pipeline accuracy
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness
  • Reduction in stale or unattended opportunities
  • Accuracy of Excel and Google Sheets trackers
  • Smooth meeting and deal coordination
  • Leadership confidence in pipeline visibility and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • No sales quotas or sourcing targets
  • No complex financial modeling
  • Clear, structured responsibilities and measurable outcomes
  • High ownership of a valuable deal pipeline
  • Direct exposure to leadership and high-value transactions
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and deal operations
  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates in South Africa and Latin America
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Deal Operations
    • CRM Operations
    • Business Operations
    • Executive Operations
    • M&A / Transaction Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, experienced with HubSpot CRM, comfortable working in Excel and Google Sheets, and relentless about following through until every task is complete, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become the operational engine that keeps high-value deals organized, accurately tracked, and consistently moving forward.

jobs.description:
Location:Canada

Work model:Remote

Expected compensation: Base salary starting at $90,000 CAD per annum

Vacancy status:This posting is for an existing vacancy.

About AudienceView

AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.

We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.

Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

  • We are people first.
  • We are innovative.
  • We are results-driven.
  • We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.

Why we'd want to work with you

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.
  • Email Marketing & Nurture:Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.
  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.
  • Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.
  • Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.
  • Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.

What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience, with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.
  • Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.
  • Marketing Automation:Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.
  • Technical Stack:Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).
  • Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.
  • Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.
  • Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • High-Intent MQLs:Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.
  • Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.
  • Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates:Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.
  • Engagement & Progression:Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.

Why work at AudienceView

  • Our work helps bring live experiences to life.From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.
  • We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  • You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale.Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.
  • We're remote-first with a live-events heart.Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.
  • Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture.The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.

How we hire — our run of show

No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

  • Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.
  • Meet More of the Team (60 minutes):Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.
  • Case Study Interview (45 minutes):Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.

How we use artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.

We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.

Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.

We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.

How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer

AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.

Ready to join the show?

If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

jobs.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
jobs.excerpt: Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.
jobs.description:
Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.

Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality.

We are looking for an AI-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent-assisted review are part of how you ship every change.

What you will do

  • Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on.
  • Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in.
  • Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns.
  • Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it.
  • Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end-to-end tests) so that AI-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence.
  • Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass.
  • Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery.
  • Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used.
  • Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI-first developers.

Why it is interesting

  • Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy.
  • You will do this on mature, mission-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo.

Frameworks and tools you will work with:

Languages & core

  • Java 17+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases

Front end

  • TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our metadata-driven UI platform (XSLT forms and flows rendered as JSON schema)

Scripting & extension

  • Groovy scripts and connectors, extension APIs and scaffolding for customer and partner modifications

AI & agents

  • Claude Code and other coding agents, agent skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, LLM APIs, evaluation of agent output

Quality

  • JUnit, API and integration testing, Playwright end-to-end tests, test data and fixtures, mutation testing

Delivery & DevSecOps

  • GitHub and GitHub Actions (or Jenkins / Azure DevOps), automated agent code review, static analysis, security scanning, SBOM, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code

Operations

  • Logging, telemetry, monitoring and observability tooling across cloud environments

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on AI and agent-based development: building production software with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents or similar, and/or building LLM-powered features and agents (tool use, retrieval, MCP, evaluation).
  • Expert-level Java: modern Java (17+), Spring/Spring Boot, REST APIs, multithreading, performance tuning and clean, maintainable design.
  • 5+ years of professional software development, with a track record of building, shipping and operating production systems.
  • Strong experience in supply chain, automation, MRP or ERP systems. You understand how orders, inventory, materials and fulfillment flow through enterprise systems, and you can spot an answer that looks plausible but is operationally wrong.
  • CI/CD and DevOps fluency: Git-based workflows, pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or similar), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code.
  • Automated testing, observability and continuous delivery as part of how you build, not a separate phase.
  • Prompt and context engineering skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output.
  • Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end.
  • Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices.
  • Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Also valuable

  • A platform where behavior is configured through data or metadata rather than written in code, such as low-code, rules engines or schema-driven UI.
  • Modern TypeScript and Angular (or React), including component architecture and design-system work.
  • Direct experience with warehouse management (WMS), warehouse execution (WES), transportation management (TMS) or MRP/ERP platforms, as a developer, implementer or operator.
  • Experience with warehouse automation: conveyors, sortation, pick-to-light, AMRs, goods-to-person systems or their control software.
  • Mobile or progressive web applications, including RF/handheld devices, offline behavior and poor connectivity.
  • Experience building MCP servers, custom agent tooling or AI-powered developer workflows.
  • Familiarity with XSLT and Groovy, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Based in the US Eastern or Central time zone.

How we work

  • AI-first by default. Agents are part of the team; you are responsible for their output.
  • No change ships without proof. Automated tests, agent review and validation evidence on every pull request.
  • Close to customers. We learn from warehouse floors and Ops leaders, not just tickets.
  • Small, senior and fast. High ownership, low ceremony, measurable results.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you ship production changes through the full agent-assisted pipeline and know our Java platform and WMS domain.
  • First 90 days: you own a feature area end to end, have contributed new agent skills or pipeline checks, and have measurably sped up delivery without lowering quality.
  • First year: you have delivered significant product functionality and are a go-to person for AI-first engineering practices across Softeon engineering.

Location and eligibility

This is a remote, US-based role. Candidates must be permanent residents of the United States. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with our teams and customers. Occasional travel to customer sites or company offices may be required.

What We’re Offering

Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Senior Systems Architect to lead the architecture, integration, implementation, and sustainment of mission-critical Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) enterprise systems operating within secure AWS GovCloud environments. The Senior Systems Architect will serve as the technical authority responsible for defining system architecture, infrastructure strategy, cloud engineering standards, and integration approaches supporting highly sensitive data and operational workloads within Impact Level 4 (IL4) and Impact Level 5 (IL5) environments. This role provides technical leadership across platform operations, infrastructure modernization, DevSecOps, configuration management, and release management activities while ensuring compliance with DoD cybersecurity and interoperability standards. The successful candidate will work directly with government customers, senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and program leadership to translate mission requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical solutions supporting critical defense operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who combines DoD mission experience, AWS GovCloud expertise, enterprise architecture knowledge (DoDAF/TOGAF), and strong customer-facing leadership skills. This individual can effectively bridge strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations while leading the evolution of secure, mission-critical defense systems.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and sustainment of enterprise applications and infrastructure solutions hosted within AWS GovCloud IL4/IL5 environments.
  • Develop and maintain logical, physical, application, data, and security architectures aligned with DoD requirements and enterprise architecture frameworks.
  • Provide technical leadership for cloud engineering, platform operations, infrastructure modernization, configuration management, and release management activities.
  • Establish architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and engineering best practices supporting secure, scalable, and resilient operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and stakeholder engagements with government customers and executive leadership.
  • Develop and maintain architecture artifacts, system diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements, Zero Trust principles, and cloud security standards.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks related to architecture, performance, security, data management, and system integration.
  • Mentor technical staff and provide leadership across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts, recommendations, and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

Clearance
  • Active Secret security clearance required.
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in systems architecture, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or systems engineering supporting federal or DoD environments.
  • Experience architecting and implementing enterprise systems within AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Proven success leading enterprise modernization, systems integration, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical operational systems handling sensitive or regulated data.
  • Demonstrated leadership of technical teams and coordination with government customers and stakeholders.
Technical Knowledge

    • NIST SP 800-53

    • Zero Trust Architecture

  • Experience designing, integrating, and sustaining systems supporting mission-critical defense operations.

Design, develop, and maintain Java-based ETL workflows that extract, transform, validate, and load data from databases, APIs, files, and other source systems.

Implement data cleansing, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation to ensure accurate and consistent downstream data.

Develop incremental loading, batching, retry, and recovery processes that support reliable execution and safe reprocessing without duplicate records

Build and maintain ORM-based data access layers using Java persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate, including entity mappings, relationships, and transaction management.

Develop and optimize SQL queries supporting application functionality and data processing.

Inspect SQL generated by JPA/Hibernate in Spring applications and analyze database execution plans to identify inefficient joins, excessive database calls, unnecessary data retrieval, and other performance bottlenecks.

Improve database performance through appropriate indexing, query restructuring, batching, pagination, and relationship-loading strategies.

Design and maintain relational schemas, constraints, indexes, and versioned database migrations.

Select ORM operations, parameterized SQL, or database-native bulk operations according to workload, maintainability, and performance requirements.

Implement and optimize OpenSearch or Elasticsearch queries, filters, and aggregations; troubleshoot search performance and maintain consistency between source data and search indexes. Monitor pipeline reliability, data quality, processing throughput, and query response times; troubleshoot production issues and demonstrate measurable improvements.

Create automated tests for transformation logic, database interactions, data integrity, and recovery behavior

Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to define requirements, document data mappings, and review database and pipeline designs.

Design, develop, and maintain GraphQL APIs and resolvers to support efficient data retrieval and integration with backend services and relational databases.

Develop and optimize database integrations using Amazon Aurora within Amazon RDS in AWS, including connection management, schema migrations, ETL workflows, and query performance tuning.

Required Technical Qualifications

Strong Java development experience building and supporting production backend applications.

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines and data integration workflows.

Hands-on experience with Java Spring ORM and persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate.

Experience writing and optimizing JPQL and SQL queries, including troubleshooting ORM-generated SQL.

Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and set-based processing.

Experience analyzing database execution plans and improving query performance through indexing and query changes.

Experience with relational data modeling, schema migrations, entity relationships, and transaction management.

Understanding of database isolation levels, locking, and concurrency.

Experience implementing data validation, incremental processing, error handling, and recoverable data workflows.

Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, and software deployment practices.

Ability to explain production performance improvements using measured results.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with workflow orchestration, job scheduling, change data capture, and pipeline monitoring.

Experience diagnosing ORM performance issues such as N+1 queries, inefficient relationship loading, and excessive entity loading.

Experience processing large datasets within defined delivery windows while managing database resource utilization.

Familiarity with Apache Spark for ETL and distributed data processing.

BS/BA degree (or equivalent) plus 8-10 years experience in related field.

jobs.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.
jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.

The Associate Software Engineer will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
  • Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
  • An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
  • Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
  • Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
  • Next.js or React.
  • Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
  • IT support experience.
  • Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

Responsibilities:

Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.

Build and ship

  • Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
  • Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
  • Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
  • Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
  • Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
  • Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
  • Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

AI development and enablement

  • Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
  • Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
  • Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
  • Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

Discover and plan

  • Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
  • Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
  • Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

Tools you may work with. These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.

  • App development: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
  • Cloud and hosting: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
  • Automation: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
  • Business systems: Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
  • Source control and CI: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Growth and milestones

This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.

Day 30: Learn the platform, ship a fix to a live app, and join a VITALs discovery session.

Day 60: Own one automation from end to end, with tests and a runbook.

Day 90: Take one VITALs project from intake to production, including user acceptance testing.

Month 6: Own one or more apps end to end. Hold regular check-ins with their department leads, and take part in architecture discussions.

Month 12: Act as a trusted technical partner to the department leads you support. Help design Valiant's future app architecture, lead discovery for new VITALs projects, and help set the direction of AI development.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $75,000 to $90,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

To meet the needs of our customers, working outside normal business hours and on some weekends/holidays is required. In addition to working OT to handle workload and meet required metrics/expectations.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Join a mission-focused team at the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) dedicated to maintaining and modernizing critical medical logistics applications that directly support military customers. As a Senior Project Analyst and Quality Engineer, you will manage complex, state-of-the-art test programs while serving as a key bridge between stakeholders, users, and software developers. The role requires translation of complex program requirements into testable objectives, developing comprehensive test plans and procedures, and guiding the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement decomposition to release verification. You will work closely with cross-functional technical teams, apply use cases and user stories to create test cases, and independently assess system performance against stated requirements to ensure high-quality software delivery. Additional sustainment tasks, such as monitoring production environments and performing analysis on databases, may be required.

  • Designs and executes test cases and test procedures to support software release targets and meeting requirement needs.
  • Translates complex program requirements into clear, testable objectives and assists with decomposition of user stories/requirements to a level of sufficiency that software developers can implement, including insertion of best practices for ensuring user stories/requirements are testable.
  • Develops and implements the overall test strategy, including defining clear test objectives, methodologies, analysis, schedules.
  • Leads and mentors QA Testers in designing detailed, executable test plans and compensating for test limitations and restrictions.
  • Incorporates automation to test cases where appropriate to expedite test execution.
  • Fosters excellent relationships with business analysts and/or stakeholders/users to understand user story and requirement needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-team technical or business resources to coordinate the resolution of data, requirements, or testing process issues that impact application quality.
  • Provides feedback on business direction, interpretation of requirements, and updates to test cases; executes test cases and signs off for release completion when necessary.
  • Captures, tracks, and manages test plans, test cases, and test steps in the enterprise repository and program-provided tools (e.g., Azure DevOps/TFS), and manages test case signoff and overall test plan posture, providing updates to project lead on testing posture.
  • Participates in software releases and deployments with Infrastructure and Application developers, supporting project leads where appropriate to review application functionality when going live and assist with documentation needs.
  • Develops a deep functional understanding of application business capabilities and continuously learns new business and technical domains.
  • Utilizes data analysis and SQL skills to investigate issues, validate database state, and provide reports as needed by stakeholders, users, or other clients in a timely fashion.
  • Leads analysis efforts to dissect test output data, interfaces with the client, provides clear results, and recommends corrective actions. Uses these skills in development and production environments as demands require.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the project, assisting project lead to support the overall stakeholder need and mission objectives.
  • Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
  • Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline knowledge and awareness.
  • Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
  • Additional duties as required.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to achieve a NACLC security background check.
  • Minimum of 5 years related experience.
  • Experience in testing software applications, including system, regression, acceptance, end-to-end, performance, and automation testing.
  • Experience in an Agile environment, with demonstrated knowledge of System Operations, Engineering, and DevOps integration.
  • Experience developing and maintaining test cases and requirements using designated automated test tools and repositories like Azure DevOps/TFS.
  • Must have detailed familiarity with commercial test environments and operating procedures.
  • Experience translating complex program requirements into testable objectives, and decomposing requirements for development.
  • Experience analyzing and recommending test cycles, test plans, and detailed test objectives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, experience working effectively with diverse organizations and personalities, and is a “team player”.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certification from a nationally recognized technical authority (e.g., ISTQB, CSM, PMP, or equivalent).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
  • Military Medical Supply Chain experience is a big plus.
  • Possess significant experience performing complex analysis using SQL to validate application behavior or generate business reports.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating or leading the development/testing of Web-based applications (e.g., .Net MVC, Angular).

Life at Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

  • Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
  • Merit-based financial rewards.
  • Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
  • Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
  • Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Amyx and Tetra Tech:

Amyx, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Tetra Tech, and our mission is to exceed our customer's expectations on every contract, to provide an environment that encourages, recognizes and rewards the extraordinary contributions of our employees, and to advance and support the communities in which we work and live.Amyx is a management and technical solutions provider and a "trusted partner"​ to our Federal Government clients on programs of national importance. We understand that successful programs require superior performance and a level of trust achieved through genuine rapport with the customer. Award-winning results have propelled Amyx to become one of the fastest growing businesses in the Washington Region. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

  • Commitment to growing the people around you. The candidate should have a history of coaching architects and developers through design reviews and code reviews, establishing delivery standards and reusable accelerators, and raising the overall capability of the practice rather than only the outcome of a single project, a plus
  • Hands on expertise with ServiceNow’s AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents and the AI Agent Studio, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and the underlying data and process readiness required to deploy them responsibly, with the ability to identify the use cases where these capabilities will deliver measurable value for a client, a plus.

jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

THE PEW CHARITABLE TRUSTS

Senior Officer, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

(Protected Area Management and Conservation Finance)

The Environment Portfolio at The Pew Charitable Trusts

For more than 30 years, Pew has been a major force in engaging the public and policy makers about the causes, consequences, and solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our environment work spans all seven continents with more than 250 professionals working at the local, national, and international levels to reduce the scope and severity of global environmental problems, such as the erosion of large natural ecosystems that contain a great part of the world’s remaining biodiversity, and the destruction of the marine environment. Pew’s global environmental program focuses on science-based, nonpartisan, and sustainable solutions to help protect the planet and people. We work in partnership with governments, Indigenous rights holders, intergovernmental organizations, non-governmental organizations, local stakeholders, scientists, and other researchers to advance public policy so that nature and communities can thrive.

Since 1990, Pew has worked in North America, South America and Australia to protect large and critically important terrestrial ecosystems, including rivers and other freshwater resources, coastal temperate rainforests, interior mountain ranges, the northern boreal forests, Australia’s Outback, and Chilean Patagonia. We work to ensure these natural systems remain bountiful, functioning, and resilient, providing essential ecological services such as clean air and clean water, sustenance and food security for local communities and more broadly for the welfare of current and future generations. Our work relies on the sciences of conservation, sociology, biology, and economics to advocate for practical and durable solutions to the loss of biodiversity.

In the sea, reforms to how our oceans are managed are essential to address overfishing, pollution, and loss of habitat. Pew began its oceans program in the United States, focusing on ending overfishing and protecting fragile marine habitat. Starting in 2005, Pew’s ocean conservation program expanded around the world and played a significant role in reforming marine fisheries management in the European Union and on the high seas and creating large scale marine reserves around the world. Our work is grounded in the best available science and pursues domestic and international conservation measures that are long-term and provide permanent, durable protections for marine ecosystems. We also work to address systemic threats to the ocean, including from plastics, over-and-illegal fishing, seabed mining, and climate change.

Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

South America’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco regions are among the most ecologically significant tropical wetlands and dry forests on Earth. This area spans parts of Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Argentina and contains thousands of plant and animal species and provides vital aquatic habitat, nutrient renewal, migration routes, and flood control for millions of animals and people living downstream. The region’s extensive ecosystems are currently threatened by deforestation, drought and intensification of wildfires related to climate change, and thus urgently need conservation action.

The project works with the policy framework in each country to solidify and expand protection of the extraordinary biodiversity of the Pantanal-Gran Chaco region. Pew partners with local and international conservation organizations, government agencies, and Indigenous governments and organizations to improve management of and expand protected areas, support Indigenous organizations and communities in the management of their territories, promote sustainable management for ranching lands, and to advance long-term conservation financing mechanisms for durable protections.

Position Overview

Reporting to the Project Director, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands, the Senior Officer will lead efforts to develop long-term financing and improve the management of protected and conserved areas in the Pantanal-Gran Chaco landscape.

The Senior Officer will focus on identifying and pursuing finance, conservation, community development, and fundraising goals that support improved management of protected and conserved lands in the region. This will include collaboration with consultants, partners, government officials and other key stakeholders, as well as facilitating the project’s engagement in public policy and advocacy related to conservation finance and improved management. This position requires demonstrated leadership in public or private sector organizations focused on promoting sustainability and conservation.

The Senior Officer will be located either in Santa Cruz, Bolivia; or elsewhere within the South America region following evaluation by Pew.

Responsibilities for the Pantanal-Gran Chaco Project:

  • Foster a work environment that inspires excellence, values impact, encourages transparency, builds mutual trust and respect, embraces and values diversity, and is collaborative, caring and compassionate. Under the Project Director’s leadership, manage aspects of Pew’s Pantanal-Gran Chaco initiative related to improving the management of the region’s protected and conserved areas. This includes organizing and coordinating high-level meetings, commissioning and conducting research, and managing strategic partnerships.
  • In collaboration with relevant Pew staff and senior management, assess opportunities to expand or develop new financing strategies for protected and conserved areas in Bolivia, Brazil, and Argentina.
  • Coordinate the development of priority financing initiatives in collaboration with Pew’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco team, consultants, and in-country partners.
  • Provide technical guidance to Pew’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco team on financing frameworks, sustainable financing mechanisms, public resource allocation, and effective management.
  • Support the Project Director in establishing and cultivating strategic alliances and launching joint initiatives with international organizations, foundations, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), government agencies, Indigenous organizations, and other institutions in the region.
  • Promote best practices and innovations in protected area management and conservation in the Pantanal Gran-Chaco through public policy engagements and outreach efforts.
  • Prepare regular updates for senior management and other audiences summarizing the initiative’s efforts and achievements toward financial sustainability of the region’s protected and conserved lands.
  • Lead analysis and research within the framework of the Pantanal and Gran Chaco strategy to gather scientific, policy, and technical information on protected area conservation lands finances and management in Latin America.
  • Represent Pew in external events online and in person, including meetings with national and local governments, multilateral organizations, and other institutions.
  • Participate in activities that support program and Pew-wide objectives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in public policy, economics, business, natural resources management or related studies preferred.
  • Generally, a minimum of 10 years
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish is required, competence in Portuguese is desired.
  • Significant experience in project management, financial mechanisms, and government engagement.
  • Experience working with local and regional governments.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Data Architect – PBM Data Modernization

Location: Remote (US Only) Industry:Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)Platform:Google Cloud Platform

Role Overview

We're looking for a Data Architect to lead data modeling and source-to-target mapping for a Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) modernization program on Google Cloud. The role covers migrating legacy claims and eligibility data, and the IBM Cognos reporting built on it, into a new BigQuery-based enterprise data warehouse. It also ensures the future-state platform meets state-specific Medicaid reporting requirements, starting with the MVP.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the semantic and logical data models for MVP and future-state reporting, covering pharmacy claims, member eligibility, prescriber, pharmacy network, formulary, rebates, and pricing domains.
  • Own mapping execution end to end. Define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and business logic from legacy structures to the new warehouse.
  • Inventory and analyze legacy IBM Cognos (Cognos Explorer / Cognos Analytics) reports, packages, and Framework Manager models. Reverse-engineer embedded business logic and calculations, and rationalize reports for redesign on the future-state platform.
  • Set mapping standards, templates, naming conventions, and documentation practices. Direct the Data and Systems Analysts and review their work for quality and consistency.
  • Lead gap analysis and drive each gap to a decision (build, defer, workaround, or descope) with business, compliance, and technical stakeholders.
  • Translate state Medicaid reporting requirements (encounter data submissions, MCO/PBM transparency reports, spread pricing and pass-through disclosures, T-MSIS-aligned extracts) into data model and mapping specifications.
  • Define data quality rules, reconciliation checkpoints, and lineage so legacy-to-target results, including Cognos report outputs, are traceable and audit-ready.
Work with data engineers on ingestion and transformation design on GCP, and use Vertex AI and Gemini to speed up mapping, profiling, and documentation.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in data architecture or data modeling, with at least 3 years in PBM, pharmacy, or health plan data.
  • Hands-on experience with NCPDP claim standards, Medicaid and managed care reporting, and legacy migration programs.
  • Strong skills in dimensional and semantic modeling, plus advanced SQL.
  • Experience with IBM Cognos Analytics / Cognos Explorer, including Framework Manager packages, report specifications, and migrating Cognos reporting to a modern BI platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud data services:
  • BigQuery for warehouse design, including partitioning, clustering, and authorized views
  • Dataflow and Dataproc for transformation pipelines
  • Cloud Composer (Airflow) for orchestration

–Cloud Storage for landing zones

  • Dataform or dbt for SQL-based transformations
  • Familiarity with Dataplex and Data Catalog for metadata, lineage, and data quality, and with Looker (LookML) for building the semantic layer.
  • Proven experience leading analyst teams and running mapping governance.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA, CMS regulations, and state-level Medicaid compliance, along with GCP security controls (IAM, VPC Service Controls, CMEK).
  • Location & Work Authorization: Must currently reside in the United States and hold valid US work authorization without sponsorship.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Vertex AI or Gemini in BigQuery for AI-assisted mapping, profiling, and documentation.
  • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.

The Role

We're hiring a Robotics Researcher to drive frontier research in embodied AI, robot learning, and physical AI systems.

This is a hands-on research role focused on advancing vision-language-action (VLA) models, generalist robot policies, world models, and emerging approaches to embodied intelligence. You'll design and execute end-to-end robotics experiments, leveraging real-world data, simulation, and human-in-the-loop systems to evaluate and improve robot performance.

You'll independently explore promising research directions and collaborate with leading AI and robotics teams to translate experimental findings into scalable solutions.

  3. Develop high-fidelity simulations using real-world data to evaluate robot policies and validate performance in physical environments.
  4. Leverage flow, our human-in-the-loop annotation platform, to structure and scale robotics datasets from egocentric video, teleoperation demonstrations, and multimodal sensor data.
  5. Investigate model limitations, failure modes, and sim-to-real gaps to develop improved datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies.
