jobs.description:
Job Description— Senior Accountant

Reports to:Corporate Controller

Pay Range DOE: 80,000 - 100,000 CAD

About Arc Beverage

Arc Beverage provides beverage co-manufacturing, packaging, and related operational services for brand owners. Our finance team partners with operations to maintain accurate financial records, support business decisions, and improve accounting processes.

Location and working hours

This position is based in Canada. Candidates must reside in Canada and be legally authorized to work in Canada. Regular working hours must align with Pacific Time (PT), including Pacific Standard Time (PST) and Pacific Daylight Time (PDT), as applicable. Additional availability may be needed during month-end and year-end close.

About the role

The Senior Accountant / Assistant Controller is a hands-on finance professional responsible for leading the accounting close, maintaining reliable financial reporting, and overseeing cost and inventory accounting. This role supports the Controller, reviews transactional accounting work, and partners with operations to explain financial results and strengthen controls.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the Controller in managing the day-to-day accounting and financial reporting functions.
  • Own and coordinate key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, amortization, reclassifications, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Prepare, review, and maintain detailed balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.
  • Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, unusual transactions, and reconciliation issues.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements and management reporting packages.
  • Analyze financial results and investigate significant variances against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Perform and review bank, credit card, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and other account reconciliations.
  • Support oversight of the accounts payable and accounts receivable functions, including vendor and customer account issues.
  • Maintain and review fixed asset, prepaid expense, accrual, lease, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Support inventory accounting, including inventory reconciliations, costing, COGS, adjustments, and investigation of variances.
  • Review capital expenditures and ensure appropriate capitalization and accounting treatment.
  • Assist with cash management, cash flow reporting, and working capital analysis.
  • Ensure accounting transactions are properly recorded, supported, and classified in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Support technical accounting assessments for new or unusual transactions.
  • Assist with annual audits, tax filings, and other external reporting requirements.
  • Prepare audit schedules and respond to auditor requests.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Support accounting system improvements, ERP enhancements, integrations, and automation initiatives.
  • Provide guidance, review, and mentorship to junior accounting team members.
  • Assist with establishing close timelines, assigning accounting activities, and ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Partner with Operations, Procurement, Sales, HR, and other departments to resolve accounting and financial issues.
  • Provide accounting and financial analysis to support management decision-making.
  • Support the Controller with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and special projects as required.
  • Step into other accounting functions as required to ensure the team meets reporting deadlines.
  • Perform other accounting and finance-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • At least 4 years of progressive accounting experience; broader accounting oversight and review experience
  • Strong cost accounting and inventory analysis experience in manufacturing or co-packing is required.
  • Proven experience leading or coordinating close activities, preparing financial reports, and resolving complex reconciliations.
  • Knowledge of U.S. GAAP accounting practices and sales tax requirements; cross-border and multi-currency experience is an asset.
  • Canadian CPA designation or active progress toward designation is preferred
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and financial models, and proficiency with ERP systems.
  • Ability to coach junior staff, manage deadlines, and explain financial information to operational leaders.
  • Availability to work regular Pacific Time hours from Canada.

How you work

You combine sound judgment and attention to detail with a practical, collaborative approach. You take ownership of deadlines, communicate issues early, and help colleagues understand the financial impact of operational decisions.

Benefits and development

Canadian health benefits and paid time off, subject to the applicable employment agreement and plan eligibility. Opportunities to develop accounting skills and contribute to a collaborative finance team.

Equal opportunity and accommodations

Arc Beverage is committed to equal employment opportunity and an inclusive workplace. Applicants will be considered without discrimination on grounds protected by applicable Canadian human rights legislation. Accommodations are available on request throughout the recruitment process.

Undergraduate course:

Online Asynchronous

The course starts on January 13th and will run through May 7th, 2027.

Course descriptions:

Foundations of Applied AI (BAI1000):

This course introduces students from all disciplines to the rapidly expanding field of artificial intelligence (AI). It focuses on developing AI literacy through technical proficiency, practical application, and critical evaluation. At first, students develop a clear understanding of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), large language models (LLMs), GenAI, and agentic AI techniques. Next, they actively learn about their unique practical applications in prompting and augmented workflows for individuals and organizations. Lastly, they assess and critique the validity, fairness, and ethical dimensions of the outputs of these AI systems. In this way, the students develop a personal AI portfolio of solutions to the problems in their fields of study by partnering with AI algorithms. No prior AI experience is required. DecisionPoint is hiring a Junior Help Desk Specialist to provide first-contact support for authorized users of the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. The work calls for accurate records, discretion, and courteous service in a sensitive Department of Defense mission.

You will work from established procedures with guidance from experienced specialists and service-desk leads. Under Total Contact Ownership, you will keep users informed and track assigned requests through resolution, including when another team handles the technical work.

This position is fully remote. The DCIPS Future user-support service window is 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding government holidays. Individual work schedules are assigned to support that coverage.

  • Receive incidents, service requests, and inquiries through approved support channels. Record, categorize, and prioritize each contact in the service-management system.
  • Troubleshoot DCIPS Future application use, user access, and related software, hardware, and connectivity issues using standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.

Perform account actions within assigned permissions and route other actions to authorized administrators. Follow approved least-privilege procedures consistent with Zero Trust principles.

  • Identify recurring questions and gaps in documentation. Help update self-service guidance and troubleshooting articles, and provide feedback on user training.
  • Maintain accurate service-performance data and handover notes, including open actions and escalation status.

  • Complete DCIPS-specific training and practice support workflows, use of knowledge resources, and escalation procedures before service activation and as the application changes.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

Overview

DecisionPoint is hiring an experienced Tier 1 Help Desk Specialist to support authorized users of the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. You will independently diagnose application and access issues, prepare clear escalation records, and help improve support procedures. You will work within Tier 1 responsibilities and coordinate with Tier 2, Tier 3, infrastructure, and cybersecurity specialists.

Under Total Contact Ownership, you will keep users informed, track assigned requests after escalation, and confirm resolution before closure. Accuracy, discretion, and respectful service are essential to this Department of Defense mission.

This position is fully remote. The DCIPS Future user-support service window is 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding government holidays. Individual work schedules are assigned to support that coverage.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Receive, categorize, prioritize, and document incidents and requests in the service-management system through approved support channels.
  • Diagnose DCIPS Future application, account, authentication, software, hardware, and connectivity issues. Use approved diagnostic tools, reproduce issues when appropriate, and distinguish symptoms from verified causes.
  • Perform authorized account and credential actions, including provisioning, changes, password and access support, and deactivation. Apply identity verification and access-control procedures; route actions outside assigned permissions to authorized administrators. Apply Zero Trust principles when troubleshooting authentication and access issues.
  • Prepare escalations with affected users, mission impact, diagnostic evidence, troubleshooting results, and the assistance required from Tier 2, Tier 3, or another technical team.
  • Track progress after escalation, communicate status and next steps, and verify and document the resolution with the user.
  • Identify emerging outages and suspected security incidents. Coordinate notifications with the Shift Lead and designated technical owners.
  • Coach junior specialists in first-line troubleshooting, ticket quality, customer communication, and the use of approved procedures.
  • Review recurring issues and recommend improvements to support procedures, knowledge articles, and user training. Validate proposed self-service content using approved test environments and sample or sanitized data before submitting it for publication review.
  • Coordinate DCIPS-related hardware exchange, repair requests, and enterprise-service dependencies with responsible support organizations.
  • Record service metrics, flag tickets at risk of missing service targets, and provide complete handovers of open incidents and actions.
  • Protect sensitive support data. Take part in DCIPS-specific training and checks of support workflows, knowledge resources, and escalation routes.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • At least five years of IT customer-support or service-desk experience, including at least two years in a federal or defense environment.
  • Experience with IT service-management tools, incident tracking, service-level management, and ITIL-aligned ticket-triage workflows.
  • Proficiency in Windows and Linux troubleshooting, user account administration, and remote desktop tools.
  • Knowledge of network fundamentals, VPNs, Active Directory, multi-factor authentication, and public key infrastructure certificate management.
  • Experience troubleshooting email, collaboration tools, and endpoint-security applications, with an understanding of Zero Trust and secure access management.
  • Familiarity with the Risk Management Framework, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving, documentation, and customer-service skills, with the ability to work independently and coordinate with remote technical teams.

Preferred certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ CE
  • CompTIA A+ or Network+
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or HDI Support Center Analyst.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

jobs.excerpt: Want to deliver tech with purpose, with people who care?
jobs.description:
Want to deliver tech with purpose, with people who care?

Join us in our mission to create solutions that help keep children safe online.

Who are we?

Headquartered in Perth, Australia, with offices around the world, Qoria is an ASX-listed global leader in child digital safety technology and services. We are a purpose-driven business operating under the Linewize brand in North America and Asia Pacific, the Smoothwall brand in the UK, the Qustodio brand in EMEA, and Qoria LK in Sri Lanka.

Our solutions are used by schools, school districts, and parental communities to protect children from harmful online content, identify students at risk based on their digital behaviours, and help teachers maintain focus and safe learning environments in the digital classroom. Today, 30,000 schools and 7 million parents rely on our solutions to help keep 25 million children safe across 180 countries worldwide.

What’s the opportunity:

Qustodio supports families with innovative tools and meaningful guidance for a healthy and safe digital experience. As our CRM Manager, you’ll make sure every parent experiences that value quickly and gets more from it over time. You’ll own our lifecycle program and CRM tooling from signup onward: driving parents to protect their child’s device, set up the parent app, and see protection in action, then keeping them engaged with timely, relevant, well-crafted communication.

You’ll step into an established, high-performing program with one clear goal: to keep improving it. By continuously testing, optimizing and exploring new opportunities, you’ll drive measurable gains in activation, engagement and conversion. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll work closely with Engineering, Data, Design, Customer Support and Marketing.

Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Product activation and engagement

Own the onboarding experience that turns signups into active users, guiding parents from protecting a child’s device to seeing protection in action.

Use product data and user behavior to trigger messaging at the moments that matter, such as blocked content, screen time limits or new app installs.

As part of the Product team, drive adoption of new features and shape how they’re introduced to parents.

Build retention journeys that deepen product usage and show ongoing value beyond the first 30 days.

Work with Customer Support to keep the Help Center accurate and aligned with the product, so parents can set up and get value on their own.

  • CRM tooling and channels

Own Qustodio’s Braze instance: canvases, segmentation, triggers and data quality.

Work with Engineering to keep event tracking and product data flowing reliably into Braze.

Uphold email best practices across deliverability, accessibility, frequency and consent.

Orchestrate email, push and in-app messaging as one consistent experience, coordinating with Marketing, QA, Design and Localization.

Manage the CRM calendar across departments.

  • Testing, insights and growth

Continuously test and optimize to improve activation, engagement and conversion.

Identify new opportunities across segments, journeys, channels and Braze capabilities.

Report on lifecycle KPIs alongside product metrics and turn learnings into action.

Bring the voice of the customer into product decisions through surveys and Customer Support insights, and keep the Help Center aligned with lifecycle messaging.

What you will bring:

  • 3+ years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a subscription app, consumer SaaS.
  • Hands-on experience with Braze or a comparable CRM platform, including canvases, segmentation and triggered messaging.
  • A product mindset: you think in user journeys, activation milestones and behavioral data, not just campaign sends.
  • Strong knowledge of email best practices, deliverability and privacy regulations such as GDPR.
  • A rigorous testing approach and strong analytical skills, with comfort working in dashboards and alongside data teams.
  • Clear, concise writing and the ability to communicate results and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Ability to own an established program independently, ramp up quickly and manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluent in English.

Why choose Qustodio by Qoria?

In this role, you can expect:

  • Great Benefits
  • Enhanced holiday & family leave
  • Tech Allowance
    .... and much more

More importantly, you'll:

  • Support tech with purpose..

At Qustodio by Qoria, your work truly matters. With every customer interaction, you’ll be helping children stay safe online. It feels good to do good.

  • With people who care...

One of our values is ‘Care, Always’. Our Support Team lives and breathes that, every day. We also look after each other and help create a supportive environment for all.

  • Through work that you love...

Working in this role takes skill, energy and resilience. It can also be incredibly rewarding. Here, your efforts will be visible and you’ll love the impact you have.

  • And a career that you own...

A proven career path forward, with real opportunities to progress your career into other teams and departments within the company. Exposure to industry leading tech, developed in-house by an amazing engineering team. Regular company wide lunch and learn sessions

We'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application if you would like to be considered for this opportunity.

jobs.excerpt: Join Points of Light and Change the WorldAs the world’s largest organization dedicated to increasing volunteer service, Points of Light engages more than 3.
jobs.description:
Join Points of Light and Change the World

As the world’s largest organization dedicated to increasing volunteer service, Points of Light engages more than 3.8 million volunteers across 32 countries.

Cast from the vision of one thousand points of light shared by its founder, President George H.W. Bush, in his 1989 inaugural address, Points of Light was founded in 1990 as an independent, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization to encourage and empower the spirit of service. The organization extends President Bush’s vision that “any definition of a successful life must include serving others.” Today, Points of Light continues to transcend politics and borders to inspire millions of individuals worldwide to take action.

Join Us: Be part of a movement that changes lives and communities. Please read the position description below. For more information, visit pointsoflight.org.

Salary Range:$70,000-$80,000 annually

Reports to:Director, Grant Management & Revenue Operations

Department:Office of the Chief Operating Officer

Location:Points of Light is a remote-first organization. Any U.S. location in the Eastern or Central time zone in a market with a major airport. Washington, DC or Atlanta preferred.

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Grant Management & Revenue Operations manages awarded philanthropic grants and signed fee-for-service (earned-income) agreements across Points of Light. Reporting to the Director, the role translates approved commitments into coordinated plans, clear ownership, reporting calendars and timely handoffs from award through closeout.

Working across Development, Corporate Programs, Finance, program and delivery teams, and relationship managers, the Senior Manager proactively connects contributors, monitors commitments and ensures timely donor and client communication through established relationship channels. The ideal candidate brings extensive grant management experience, strong project management and communication skills, and an adaptable approach to improving processes

Position Functions and Responsibilities Include:

Post-Award Planning and Enterprise Coordination

  • Lead kickoffs with Finance, delivery leads and relationship managers. Confirm agreement terms, approved budgets, planned funding assignments, owners, deliverables, reporting requirements, payment triggers and handoffs.
  • Maintain one implementation plan and reporting calendar per agreement, covering milestones, dependencies and deadlines. Apply the Supervisor’s distinct grant and earned-income workflows; coordinate required financial setup with Finance.
  • Establish routine touchpoints with all relevant enterprise contributors throughout each agreement’s lifecycle. Confirm responsibilities, share decisions and changes, anticipate dependencies and connect teams before handoffs break down.

Grant and Contract Monitoring

  • As needed, support preparation of revenue agreements, agreement letters and amendments using approved templates; coordinate required information, reviews, approvals and electronic signatures; and maintain executed documents in Salesforce under supervisor’s guidance.
  • Track deliverables, funder restrictions, reporting conditions and spending deadlines against approved plans. Identify emerging compliance and execution risks, follow up with responsible owners and flag concerns to the Director and Finance.
  • Prepare agreement-level monthly status reports comparing progress with approved proposals, plans and budgets and Finance’s official results and forecast. Highlight variances and decisions for the supervisor’s portfolio review.
  • Coordinate resolution with accountable owners and track their corrective actions. Escalate unresolved issues, conflicting information and material variances with actionable recommendations.
  • Route proposed changes to scope, timing, deliverables or financial terms through the supervisor for approval before revised commitments are made; update plans and records after authorization.

Finance Coordination and Documentation

  • Obtain time records, milestone confirmations and supporting documentation for timely invoicing, revenue recognition and restricted-fund accounting. Check completeness, submit by Finance’s deadlines and resolve missing or inconsistent information.
  • Support Finance-led reconciliation by investigating discrepancies among agreements, operational records, completed milestones and financial reports. Program and delivery leaders certify completed work and source accuracy; Finance retains accounting and revenue-recognition decisions and official financial records.

Donor and Client Reporting and Closeout

  • Coordinate accurate program content, supporting documentation and approvals for funder and client reports. Keep relationship managers informed of progress, changes and risks; ensure they have timely updates and materials to communicate with donors and clients through established channels.
  • Maintain complete files, including executed agreements in Salesforce, approved changes, schedules, supporting documentation and submission records. Complete administrative closeout after program and Finance confirmation, documenting final reports, approvals, outstanding requirements and lessons learned.

Process Improvement and Project Support

  • Proactively identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to the supervisor using recurring issues, performance data and staff feedback. Help test and implement approved changes and assess results.
  • Maintain procedures, templates, job aids and training under the supervisor’s standards. Reinforce consistent use, address adoption gaps and adapt workflows as requirements evolve.
  • Partner with CRM enablement and Salesforce Administration on reporting needs, data gaps and system improvements; maintain assigned records in approved systems.
  • Provide operational support for donor data administration and fundraising events, as capacity permits and assigned by supervisor.
  • Support time-bound cross-functional project teams (Tiger Teams), as assigned by supervisor or COO, with a defined purpose, executive sponsor, scope, capacity plan and end date.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong grant administration, project management and organizational skills; ability to coordinate multiple agreements, contributors and deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to agreement requirements, financial documentation and reporting; ability to translate findings into clear action.
  • Proactive communication, facilitation and follow-through; ability to build accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Adaptability, curiosity and initiative in suggesting and testing process improvements; sound judgment in resolving and escalating issues.
  • Commitment to integrity, discretion, Points of Light’s mission and a collaborative, respectful workplace.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for restricted grant management from award through reporting and closeout.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating complex cross-functional projects and partnering with Finance and delivery teams on budgets, documentation and reconciliation.
  • Grant accounting experience preferred, particularly using Blackbaud for grant setup, coding, restriction tracking or financial reporting.
  • Experience developing procedures, training colleagues and implementing process improvements.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM software, Excel and project management tools (Asana preferred); familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.
  • Relevant certification or formal training in grants management, project management or process improvement (e.g., CGMS, PMP or Lean Six Sigma) preferred.
  • Ability to create a welcoming work environment for all.

Culture and Values: Points of Light has a 35-year plus history that it seeks to honor, while looking toward the future as an innovative thought leader in the social sector. We have a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Our organization values innovation, dedication, teamwork and respectfulness. We enjoy thinking big, but also working hard to deliver our best work. Our team is solution-oriented, looking for someone who is always ready to deliver on ways to solve challenges, internally and with external partners.

What We Offer:Competitive compensation and excellent benefits including a robust PTO program: 18 days of PTO (increases to 20 days after three years of service) and 10 holidays; plus, we are closed December 25-January 1. Medical, dental and vision benefits offered, free life insurance, along with long-term and short-term disability, a 403(b) program with employer match, parental leave and one day of volunteer time off per month.

Our Company

PharMerica

Overview

** This is a remote role**

The Implementation Consultant is responsible for independently leading and managing new customer implementations, change of ownership initiatives, pharmacy and facility moves, and other complex customer transition projects. This role serves as a consultative partner to customers and internal stakeholders, assessing business and operational needs, developing implementation strategies, identifying risks, recommending solutions, and guiding projects through successful completion.

The Implementation Consultant exercises discretion and independent judgment in evaluating customer requirements, interpreting operational needs, establishing project priorities, resolving complex implementation issues, and recommending appropriate courses of action. The position works collaboratively across multiple functional areas to ensure implementation solutions align with customer expectations, operational capabilities, service standards, and business objectives.

The successful candidate is highly organized, forward-thinking, analytical, and an effective communicator who takes a proactive and consultative approach to problem solving. This individual must be comfortable independently leading multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while adapting strategies based on changing customer and operational needs.

Benefits and perks for You!

  • Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts (up to $5,000 for childcare)

Overview

LMI is seeking a Software Engineer to build and deploy Army applications that connect Palantir Foundry data and services with Microsoft Power Platform workflows and user interfaces. This engineer will turn operational requirements into working applications and own delivery from design through deployment and ongoing support.

This role combines application development, data integration, and direct collaboration with Army users. You will build in Foundry and Power Platform, establish reliable interfaces between them, and make technical decisions about where data, application logic, and workflows should reside. The work requires sound engineering judgment, hands-on development, and the ability to deliver within government security and platform constraints.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Army users, data owners, and technical teams to understand operational requirements and translate them into application designs and working software.
  • Design, build, and maintain applications that connect Palantir Foundry with Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, and Power Automate.
  • Develop canvas and model-driven Power Apps, Dataverse tables and relationships, and automated business workflows.
  • Build Foundry data pipelines, transforms, ontology objects, and application components that support operational use cases.
  • Implement integrations through approved APIs, connectors, and data exchange mechanisms, including application updates to source systems where authorized.
  • Define data ownership, field mappings, identifiers, validation rules, and synchronization behavior across platforms.
  • Develop reusable code using Python, SQL, and JavaScript or TypeScript, as appropriate to the platform and application.
  • Apply authentication, authorization, and data access controls consistent with customer requirements and each platform’s security model.
  • Build error handling, logging, monitoring, and recovery processes into applications and integrations.
  • Test, document, deploy, and maintain software using version control, code reviews, and approved application lifecycle management practices.
  • Demonstrate working capabilities to users, incorporate feedback, and troubleshoot issues through resolution.
  • Document architecture, interfaces, deployment procedures, and support requirements so other engineers can maintain and extend the software.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • At least three years of relevant experience developing and supporting enterprise software, applications, or systems integrations.
  • Hands-on development experience with Palantir Foundry, including data pipelines or transforms and ontology-based applications or services.
  • Hands-on experience developing applications and workflows with Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, and Power Automate.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems using REST APIs, connectors, or other supported interfaces.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation, integration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing relational data models and mapping data between systems.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure handling of application credentials.
  • Experience testing, deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting applications or data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and software development lifecycle practices.
  • Ability to work independently, collaborate across technical disciplines, and explain technical decisions to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Active Secret clearance.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience integrating Palantir Foundry with Microsoft Dataverse or other Power Platform services.
  • Experience supporting Army Vantage or other DoD application and data environments.
  • Experience with the Dataverse Web API, Power Platform custom connectors, and application authentication services.
  • Experience managing Power Platform solutions, connection references, environment variables, deployment pipelines, and data policies.
  • Experience developing Foundry Workshop applications, ontology actions and functions, or integrations using Foundry APIs.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript for application extensions and integration development.
  • Experience with PySpark, Foundry Pipeline Builder, or Foundry Code Repositories.
  • Experience working within government security, accreditation, and deployment processes.
  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, or Spark-based processing.
  • Experience incorporating AI/ML capabilities into applications using Foundry AIP or other approved services.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

jobs.description:
About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corp, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

As a Senior Salesforce Developer – Field Service at Omnidian, you will design, develop, and optimize Salesforce Field Service solutions that power our technician experience and field operations. You'll leverage the latest Salesforce AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve technician productivity, and enhance customer experiences while building scalable, secure, and maintainable platform solutions.

You are a hands-on Salesforce engineer with deep expertise in Field Service who embraces AI-assisted development and modern engineering practices. You'll partner closely with Product, Operations, Customer Experience, and Engineering teams to deliver intelligent solutions that improve scheduling, dispatching, work execution, and operational efficiency.

What You'll Do

    At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

    Salesforce Field Service Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce Field Service solutions using native platform capabilities and custom development.
  • Configure and customize Field Service functionality, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, Dispatcher Console, and Field Service Mobile.
  • Build modern Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex services, Flows, and Platform Events that support technician and dispatcher experiences.
  • Develop mobile-first solutions that improve field technician productivity and customer service.

    • AI-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality, and automate repetitive development tasks.
  • Design and implement AI-powered Salesforce solutions using capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, and Model Builder where appropriate.
  • Build intelligent automations that improve technician recommendations, work order routing, knowledge retrieval, and operational decision-making.
  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and recommend practical use cases that improve business outcomes.
  • Partner with Product and Operations teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort and improve field service efficiency.

    • Platform Engineering

  • Develop high-quality solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, Platform Events, and Custom Metadata.
  • Balance declarative configuration with custom development to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Ensure applications meet Salesforce best practices for security, performance, scalability, and governor limits.
  • Perform code reviews, maintain automated testing, and contribute to engineering standards and platform quality.

    • Integrations & Automation

  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce Field Service and enterprise applications using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and platform-native integration capabilities.
  • Design reliable automation that supports scheduling, dispatching, technician workflows, and customer communications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational processes through intelligent automation and platform enhancements.

Who You Are

  • You're an experienced Salesforce developer with deep expertise in Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud.
  • You have embraced AI-assisted software development and use modern AI tools to improve engineering productivity and solution quality.
  • You understand how AI can enhance business workflows and customer experiences - not just generate code.
  • You know when to configure Salesforce, when to build custom solutions, and when AI capabilities can deliver business value.
  • You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while keeping user experience and operational efficiency at the center of your decisions.
  • You collaborate effectively across engineering and business teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • You mentor teammates, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve how software is built and delivered.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
  • Strong experience customizing Field Service capabilities, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Dispatcher Console, Scheduling Policies, and Field Service Mobile.
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flow, Platform Events, and Custom Metadata.
  • Experience building integrations using REST APIs and Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted software development tools (such as GitHub Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar) to improve development velocity, testing, documentation, and code quality.
  • Experience designing or implementing Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, or AI-powered automation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, governor limits, data modeling, and platform architecture.
  • Experience working in Git-based, source-driven development environments with modern CI/CD practices.
  • Proven ability to own features from design through deployment and production support.

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Salesforce Field Service Consultant certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Experience implementing Agentforce for customer service or field service use cases.
  • Experience building AI-powered technician assistants, intelligent scheduling, or knowledge retrieval solutions.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, telephony, GIS, or customer communication platforms.
  • Experience with MCP, or enterprise AI integration patterns.
  • Experience in renewable energy, utilities, asset management, or home services industries.
  • Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology organizations.

Work-Life & Culture

  • We provide outstanding benefits including family medical, dental, vision, disability, 401(k) administration and $1k match per year and thoughtful paid time off
  • We offer 12 weeks of paid parental leave to all FTE employees (birthing and non-birthing) after 1 year, and four-week paid sabbatical leave after four years
  • We offer a competitive total compensation package that includes monthly health insurance premiums, bonuses and long-term stock options for every employee
  • We love to lift each other up through company-wide slack channels such as #puppiesandpets, #omnidian-wellness, #praiseandbooms and #sustainablefuture
  • We have affinity groups to help employees feel seen and supported, such as Rainbow Array, Black Lights Matter, Neurospicy R Us, Puente and more.
  • We are a passionate, mission driven team that believes in collaboration, mutual respect and trust. For examples, come Discover our Story!

Grow with Us

  • We mentor and invest in our employees and prioritize them for future opportunities. Check out our Instagram reels to see a few career journey examples, or this Omnidian Career Experience overview on YouTube.
  • Internal candidates: Check out our advice on Internal Transfer: Job Application Process; Alums, email us after you apply.
  • Here are the roles in this career track:
  • Staff Developer
  • Principal Developer
  • We’re a fast-growing growth company, which means we’re constantly reinventing processes, adding new products, and asking people to use all of their skills and talents. That means there’s going to be a lot of opportunities for you to grow, which also means you will likely be stretched in ways you’ve never experienced in a job before. If you are resilient, determined, and not afraid of a big challenge, come apply.

Privacy

California-based candidates: To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our California Job Candidate Privacy Policy.

Diversity and Inclusion

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our customers. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to ensuring our hiring and retention practices, as well as our office culture, reflects this value.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
Omnidian is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity in the workplace. We make employment decisions on the basis of merit and business need. We hire without consideration to age, ancestry, citizenship, disability, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, national origin, political activity or affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.
We invite you to be part of our mission to create a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

About the Role

The Marketing & Demand Generation Specialist will take ownership of building and executing a structured B2B marketing program for an established technology services business. This is a hands-on role for an experienced marketer who can combine strategic thinking with practical execution across content, campaigns, demand generation, marketing automation and sales enablement.

Working closely with leadership, sales, business development and technical subject matter experts, you will strengthen brand visibility, communicate complex technology solutions clearly and create coordinated marketing activity that generates and nurtures qualified opportunities.

You will have the autonomy to assess existing marketing activities, recommend priorities and establish scalable processes while personally delivering the campaigns, content and systems required to support business growth.

About the Client

You will be working with an established, New Zealand-owned technology services provider supporting businesses with integrated IT, communications and digital solutions.

The organisation combines technical expertise with a strong understanding of commercial needs, helping customers improve productivity, security, resilience and long-term business performance. Its capabilities span managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, AI readiness and governance, Microsoft productivity solutions, business intelligence, connectivity, and voice and communications services.

With a partnership-led approach, the business works closely with customers to simplify their technology environments and deliver measurable value through practical, reliable solutions.

Ideal Profile

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in a hands-on B2B marketing, demand generation or growth marketing role.
  • Previous experience within managed services, IT services, technology or a closely related sector.
  • Proven ability to develop marketing strategy and independently execute resulting initiatives.
  • Strong experience creating B2B content for technical services and business decision-makers.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience across campaigns, segmentation, workflows, automation and reporting.
  • Experience planning and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of how brand awareness, content, lead nurturing and sales conversion work together.
  • Experience supporting sales teams with collateral, messaging and campaign insights.
  • Excellent written English and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear, engaging content.
  • Strong stakeholder interviewing, communication and collaboration skills.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.

  • Ability to operate independently in a newly established marketing role.

  • Experience with account-based marketing.
  • Experience producing customer video stories, webinars or testimonial content.
  • Practical use of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or ChatGPT for research, ideation and content workflows.
  • Experience improving proposals, presentations and document templates.

Tools & Platforms

Essential

  • HubSpot.
  • Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Canva or a comparable content-design platform.

Good to Have

  • Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI tools.
  • WordPress.
  • Apollo.io or comparable lead-sourcing platforms.
  • Analytics, SEO and other relevant marketing tools.

Key Attributes

  • Proactive and confident in recommending marketing priorities and next steps.
  • Commercially focused, with an emphasis on qualified opportunities and pipeline contribution rather than vanity metrics.
  • Comfortable establishing structure and working with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Hands-on across strategy, content, systems and execution.
  • Curious and confident when engaging technical subject matter experts.
  • Accountable for deadlines, commitments and outcomes.
  • Collaborative and effective when partnering with sales and business development teams.
  • Comfortable testing ideas, analysing results and adapting direction based on evidence.
  • Resourceful and motivated by the opportunity to build and mature a marketing function.

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Assess existing marketing activity, brand presence, audiences, content and systems.
  • Develop a practical marketing plan aligned with growth and new-business objectives.
  • Define ideal customer profiles, priority segments and key buyer personas.
  • Translate technical services, expertise and customer outcomes into compelling market-facing value propositions.
  • Recommend appropriate campaign, communication and content priorities.
  • Maintain a rolling marketing calendar covering campaigns, content, events and sales enablement.
  • Establish meaningful marketing benchmarks and reporting processes.
  • Proactively identify and recommend priorities rather than relying on individually assigned tasks.

Brand Positioning & Content

  • Develop consistent brand messaging across customer and prospect touchpoints.
  • Interview leaders, technical specialists and customers to uncover valuable insights and stories.
  • Translate technical information into accessible content for business decision-makers.
  • Produce case studies, customer success stories, LinkedIn content, articles, thought leadership, emails, newsletters, service overviews, presentations, sales collateral, guides, lead magnets, website copy, landing pages and video scripts.
  • Identify opportunities to demonstrate expertise, credibility and differentiation within the technology services market.
  • Maintain an organised, reusable content library.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of customer-facing documents and presentation templates.

Demand Generation & Campaign Management

  • Plan and execute targeted campaigns that build awareness, engage prospects and generate qualified opportunities.
  • Develop coordinated multi-channel campaigns spanning email, LinkedIn, website content and outbound follow-up.
  • Partner with sales to define campaign audiences, offers, calls to action and qualification criteria.
  • Support account-based marketing initiatives for priority prospects and segments.
  • Build nurture journeys that move prospects from awareness through to sales engagement.
  • Coordinate marketing campaigns with outbound business development activities.
  • Provide business development with relevant campaign messaging, target segments, content and follow-up sequences.
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimise activity using engagement and conversion data.

HubSpot Marketing & Automation

  • Collaborate with sales to improve CRM data quality and consistency.

Website, Search & Digital Presence

  • Test different audiences, messages, channels and content formats.
  • Use performance data and commercial outcomes to guide campaign optimisation.

Strategic Account Planning Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-stakeholder account plans aligned to each customer's business objectives. Drive measurable platform adoption, value realization, and long-term partnership growth.

Executive Engagement & Value Delivery Lead high-impact Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) with senior clinical and operational leadership. Deliver data-driven ROI narratives and strategic roadmaps that reinforce Elation's value and deepen executive sponsorship.

Renewal Management Own the full renewal lifecycle — from strategic planning and executive alignment to contract negotiation and timely close. Maintain a strong, predictable renewal rate across your book of business.

Strategic Expansion & Whitespace Management Act as the primary commercial lead for your portfolio, directly driving and executing the end-to-end sales cycle for all cross-sell and upsell transactions. You will proactively pursue and close whitespace opportunities by translating usage data, clinical workflows, and organizational growth signals into prioritized expansion strategies that result in realized revenue and increased account penetration.

Proactive Risk Mitigation Monitor customer health signals and leverage AI-driven insights to identify at-risk accounts early. Develop and execute tailored mitigation plans to address risk and protect long-term retention.

Product Adoption & Utilization Drive deep feature adoption across your portfolio through targeted campaigns and high-impact interventions. Partner with product and clinical teams to ensure customers are maximizing the full value of the Elation platform.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Implementation, Professional Services, Sales, and Technical Support to deliver a seamless, world-class customer journey from onboarding through renewal and beyond.

Consultative Selling Act as a consultative partner — identifying evolving customer needs and effectively presenting the value of Elation Health's expanding suite of products and services.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing growth role, with at least 2+ years focused on mid-market and enterprise accounts in healthcare SaaS, EHR, or RCM platforms
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and navigating large healthcare organizations
  • Prior experience owning expansion revenue, renewals, and upsell/cross-sell motions within an existing book of business
  • Familiarity with ambulatory, specialty, multi-site group practices, or enterprise health systems

Skills & Competencies

  • Executive presence and the ability to influence and build trust with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders
  • Strong full-cycle, consultative selling instincts — comfortable identifying needs, building business cases, and presenting solutions
  • Proficiency in data storytelling: translating platform usage, outcomes data, and ROI metrics into compelling customer narratives
  • Skilled in clinical use case framing to connect platform capabilities to physician and operational workflows
  • Experience with lifecycle automation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and customer health monitoring solutions

Mindset

  • Strategic thinker who balances long-term relationship building with near-term revenue accountability
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing a complex book of business with competing priorities
  • Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — you thrive working with sales, product, and services teams

How We Measure Success

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Expansion and upsell pipeline and close rate
  • Renewal rate and on-time renewal %

  • Executive engagement and EBR completion rate

Although several large digital ad platforms already exist, advertisers are being increasingly drawn to Reddit because of our passionate communities. We believe our community-centric platform has created the opportunity for Reddit to build a highly differentiated ads business.

About the Ads Data Science Team:

The Ads Data Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize advertiser value on Reddit through robust data foundations, metrics, and strategic insights generated through experimentation and cutting-edge DS methods.

We work on a wide range of challenging problems in the areas of ads and platform measurement, campaign and creative management, advertiser growth and retention, monetization, and the intersection of brand and community engagement. We are a highly collaborative team of passionate data scientists and engineers who are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with machine learning and statistical modeling.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our growing Ads Data Science team. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing as well as applying cutting-edge DS models/methods to improve the adoption and performance of our advertising platform through data-driven insights. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other data scientists to identify opportunities, define metrics, and build solutions that drive significant impact for Reddit.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and apply DS solutions to inform improvements in advertiser experience and Reddit's ad platform
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can be used to improve the effectiveness of our advertising platform
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and translate them into data science solutions
  • Develop ML models & DS methods to improve anomaly detection, prediction, & pattern recognition
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in machine learning and data science
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists on the team

Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field such as: Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or Operations Research
  • For M.S. holders: 5+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • For Ph.D. holders: 4+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • Platform experience and a deep understanding of the ads ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, causal inference and experimental design
  • Experience with large-scale data processing and analysis using tools such as Spark, Hadoop, or Hive; knowledge of BigQuery a plus
  • Proficiency in Python or R and experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Passion for Reddit and the online advertising industry

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with online advertising and ad tech
  • Experience with causal inference and A/B testing
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications in relevant conferences or journals

jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Principal AI Process Orchestrator is a key role. This is the person who decides what work humans do and what work AI does, and then designs and ships the systems that make both happen.

You will front every engagement. You will earn trust with the client’s executive team in week one. You will lead the work from workflow audit to shipped automation. You will carry 3-4 concurrent clients and lead Associate Orchestrators through implementation.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We are not hiring a manager. We are hiring the sharpest business analyst you know, the one who also spends their weekends building AI agents and has strong opinions about which tool to use for which job.

Job Description:

  • Lead client engagements end-to-end: You are the face of the engagement. You sit across from the client’s COO or CEO in week one, not week six. You own the weekly update, the monthly business review, and the strategic direction of the work.
  • Map the business: In the first 30 days of any engagement, you learn how work flows through the client’s organization. You produce an opportunity map that identifies the 5-10 workflows where AI can materially change the economics of the business.
  • Design the future state: For the 2-3 workflows selected for transformation, you design the rewired version. What humans do. What agents do. Where the handoffs live. What the evals look like. How success is measured.
  • Ship the implementation: You scope the work, direct the Associate Orchestrators on the engagement, review their output, and ship the first automation to production within 60 days of engagement start.
  • Grow the engagement: You identify when a client needs a Build pod, a Rescue, or ongoing Support, and pull the right Creative Chaos resource in. Transformation is the front door. You open the rest of the house.
  • Own the outcome: You report on measurable client impact: hours saved, error rates reduced, throughput gained. Numbers, not narratives.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience as a business analyst, solutions engineer, or technical consultant in software delivery, product, or enterprise SaaS. You have sat between business stakeholders and technical teams. You have interviewed users, mapped workflows, written specs, and owned the result. You are on an individual contributor track and not looking to manage people.
  • Deeply AI-native: Not “uses ChatGPT daily.” You have built and deployed real agents. You use Claude Code as a daily tool, not a curiosity. You have opinions about Cursor vs. Windsurf, LangChain vs. LlamaIndex, and which MCP to use when, because you have actually tried all of them. You can name the right tool for the right job and defend the choice.
  • Portfolio over resume: You can show us a GitHub, side projects, deployed agents, and public writing on what you have built. We do not hire anyone who cannot show us what they have built with their own hands. A resume is not enough. A repo is.
  • Business-native English and executive poise: You have worked with or inside US or Western companies. You can run a stakeholder workshop with twelve people in the room without losing control of it. When you walk into a US CEO’s office, you command the meeting from minute one.
  • Curious and hungry: You learn a new tool every week on your own time. When you are given a well-understood problem, you dig into something adjacent that nobody asked you to look at. You built something last weekend because you wanted to see if you could.

How we hire

This is a portfolio hire, not a resume hire.

Portfolio review: We read everything before we talk to you. If the work is not there, there is no interview.

Technical conversation: 45 minutes. We walk through your agent, your design decisions, and the tools you reached for.

Live exercise: 48 hours. We share a real workflow from one of our portfolio companies. You design how you would rewire it, map the humans-vs-agents split, and sketch the 30/60/90 implementation plan.

Final conversation with the Leader: 60 minutes. Direct, a go or no-go decision within 48 hours.

What Creative Chaos offers

- Direct access to the managing partner and a small senior team

- A clean mandate: you own the engagement, we clear the path

- Best-in-class tooling: Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, and every agent framework worth trying

- The chance to define a new category of work before the market has a name for it

- Compensation open and based on capability and experience
