Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America's promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: We organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners' capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together.

We've built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other's wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven Senior Engineering Manager who believes that great products emerge from strong teams? Do you have a curiosity and passion for bringing related areas together and coaching people of different backgrounds and technical expertise into a cohesive, collaborative team? Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

The Murmuration Engineering Team is seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to grow and develop the multidisciplinary team (DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps) that builds and maintains the shared systems that all of our teams depend on. Your guidance and influence on this team will raise the bar across the engineering organization.

Murmuration builds technology that helps our partner organizations strengthen civic engagement and organize more effectively in their communities. Our products weave together engagement, outreach, demographic, and voter data into intuitive applications that help partners better understand and act within the communities they serve. Our team is intentionally multidisciplinary and partner-focused. We succeed together by aligning planning, execution, and learning across engineering, product, design, research, data, and partner success. We build complex, data-driven systems that need to work reliably during critical moments, scale as our partners grow, and remain understandable and maintainable as communities and their needs evolve.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you'll join the Platform Team to support both production and prototype applications and the services they're built upon. You'll coach and grow a small, cross-discipline team that owns the outcomes for the org's build/deploy/run systems, with accountability for other teams' ability to ship fast, safely, and reliably. The team’s disciplines span DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps domains.

Your leadership actively shapes the team's operating model, evolving it to serve the Engineering organization's current and future needs. Your strategic thinking turns vision into sequenced deliverables and adapts as priorities shift without losing sight of where the team is headed. Your commitment to high-quality documentation improves knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term product maintainability across Murmuration.

Your ability to work across engineering teams, understanding their goals and shaping the org's engineering roadmap around them, is key to making the Platform Team successful.

This role suits a deeply experienced Senior Engineering Manager who can evaluate where we are today, absorb shifts in direction, and keep us on track. Your commitment to building inclusive, high-trust, high-performing teams is visible across the technology organization. And you believe, as we do, that how we build is just as important as what we build.

Job Level: M4

Drive & Model

  • Shape technical strategy for the team: Build an engineering roadmap that keeps the team focused on big-picture objectives and that reflects tradeoffs among competing priorities, dependencies, and complexities across DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps. Propose clear recommendations and plans, and present well-reasoned documentation of tradeoffs and alternatives.
  • Manage technical debt and process health: Maintain a steady cadence of debt paydown, prioritizing which debt to tackle and communicating the reasoning behind those choices. Own the schedule of dependency and application updates so end-of-life deadlines are handled proactively rather than as last-minute fire drills.
  • Deliver production-ready platforms: Own the platforms and tooling that give other teams a stable, observable foundation of reliability, performance, and operational excellence so they can focus on building and testing their own applications on top of it.
  • Strengthen application security: Introspect codebases to identify vulnerabilities early, and own data privacy and access control as first-class concerns; deliver solutions that support secure coding practices across the org without owning how other teams write their code.
  • Enable FinOps visibility: Build and own the single panes of glass that give engineering leadership and the C-suite a clear, trusted view of cloud and infrastructure costs, supporting both short-term budget decisions and long-term cost strategy.
  • Architect for the long term: Design and build systems and architectures that will serve Murmuration for years with scale, reliability, security, and maintainability as first-class concerns.

Elevate the Team

  • Coach and empower emerging leaders: Coach leaders to lead at every level: Within their own teams, as good, collaborative, and experienced peers, and through mentoring ICs around them.
  • Resolve ambiguity: Actively shape and bring structure and clarity (not perfection) to specs.
  • Listen and elevate: Stay closely attuned to how other teams approach test strategy, code quality, and system design, and use that insight to ensure that what our team builds and delivers elevates their developer journey.
  • Be like Ted Lasso: Believe, coach the whole team, build trust, and demonstrate kindness, empathy, optimism, curiosity, and vulnerability.

Lead Beyond Platform

  • Lead beyond the Platform team: Own objectives that span multiple teams and align with division and organizational goals.
  • Be the voice: Lead with ownership and accountability on behalf of DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps; seek opportunities to add clarity, make high-quality recommendations, and be a decision-maker in discussions with product and leadership.
  • Identify risk: Identify, document, and follow-up in a timely manner on vulnerabilities and operational risk across the full platform, including applications built by other teams.
  • Lead incident response: Involve the right people across DevOps, App Security, SRE and FinOps, lead the response, conduct root cause analysis, and follow through until learnings are shared, incorporated, and remediation is complete.

Build with Vision

  • Build one internal engineering system, not four Platform teams: Treat DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps as interdependent subsystems where the outcome depends on how well they integrate, not how well each performs alone.
  • Present a cohesive voice and narrative externally: Lead with expertise and a cohesive single voice about the Platform Team’s mission and deliverables to our peer teams.
  • Be curious about people, not just systems: Identify opportunities to foster curiosity and ease communication between people who come from different backgrounds, experiences, and technical lenses.
  • Use AI to amplify: Surface risks and gaps that manual review would miss, and measure team progress together towards shared goals.

Requirements

Technical Depth and Judgement

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across DevOps and SRE: Your direct prior experience informs your approach to prioritizing competing work, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and explaining how a decision in DevOps, SRE, AppSec, or FinOps supports the organization as a whole.
  • Sound judgment under imperfect information: Make tradeoff calls to generate clarity in ambiguous situations.
  • Communicates effectively: Explain to non-technical leadership why an architecture decision is sound without needing the original author in the room.
  • Champions team decisions: Advocate for the team's technical decisions to peers, product, and leadership.

Scope, Initiative, and Execution

  • Lead execution at scale: Lead technical execution for initiatives spanning multiple teams or systems, balancing quality, performance, and cost while keeping stakeholders aligned on tradeoffs and risks.
  • Turn strategy into shipped deliverables: Translate objectives aligned with division and organizational goals into clear epics, stories, and tickets, anticipating technical challenges and proposing solutions before they become blockers.
  • Plan through ambiguity: Estimate large, cross-team projects with unknowns, building mitigation plans for what’s unresolved, and breaking work into milestones and iterations to reduce risk and deliver incremental value.
  • Drive to completion: Involve decision makers, delegate clearly, communicate consistently, and follow through as an owner, in a timely manner, until an outcome is delivered.
  • Multiply team effectiveness: Use technical leadership, tooling, infrastructure, and process improvements to multiply the impact of both the Platform Team and the Engineering organization.

Organizational Impact

  • Influence beyond the team: Shape outcomes beyond your own team through role modeling, documentation, and advocacy.
  • Mentor future leaders: Develop future technical leaders, building their judgment, ownership, and skills through 1:1 guidance and small-group knowledge sharing.
  • Raise the engineering bar: Drive the standards and best practices that raise the bar across the organization, creating processes that instill ownership behavior in others.
  • Lead by example: Proactively share context and learnings with an eye to creating the kind of high-trust, high-performing team culture that makes everyone better.

What You Bring to the Table

Foundations

  • 10+ years of professional software manager engineering experience with demonstrated fluency across infrastructure, systems, and application layers, and a track record of delivering in production across a variety of languages, tools, and technology stacks.
  • A quality-driven mindset with experience writing, maintaining, and driving infrastructure and deployment safety checks at the team or product level.
  • A track record of effective collaboration with product, data science, and R&D teams, bridging technical and domain-specific perspectives across disciplines.

DevOps

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices.
  • Production experience with AWS, including compute, storage, and networking services.
  • Proficiency with Docker, Make, or similar build tools, as well as environment scripting.
  • Fluency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) across AWS, GCP, and Azure providers sufficient to evaluate design decisions, not just approve them.

App Security

  • Experience driving secure coding practices, data privacy principles, and access control patterns as applied in production systems.
  • Familiarity with security practices such as vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and secure SDLC.
  • Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, NIST CSF) and how they shape engineering decisions.

SRE

  • Deep experience with cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and production-grade software at scale.
  • Direct experience with observability tooling (logging, metrics, and tracing) using tools such as Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Working knowledge of incident management practices: On-call rotations, escalation, and postmortem processes.

FinOps

  • Familiarity with cloud cost and billing platforms sufficient to build tooling that supports both short- and long-term budget decisions.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Voter File Data;
  • Experience with or interest in political data; and/or
  • A background in political tech, civic tech, advocacy, or mission-driven organizations.

Talented Senior Engineering Managers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

This is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package, open

to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $228,497. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar.
jobs.description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

We are seeking a Design Engineer to create PV power plant designs for projects from early stages of the project life cycle to detailed engineering for construction. Design Engineers are capable of creating highly detailed array layouts based on project site conditions, customer preferences, and their own knowledge of current technologies during the conceptual stages to optimize the value of the project. During the detailed engineering phase of the project, the Design Engineer will coordinate with internal and external resources as needed to generate the engineering package, obtain necessary construction permits, and assist in construction administration during the installation of the system.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience in utility power plant scale solar PV systems design, a knack for problem solving, is comfortable in dynamic situations, and detail-oriented. Experience in AutoCAD and Civil 3D is a must.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Follow standards and goals for the engineering department
  • Assist in documenting and developing industry best practices, standards and guidelines
  • Attend project meetings, develop reports and status of design deliverables
  • Prepares detailed mechanical, electrical, civil, and structural designs for solar arrays
  • Coordinates with Project Managers, and other project participants to define project design basis and project goals
  • Work with internal and external design and engineering partners:
  • Architecting and developing detailed design documentation including System Architecture Diagrams, Device Points List, IP lists, Logic Diagrams, etc.
  • Uses understanding of system performance, construction logistics, material and labor costs to optimize designs
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining design packages
  • Adopts necessary document control measures to manage internal and external design documentation
  • Creates Bills of Materials for projects
  • Holds design review meetings with internal and external parties as needed to maintain proper QC/QA on their projects
  • Assists in development of departmental processes and best practices for the team

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or related field
  • Ability to effectively communicate with team members and business partners
  • Minimum of 3 years project engineering experience in the design/build, EPC or utility SCADA solar (PV) and Battery (BESS) generation field producing technical CAD documents
  • Experience with communications architectural design
  • Proficient AutoCAD skills, SolidWorks is a plus
  • Working knowledge of electrical and SCADA design, materials and methods of installation
  • Experience in the solar PV industry or other power generation sectors, and experience creating utility scale permitting and construction documents
  • Working knowledge of communications and network design principles
  • Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Participated in or led continued improvement/lessons learned programs

Benefits

Compensation And Benefits

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Range: $85,000 - $105,000 (DOE). Within each posted range, individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher), dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Terabase offers competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Generous time off and holiday policy

• Remote flexibility

• Flexible time off

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Career progression

• 401k match

• Stock options

• Home office set up allowance

• And much more!

Terabase is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

We do not discriminate for any reason including race, color, sex, gender, age, religion or religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military/ veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our products, the diverse consumers we represent, and the communities we call home.

Principles only. This role is not open to receiving agency candidates, and any contingent submissions will not be considered. Terabase Energy does not utilize third-party recruitment agencies. Please contact our Recruiting team at with any staffing-related inquiries.

jobs.title: Design & Presentations Internship | Fall 2026
jobs.excerpt: Brilliant Agency, one of the most respected and rapidly growing agencies focused on family-oriented brands, seeks a REMOTE Design & Presentations Intern, 15 hours a week to help support the agency’s growing, award-winning team beginning June 1 and ending December 18.
jobs.description:
Brilliant Agency, one of the most respected and rapidly growing agencies focused on family-oriented brands, seeks a REMOTE Design & Presentations Intern, 15 hours a week to help support the agency’s growing, award-winning team beginning June 1 and ending December 18.

Who We Are:

So what’s Brilliant all about? We are a unique Marketing agency with nearly 25 team members across the US. We give our team the resources they need to get their work done without having to sit in a cubicle or stuffy office. From costume contests to virtual happy hours and Slack GIFs, we prioritize connecting with each other and creating a sense of community.

What We Do:

We specialize in PR, Influencer, and Social Media services for consumer lifestyle brands across a variety of categories including baby/maternity, toys/games, food/beverage, and CPG.

Our Dream Team Member:

  • Resourceful, committed, and deliberate
  • Strong eye for design, layout, and visual storytelling
  • Able to translate a specific vision into clean, compelling slides for more visual storytelling
  • Comfortable working in Canva (presentations + graphics)
  • Understands how to simplify information visually (not just make things “look good”)
  • Detail-oriented with typography, spacing, and consistency
  • Open to feedback and quick iterations
  • Interested in how design supports strategy, storytelling, and client work
  • Excited about building a strong career foundation to build from post graduation.
  • Video and post-production editing capabilities not required but a PLUS!

Job Description:

We have two internship sessions – Spring/Summer (January - May/August) and Fall/Winter (June or August - December) – and many interns end up staying for multiple sessions. Active interns get first pick for the following semester internship spots!

This isn’t an internship to organize files or provide admin support. Your work will provide a meaningful contribution to Brilliant as an agency and to its clients. You will receive true agency experience with opportunities to collaborate with different departments and exposure to agency life should that be a long-term career path you want to explore. With that, it is critical that interns can meet deadlines, respond to messages in a timely manner, and be proactive in communicating with their team.

Potential Responsibilities Include:

Presentation & Slide Design:

  • Translate team ideas, outlines, and data into clean, visually compelling slides
  • Build and update presentations using Brilliant templates in Canva
  • Help improve slide structure, flow, and clarity for internal and client decks
  • Turn messy content into polished, easy-to-understand visuals

Graphic Design Support:

  • Create simple graphics for internal and client needs (social mockups, one-pagers, etc.)

Creative Collaboration:

  • Work with account teams to bring ideas to life visually
  • Share ideas for improving templates and design systems

Internship Structure:

  • Summer/Fall Session (2026): starting June 1 (or sooner) and ending December 18

While these are our preferred timelines, we are still flexible with potential start and end dates based on candidate availability.

Requirements for a successful candidate include:

  • You must be a rising sophomore, junior or senior.
  • Experience using Canva (required)
  • Intermediate understanding of presentation design and layout
  • Ability to work from a template and also improve upon it
  • Portfolio or sample work (presentations or graphics)
  • Ability to commit to at least 15 hours a week during office hours, 8–5 in your time zone
  • Professional demeanor and a drive to succeed
  • Eagerness to learn and willingness to ask questions
  • Resourceful attitude and keen attention to detail

***Prior to applying for this position, please contact your College or University Career Center and verify that you are eligible to receive College Credits for an Internship although accepting credit hours is not necessary to accept an offer. If selected, Brilliant will reimburse you $250 each month for using your personal cell phone, computer, and home internet.***

jobs.title: Physician Advisory Services QA Specialist
jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYThe QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.

The QA Specialist is responsible for the timely completion and overall completeness of a reviewer report. Completeness is determined by customer requirements, company best practices, and clinical accuracy. In addition, the QA Specialist participates in improving DS processes and works with the Manager to ensure high efficiencies are achieved.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Interaction

  • Provides regular report status updates to the client.
  • Evaluates the Quality of physician’s report and determines if the report will meet all client and jurisdictional standards; the QA Specialist is also responsible for ensuring that the clinical rationale supports the physician’s determinations.
  • Clarifies ambiguous report questions with clients.
  • Distribute final report back to client according to client specific requirements.
  • Receives, coordinates & executes all aspects of clarification & addendum requests from the client.
  • Participates in phone calls OR meetings with client(s) when a report is in question.
  • Follow up with the client for any missing information that is pertinent to the referral.

Physician Interaction

  • Works directly with physicians to ensure that all client questions are answered and supported by clinical rationale.
  • Conduct regular follow up with the physician or their office staff to ensure an on-time delivery of the report.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written feedback to the doctor regarding report quality.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written requests to the physician or their office staff for clarifications.
  • Receive written or verbal confirmation from the physician that a report has the doctor’s approval and ensures the doctor provides his/her signature for the final report.

Report Analysis

  • Review each physician report for data accuracy including spelling, grammar & punctuation.
  • Responsible for ensuring that all state requirements for reporting are met.
  • Responsible for report format and adhering to each client’s specific requirements.
  • Must ensure that all client special handling instructions with regard to report completion and delivery are met.

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

An Associate’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a healthcare and/or insurance setting is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

jobs.description:
Full Stack Engineer

Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Technology | Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients—a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses—is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and scale the technology powering its marketing, lead generation, tracking, and revenue operations.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a strategy-only engineering position.

You’ll work across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • Internal dashboards and operational tools

You’ll work directly with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn real business problems into production-ready systems that improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.

If you’re a strong full-stack engineer who understands both software engineering and performance marketing technology, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack & Internal Tool Development — Primary Focus

Build, deploy, and maintain internal applications using:

  • Next.js
  • React
  • Python

You’ll:

  • Develop marketing dashboards and reporting systems
  • Build internal operational tools used by media buyers and teams
  • Replace repetitive manual workflows with scalable software
  • Develop reliable backend services and integrations
  • Take systems from concept through production deployment
  • Continuously improve tools based on real user and campaign needs

Marketing Data, Tracking & Attribution — Core Focus

Own and improve the technical infrastructure connecting advertising performance to actual business outcomes.

You’ll:

  • Implement and optimize Meta Pixel
  • Work hands-on with Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Configure accurate event tracking
  • Handle event deduplication
  • Improve attribution accuracy
  • Troubleshoot tracking discrepancies
  • Build pipelines connecting:

Ad Platforms → Backend Systems → CRM → Reporting Dashboards

Develop reporting systems that give teams visibility into metrics such as:

  • ROAS
  • CPL
  • CAC
  • Conversion rates
  • Lead quality
  • Campaign performance

AI Integration & Marketing Automation

Build AI directly into live marketing and operational workflows.

Use APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms to develop systems for:

  • Ad copy generation
  • Creative ideation
  • Lead scoring
  • Lead qualification
  • Campaign analysis
  • Performance insights
  • Automated reporting
  • Operational workflow automation

This role requires someone who actively uses modern AI tools—not someone with only theoretical exposure.

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation — Critical

Integrate and automate CRM platforms such as:

  • GoHighLevel
  • Close CRM
  • HubSpot
  • Similar CRM systems

Build workflows connecting the entire lead lifecycle:

Lead Capture → CRM → Routing → Follow-Up → Pipeline → Conversion → Attribution

You’ll also:

  • Automate lead routing and assignment
  • Build pipeline management workflows
  • Configure webhooks and API integrations
  • Sync CRM conversion outcomes back to advertising platforms
  • Support offline conversion and CAPI event tracking

jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build industry-first products that make retirement accounts simple and easy for employers to support and participants to use. You will collaborate with domain experts to design, build and test new features and systems. As reliability and auditability is key to earning our customers’ trust, you will build robust systems that are observable, maintainable, and scalable. As an engineering organization, we:

  • Value continuous improvement - we care about documentation, security, durability, not just throwing features over the wall.
  • Help each other be better engineers - we leave things better than we found it.
  • Aspire to collaborate seamlessly - we ensure our software is improving the customer experience.

What you get to do every day

  • Design, build, and maintain our user experiences for both external and internal customers
  • Work on business-critical, foundational services which serve as the data funnel of our entire platform
  • Improve complex processes and systems to make them more robust and require less human intervention
  • Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to share knowledge and build expertise
  • Develop ownership over domains in our system and make informed engineering tradeoffs
  • Advocate for and delight internal and external users
  • Direct AI agents across the full development lifecycle, from prototyping and implementation to debugging and code review. Operate as the architect and decision-maker while AI handles the building
  • Expand what's possible with AI tooling and identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work, improve code quality through AI-driven review, and share effective patterns with your team

What you bring to the role

  • 6+ years of experience building and maintaining software in production
  • Desire to work with the following technologies: Node, TypeScript, Kotlin, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Kafka
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Claude Code and Cursor) to accelerate development cycles and improve code quality.
  • Top notch communication skills. You can communicate well with engineers and non-engineers alike
  • Strong desire to learn, think creatively, and share knowledge with others
  • Enjoy mentoring other engineers and deeply review their code
  • Proactive and empathetic mindset - you love to roll up your sleeves to fix problems for our customers
  • Past experience working in startups and/or fintech

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.

jobs.description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. NeuralMesh by WEKA sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud- and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

About the role

WEKA is looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and go-to-market for Augmented Memory Grid (AMG), part of the NeuralMesh platform. This is a deeply technical PM role sitting at the intersection of AI inference infrastructure, high-performance networking, and enterprise storage. You will work directly with engineering, GPU/inference partners (NVIDIA, hyperscalers, GPU clouds), and enterprise customers running large-scale LLM inference to define what AMG needs to do next.

Bring Your Expertise – and Your Passion

  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership skills with a history of successfully leading cross-functional teams. Product Managers are expected to inspire and motivate team members to achieve ambitious goals while maintaining a collaborative and positive working environment. You understand how to influence without authority, and your recall of meaningful details supports verbal and written agility.
  • Strategic Vision: You are a strategic thinker who can develop and execute product strategies that align with market trends and customer needs, as well as think critically about existing strategies. You have a proven ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and deliver results.
  • Communication Skills: You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable presenting product strategies and roadmaps to internal teams and external customers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the AMG product roadmap: KV-cache/prefix-cache offload, memory tiering, and integration with inference engines and orchestration layers (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Kubernetes-based serving).
  • Partner with engineering to define architecture trade-offs across GPU memory, networking (RDMA, GPUDirect, NVMe-oF), and distributed storage — translating inference performance bottlenecks (time-to-first-token, throughput, context length) into product requirements.
  • Work directly with enterprise customers and GPU cloud partners: Nebius, CoreWeave, TogetherAI, etc., running production inference workloads to gather requirements, validate benchmarks, and prioritize features that reduce cost-per-token and improve SLAs at scale.
  • Partner with NVIDIA and other silicon/inference-stack partners on joint roadmap and certification work.
  • Define and track benchmarks (TTFT, throughput, cache hit rate) that demonstrate AMG's value versus standard GPU-memory-only inference.
  • Support sales and field teams with technical positioning, competitive differentiation, and enterprise deal support.

Must-have qualifications

  • Inference ecosystem depth: hands-on product or engineering experience with LLM inference serving — vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Ray Serve, or comparable — and fluency in concepts like KV-cache, prefix/context caching, quantization, and batching strategies.
  • Model & systems familiarity: working knowledge of how modern LLMs are served in production (context windows, multi-tenant serving, GPU scheduling) well enough to translate model-level constraints into infrastructure requirements.
  • Networking/infrastructure fluency: comfort with the fundamentals of high-performance networking and distributed systems — RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, NVMe-oF, or equivalent — and how they affect inference performance.
  • Enterprise customer experience: track record working directly with large enterprise accounts — requirements gathering, production deployments, SLAs — not solely self-serve/PLG products.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, ideally with some portion in infrastructure, ML platforms, or developer-facing technical products.

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience at a GPU cloud, inference platform, or AI infrastructure startup.
  • Familiarity with storage systems (parallel/distributed file systems, object storage) in AI/ML pipelines.
  • Experience partnering directly with NVIDIA or other accelerator/silicon vendors.

The WEKA Way:

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility & ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned that you don’t meet every qualification above?

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified. At WEKA, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned that your past work experience doesn’t match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.

WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

The Sargent & Lundy Consulting (SLC) group provides comprehensive technical, financial, and strategic advisory services for energy sector clients, including utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), project developers, lenders, investors, government agencies, and system operators.

As part of our team, you will help clients navigate the energy transition from new generation and grid modernization to data center energy campus development and strategic planning. In this role, you will help clients define and execute strategies for new and existing power projects and support clients with improving their business operations. jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Military DoD SkillBridge program is an opportunity for Service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through specific industry training, apprenticeships, or internships during the last 180 days of service. SkillBridge connects Service members with industry partners in real-world job experiences under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322.29. Separating Service members can be granted up to 180 days of permissive duty to focus solely on training full-time with approved industry partners after unit commander (first O-4/Field Grade commander in chain of command) provides written authorization and approval. GE Aerospace as a Skill Bridge partner offers real-world training and work experience in in-demand fields of work while having the opportunity to evaluate the Service member’s suitability for the work. Military DoD SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from GE Aerospace, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as active-duty service members.

Job Description

The Senior Operations Planning Analyst is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving production and operations schedules that support customer demand, business priorities, and execution performance. This role partners closely with operations, supply chain, materials, manufacturing, sourcing, logistics, and program teams to align schedules with capacity, material availability, and shop readiness. The role requires strong analytical capability, operating rigor, and proactive problem solving to identify schedule risks, drive recovery actions, and improve Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost outcomes.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Own development, maintenance, and execution support of production and operations schedules for assigned value streams, product lines, programs, or sites
  • Translate demand, backlog, forecast, and business priorities into executable schedules aligned with capacity, labor, material availability, and operational constraints
  • Analyze schedule attainment, loading, throughput, bottlenecks, and resource constraints to identify risks and recommend corrective actions
  • Partner with manufacturing, materials, sourcing, logistics, quality, and program teams to align schedules with operational readiness and customer commitments
  • Lead schedule reviews and planning routines to communicate priorities, risks, constraints, and recovery plans
  • Monitor schedule adherence, past due orders, recovery progress, and output performance; escalate issues that may impact delivery or business commitments
  • Perform scenario analysis to evaluate schedule options, tradeoffs, and impacts to capacity, fulfillment, and customer delivery
  • Drive schedule stabilization through improved planning logic, operating discipline, and cross-functional action management
  • Develop and maintain planning dashboards, reports, and metrics related to schedule attainment, backlog, constraint management, and on-time delivery
  • Support operating cadences including daily management, weekly reviews, and leadership updates with clear, data-driven insights
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to improve schedule accuracy, flow, visibility, and predictability

Required Qualifications

jobs.description:
UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a UX/UI Designer to create intuitive, visually polished, and high-performing digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is more than a visual design role. You’ll own the design process from user research and UX strategy through wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and leadership to understand user problems and translate them into digital experiences that are easy to use, scalable, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution and enjoy solving real product problems through design, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & UX Strategy

  • Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioral analysis
  • Identify user needs, pain points, and friction across digital experiences
  • Translate research into:
    • Personas
    • User journeys
    • User flows
    • Information architecture
    • Wireframes
  • Use behavioral and analytics tools such as:
    • Hotjar
    • FullStory
    • Google Analytics
  • Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to identify UX opportunities
  • Recommend improvements based on user behavior, research, and product goals

Wireframing & Prototyping

  • Create low-fidelity wireframes to validate concepts and workflows
  • Build interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review
  • Develop high-fidelity product mockups using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Rapidly iterate based on:
    • User testing
    • Stakeholder feedback
    • QA findings
  • Clearly communicate interaction patterns and intended product behavior
  • Move concepts efficiently from early exploration to production-ready design

UI & Product Design

  • Design clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces
  • Create responsive experiences across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Balance usability, aesthetics, accessibility, and business objectives
  • Design user flows and conversion paths that minimize friction
  • Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and layout principles
  • Ensure interfaces are visually polished and production-ready
  • Maintain consistency across features and product experiences

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries
  • Establish consistent standards for:
    • Typography
    • Color
    • Spacing
    • Layouts
    • Components
    • Interaction patterns
  • Create reusable components that improve design and development efficiency
  • Maintain organized design files, assets, specifications, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency across products, features, and platforms
  • Evolve design systems as product requirements grow

Accessibility & Usability

  • Apply WCAG accessibility standards throughout the design process
  • Consider:
    • Contrast
    • Readability
    • Keyboard accessibility
    • Responsiveness
    • Overall usability
  • Conduct usability reviews
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows
  • Improve:
    • Task completion
    • Navigation
    • Conversion paths
    • Overall product usability
  • Incorporate accessibility into designs from the beginning rather than treating it as a final check

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Product Managers
    • Developers
    • QA
    • Leadership
  • Participate in sprint planning, product discussions, and feature prioritization
  • Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation rather than only at handoff
  • Deliver developer-ready designs using:
    • Figma Dev Mode
    • Zeplin
    • InVision Inspect
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and interaction documentation
  • Review implemented designs
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies before release
  • Help ensure the final product accurately reflects the intended user experience

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional UX/UI or Product Design experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • UI craftsmanship
    • Responsive design
    • Product design thinking
  • Advanced proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
    • Responsive layouts
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX and usability principles
    • Interaction design
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
    • Mobile-first design
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to clearly explain and defend design decisions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote product environment
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS products
    • Mobile applications
    • E-commerce platforms
  • Experience building or maintaining scalable design systems
  • Familiarity with:
    • HTML/CSS fundamentals
    • Developer workflows
    • Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as:
    • Hotjar
    • FullStory
    • Google Analytics
  • Experience conducting A/B tests or design experiments
  • Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience collaborating directly with engineering teams through implementation

Tools & Technology

Figma | Figma Dev Mode | Adobe XD | Sketch | Zeplin | InVision Inspect | Hotjar | FullStory | Google Analytics | HTML/CSS | Design Systems | Prototyping & Usability Testing Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Think about user journeys and product problems, not just individual screens
  • Combine strong visual design skills with practical UX thinking
  • Can clearly explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
  • Are comfortable using research and data to challenge assumptions
  • Understand how UX impacts adoption, engagement, conversion, and satisfaction
  • Collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Care about consistency, accessibility, and the small details that make products feel polished
  • Can iterate quickly without sacrificing design quality
  • Understand how designs translate into real products during development
  • Take ownership from initial research through final implementation

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing user behavior, product feedback, or upcoming feature requirements to identify UX opportunities and potential friction.

Throughout the day, you could create user flows and wireframes, build and test interactive prototypes, design polished interfaces in Figma, or refine the product’s design system.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering during sprint execution, incorporate feedback from usability testing and QA, and prepare developer-ready designs with clear specifications and interaction details.

You’ll also review implemented features to ensure the final experience maintains the intended design quality and consistency.

In short: you turn user needs and business requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital products.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved product usability and user satisfaction
  • Increased engagement and product adoption
  • Reduced friction across critical user journeys
  • Improved task completion and conversion flows
  • Consistent implementation of design systems
  • Reduced design-related development revisions
  • On-time delivery of developer-ready designs
  • Strong accessibility and responsive design standards
  • High-quality implementation of approved designs
  • Positive feedback from users and internal stakeholders

Why This Role Stands Out

  • End-to-end ownership of UX and UI design
  • Opportunity to influence real product strategy and user experience
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering leadership
  • Opportunity to build and improve scalable design systems
  • Use of research and analytics to influence product decisions
  • Hands-on involvement from discovery through implementation
  • Fully remote environment aligned with U.S. clients
  • Strong career progression into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead UX/UI Designer
    • Design Systems Lead
    • Head of Product Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Portfolio Review + Practical Design Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have a strong UX/UI portfolio, are highly proficient in Figma, and can take a product from research and wireframes through polished, developer-ready UI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help create digital products that are intuitive, accessible, scalable, visually polished, and genuinely enjoyable to use.

jobs.excerpt: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.
jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own iOS architecture decisions, ship polished Swift applications, and set the standard for how AI accelerates engineering at Xsolla.
Deep expertise in modern Swift is essential - SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors, structured concurrency), and the Apple platform frameworks - along with a proven track record of shipping commercial applications to the App Store from concept to launch. The ability to design scalable architectures, implement robust testing strategies, profile and optimize launch time, scroll performance, memory, and battery, and mentor other engineers while collaborating across cross-functional teams will be key to your success in this role.
We build AI-first. We expect you to work fluently with AI coding agents as a daily multiplier - scoping work for them, reviewing what they produce with a critical eye, and building the internal tooling, context, and evaluation habits that make the whole team faster.
If you’re passionate about building high-quality iOS experiences that scale, and love shipping apps that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain our native iOS application in Swift and SwiftUI, used by players and developers worldwide.
  • Deliver high-quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration.
  • Own the full iOS release process: code signing, provisioning, TestFlight distribution, App Store review and submission, phased rollouts, and crash triage.
  • Implement best practices for iOS development, including code review, automated testing strategies, and CI/CD with Xcode Cloud, Fastlane, or equivalent.
  • Integrate mini-apps, payments, and virtual currency systems into the Xsolla App ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to turn business goals into experiences that feel genuinely native.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, QA engineers, and project managers, and communicate effectively across distributed, multi-timezone teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

Architecture & Design:

  • Design and implement scalable application architecture for iOS with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Lead architectural decisions around modularization, dependency injection, navigation, and state management (MVVM, TCA, or Observation-based approaches).
  • Configure and optimize the Xcode build graph, Swift Package Manager dependencies, and modular targets for fast, incremental builds.
  • Build and maintain an internal SwiftUI component library and design system implementation.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.
  • Partner with the Android and React Native engineers to keep shared API contracts, design tokens, feature flags, and analytics schemas coherent across the app family -without flattening the platform into a lowest common denominator.
  • Drive observability for mobile: structured logging, crash monitoring, performance tracing, and release health dashboards.

AI-First Engineering:

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants as a core part of your daily workflow, and raise the bar for how the team prompts, reviews, and verifies AI-generated code.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes agents effective in our codebase: project rules, tool integrations, reproducible dev environments, and automated checks that catch what review misses.
  • Prototype and ship AI-powered product features using Core ML, the Foundation Models framework, and server-side LLMs - with a clear eye on latency, cost, privacy, and offline behavior.
  • Design evaluation and guardrails for AI features, including prompt regression testing, fallback behavior, and handling of model failure modes in production.
  • Share what works: mentor engineers on AI-assisted development and help set practical, quality-preserving standards for the organization.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Swift.
  • Proven track record of shipping commercial iOS applications, with apps you built currently live in the App Store.
  • Strong command of modern Apple frameworks and idioms: SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, Combine, UIKit interop, and the Observation framework.
  • Strong understanding of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture, unidirectional data flow), dependency injection, and state management.
  • Experience with automated testing on iOS - XCTest, Swift Testing, snapshot and UI tests - and with CI/CD for iOS release pipelines.
  • Solid grasp of performance, memory, and energy profiling using Instruments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven, daily use of AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate real production work - scoping tasks for agents, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and measurably increasing your own and your team’s velocity.
  • Experience with third-party integrations, REST/GraphQL APIs, and mobile SDK consumption.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a results-driven approach.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with widgets, App Intents, Live Activities, push notifications, or deep linking at scale.
  • Experience bridging Swift modules into React Native, or with Kotlin Multiplatform on the iOS side.
  • Familiarity with StoreKit 2 and Apple’s in-app purchase and external purchase link entitlements.
  • Familiarity with gaming ecosystems, virtual currency platforms, in-app purchases, or alternative payment and digital commerce flows.
  • Experience with mobile security practices: secure storage, certificate pinning, obfuscation, and fraud prevention.
  • Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks in the mobile or AI engineering space.
Benefits:We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

We have worked with the likes of Zepto, Cred, and Rippling for their talent recruitment. We have 100Mn+ candidates in our database & have helped 1000+ startups & companies hire. We featured in LinkedIn’s top 4 startups and in Fobes. While we are a YC-funded startup, we are also backed by the likes of Kunal Shah (CEO of WhatsApp), Venture Highway acquired by General Catalyst, among others.


While we are investor led, we are already profitable, and growing rapidly across India and the US.

You’d be doing a wide variety of things - talking to the Founding team and CXOs to understand what they are looking for in the crucial person to join their team. Then, picking people who you think are up for the challenge. Communicating and coordinating with them to get a candidate placed in the firm. You’d also analyse trends in which candidates get selected, use internal tools to find the best talent, and understand trends across industries.

An exceptional communicator: Your communication is clear, you have the ability to communicate with CXOs confidently, and you can talk to candidates with clarity and empathy. The energy and enthusiasm to talk, express and “listen” in a conversation. English fluency is a must, and other languages are a plus.

Coachable, detail-oriented and action-oriented: You are willing to learn, absorb feedback rapidly, and adapt accordingly, looking forward to acting and not just observing. You have a keen eye for detail, and you don’t let go until your final work is polished.

Recruitment: You’d learn the skills to be a world class recruiter in a couple of years

Regular interaction with leadership: Currently, we are a very small team, so you'll interact and learn directly from the founders and the leadership team.

Work from anywhere: We are happy for you to work from home or the mountains or the beach, as long as you have a stable internet connection.

We value your time; the whole process is planned in a way that we’ll wrap up in 5 - 10 days.
