About Us

CopilotKit is the #1 open-source platform for connecting AI Agents with user-facing applications. In our first two years, we’ve delivered the fastest growing Javascript AI framework of all time, and built a vibrant community (40k+ GitHub stars, millions of weekly installs, 10s of millions of copilot interactions, double-digit MoM growth), are already monetizing at the enterprise level, and are used by companies ranging from startups to Fortune 100s (including production usage by over 10% of Fortune 500s).
We’re emerging as the default for a critical part of the AI stack: the agent/user interaction layer. CopilotKit brings agents out of demos and terminals and into production, through deep integrations with the leading AI infrastructure companies and hyper-scalers (including the leading AI/infra teams at Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, LangChain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, and others).
Our small, fast-moving team is building the agentic application platform that will define how user-interactive AI actually manifests in the real world. This is a unique opportunity to join as an early leader on one of the most complex and high-leverage surfaces in AI — with significant scope for technical, product, and leadership growth.

The Role

You'll own the deep integrations between CopilotKit & AG-UI and the broader agentic stack -- and keep our position as the default choice for connecting any agent to user-facing surfaces.
You'll collaborate on a daily basis with some of the most important teams on some of the world's most important companies, including the leading AI teams at Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, as well as leading teams as Langchain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, AG2, Llamaindex, and others.
This role requires both breadth and depth: rapidly understand new frameworks, identify the right integration patterns, and ship production-quality SDKs that tens of thousands of developers depend on. You'll work directly with partner engineering teams and represent CopilotKit in technical collaborations across the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

We're Looking for Pilots, Not Just Mechanics

For integrations work, an AI-native workflow matters even more. You'll need to rapidly understand new frameworks, prototype integration approaches, and iterate quickly across multiple codebases. You're fluent in AI-assisted development as your primary mode of working—directing AI to explore unfamiliar APIs, generate integration boilerplate, and accelerate context-switching. You evaluate outputs, catch failure modes, and course-correct in real time. You've shipped meaningful work this way, especially in integrations where breadth and speed matter as much as depth.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations with agent frameworks and model providers, including AG-UI protocol adapters
  • Design clean, idiomatic APIs that feel native to each framework while maintaining ecosystem consistency
  • Own full integration lifecycle: research, prototyping, implementation, documentation, and maintenance
  • Work directly with partner teams to coordinate releases, resolve compatibility issues, and influence roadmaps
  • Create comprehensive examples and guides for rapid adoption
  • Monitor ecosystem trends and identify high-value integration opportunities

Requirements

  • Track record building integrations, SDKs, or libraries that connect disparate systems
  • Strong TypeScript expertise (3+ years); Python proficiency is a plus
  • Experience rapidly learning new frameworks and APIs (you have a system for this)
  • Comfort working across multiple codebases and languages simultaneously
  • AI-native workflow with demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools for exploring APIs and accelerating context-switching
  • Clear communication skills for cross-team/cross-company collaboration
  • High independence and ability to drive projects end-to-end
Nice to Have: Agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, Mastra), LLM APIs, external partner work, open-source contributions, React, real-time systems

Why Join Us

• Work on foundational AI tech: Build the infrastructure powering the next wave of user-facing, AI-native applications
• Ship from zero-to-one: Join early enough to shape the product, architecture, and engineering culture while riding the wave of real traction and momentum
• Be surrounded by top talent: Join an A+ team and collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and AI infra leaders
• Make open-source impact: Build in public with a fast-growing, engaged developer community
• Own meaningful upside: Competitive salary and real equity with early-stage ownership and line-of-sight to value creation
• Build your network: Daily and weekly work alongside the most important teams of the world’s most important companies; on the infrastructure side, the ai/infra teams of Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, Langchain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, and others; on the customer side, the leading ai product initiatives of the world’s top enterprises
• Great benefits: 100% health coverage for employees, 50% for dependents, Dental and Vision insurance, competitive paid time off
• Remote-first, high-agency culture: Flexible work, no micromanagement, and full trust and ownership
• Help define a new category: Shape the direction of a fast-growing, well-funded startup building a core layer of the future AI stack
We're looking for builders with a bias toward ownership: engineers who thrive in ambiguity, love solving hard problems, and want to help create something genuinely new. You’re joining at the inflection point: product-market fit is real, momentum is strong, and the most meaningful technical decisions are still ahead.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Supply Chain & Logistics
jobs.excerpt: Atrium is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering delivery of RNA therapeutics to the heart to transform the standard of care for people living with cardiomyopathies.
jobs.description:
Atrium is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering delivery of RNA therapeutics to the heart to transform the standard of care for people living with cardiomyopathies. Our proprietary technology leverages the targeted RNA delivery platform initially designed at Avidity, which combines the tissue selectivity of mAbs and other targeted delivery ligands with the precision of oligonucleotides.
This unique combination is designed to allow selective targeting of the underlying genetic drivers of disease that were previously undruggable. Through targeted, non-viral delivery of siRNA to cardiac tissues, our approach has the potential to overcome key limitations of nonspecific viral and nanoparticle-based delivery systems, including challenges related to tissue specificity, immunogenicity, and redosing.

Job Summary:

Atrium Therapeutics is seeking an experienced Associate Director, Clinical Supply Chain & Logistics to manage the end-to-end planning, execution, and oversight of clinical trial material supply for Atrium's cardiomyopathy programs. This role owns clinical supply forecasting, packaging and labeling, IRT/RTSM configuration, depot vendor management and distribution, and has an expanded scope to include responsibility for shipping and logistics operations — including carrier and freight-forwarder management, import/export and customs compliance, cold-chain shipment coordination and execution for Atrium Technical Operations and other teams. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Quality, Technical Operation, Regulatory, and external CMO/3PL partners to ensure uninterrupted, compliant, and on-time drug supply. Level of hire (Senior Manager vs. Associate Director) will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic direction for clinical supply strategies by translating and integrating trial designs, enrollment assumptions, manufacturing readiness and regulatory requirements into actionable clinical supply plans.
    •Manage IRT/RTSM vendor and lead specification gathering, user acceptance testing and IRT lifecycle throughout study duration, ensuring accurate randomization, resupply, and inventory levels across studies and sites.
    •Identify and mitigate clinical supply risks (e.g., expiry, demand variability, single-source dependencies) and build contingency plans to prevent trial disruptions.
    •Partner with Clinical Operations, CMC, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality to align clinical supply timelines with study start-up, enrollment, and closeout milestones.
    •Oversee and coordinate packaging, labeling (including label design and label proof development), distribution and return drug management activities with CMOs according to approved budgets and plans.
    •Represent Clinical Supply Chain in cross-functional Clinical Study Team, CRO and vendor meetings.
    •Authors pharmacy manuals and participates in reviews of other study related documentation
    •Serve as the primary point of accountability for shipping and logistics requests across Technical Operations, Development Sciences, Biology and Chemistry teams, including transfers of GMP and non-GMP materials (intermediates, drug substance, drug product, testing samples etc.)
    •Manage relationships with couriers, freight forwarders, and specialty cold-chain carriers
    •Own import/export compliance, including licenses, permits, customs documentation, and country-specific import requirements for material shipments.
    •Oversee cold-chain and temperature-controlled shipment execution, including packaging qualification, temperature excursion investigation, and corrective action.
    •Monitor shipment status end-to-end, coordinate with vendors on inbound/outbound logistics, proactively resolve delays or exceptions, and maintain shipment tracking and reporting for cross-functional stakeholders.
    •Ensure all clinical supply and logistics activities comply with GMP, GCP, and applicable import/export regulations.
    •Maintain inspection-ready documentation and ensure clinical supply and shipping records are filed appropriately in the eTMF/quality systems.
    •Support the creation and revision of SOPs related to clinical supply chain and logistics processes.
    •Lead or contribute to deviation, CAPA, and investigation processes related to supply or shipping issues (e.g., temperature excursions, shipment delays or damage).

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, supply chain, logistics, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
    •Associate Director: typically 10+ years, of clinical supply chain experience in biotech/pharma, with direct experience in packaging, labeling, and distribution of investigational products through all stages of international clinical studies (start-up, enrollment, maintenance and close-out)
    •Demonstrated experience managing shipping, logistics, or distribution operations, including carrier/freight-forwarder management and import/export or customs compliance.
    •Experience with IRT/RTSM systems, clinical supply forecasting tools, and CMO/depot network management.
    •Experience in rare disease, cardiology, or genetic medicine clinical trials is a plus.
    •Working knowledge of GMP, GCP, and global import/export regulations relevant to clinical trial materials.
    •Strong vendor management, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
    •Ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, growing biotech environment.
    •Excellent analytical, organizational, and written/verbal communication skills.
    •Comfort operating with the autonomy and hands-on scope typical of a small, growing company.
    •Some domestic and/or international travel may be required to support vendor, depot, or CMO site visits.
    •This role is based in San Diego, CA or Remote

What We Provide:

  • The base salary range for this role is $180,500-$199,500. The final compensation will be commensurate with such factors as relevant experience, skillset, internal equity and market factors.
    •Atrium offers competitive compensation and benefits which include stock options & RSUs, as well as a 401(k) with an employer match. In addition, the comprehensive wellness program includes coverage for medical, dental, vision, LTD, and unlimited of time off including summer & winter breaks.
    •A commitment to learning and development which includes a variety of programming internally developed by and for Atrium employees, opportunities for job-specific training offered by industry, and an education reimbursement program.

jobs.description:
See something that should exist? Build it.
See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Commerce Integrations Lead / Sales Engineer

LATAM · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI
Start date: September 2026

Integrations & Technical Solutions Lead

LATAM or EMEA · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI

See something that should connect? Build it.
See a process that should exist? Create it.

At Terrific, we’re building the next generation of social commerce—helping brands turn content, creators, live experiences and AI into commerce they own.

Our technology brings shoppable video, live shopping, interactive timelines, polls and product carousels directly onto a merchant’s website or app.

Now we’re looking for an Commerce Integrations Lead/Sales Engineer to help us connect Terrific to the wider commerce ecosystem—and build the systems that make those connections faster every time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a finished playbook.

You’ll help write it.

You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to solve the technical problems that determine whether a customer can launch, how quickly they see value and how easily we can support the next merchant.

One day, you may investigate how a global retailer’s cart works across multiple markets. The next, you may build a lightweight integration, help shape a live commercial opportunity, automate part of our technical-discovery process or prepare an app for a commerce marketplace.

You’ll work directly with teammates and customers across Latin America, Europe, Israel and the United States. You’ll have visibility into the full journey—from the first sales conversation through integration, launch and ongoing performance.

If you enjoy moving between technology, customers and commercial problems—and want the freedom to build rather than simply maintain—this role offers unusual room to make an impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

Terrific needs to connect with the platforms and tools merchants already use.

You’ll help us expand and improve integrations across:

  • Shopify

  • VTEX

  • Adobe Commerce/Magento

  • WooCommerce

  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud

  • BigCommerce

  • Tiendanube/Nuvemshop

  • Wix

  • PrestaShop

  • Shopware

  • Custom and headless commerce environments

  • Native mobile applications

You’ll also explore integrations with platforms such as Klaviyo, Attentive, Gorgias, Zendesk, Yotpo, Segment, Zapier, Google Merchant Center and Meta Commerce Manager.

Over time, you’ll help Terrific build a stronger marketplace presence, a more repeatable onboarding process and a technical integration layer that can scale across customers and markets.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Investigating merchant websites, applications and commerce stacks.

  • Understanding how product catalogs, variants, carts and checkout flows work.

  • Assessing technical feasibility for active commercial opportunities.

  • Turning customer requirements into clear technical recommendations.

  • Building, testing and improving integrations across major ecommerce platforms.

  • Helping merchants move from signed agreement to their first live Terrific experience.

  • Working directly with customer engineers and internal commercial teams.

  • Supporting technical discovery, proposals, security reviews and proofs of concept.

  • Improving the reliability of product feeds, event tracking, cart actions and embeds.

  • Publishing and maintaining Terrific apps across relevant commerce marketplaces.

  • Building tools, scripts, automations and AI agents that make integration work faster.

  • Turning repeated customer friction into clear Product and Engineering priorities.

  • Creating the documentation and processes that will support future customers and teammates.

You won’t be expected to solve everything alone. You will be expected to take ownership, bring the right people together and move the problem forward.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re technical, curious and commercially aware.

You want to understand why something matters to the customer—not only how it works in the code.

You’re comfortable opening DevTools, tracing an API request, reading someone else’s implementation and building a practical solution. You can move from a technical conversation with engineers to a commercial conversation with Sales or a customer without losing the thread.

You communicate clearly, ask good questions and know when to challenge an assumption.

You don’t need every process to be defined before you begin. You like taking something that is currently handled differently each time and turning it into a system the company can reuse.

You also understand that speed and judgment matter in a startup. Sometimes the right answer is a full integration. Sometimes it is a simpler path that gets the customer live this week.

HOW YOU’LL USE AI

Terrific is AI-native by default.

We don’t treat AI as a separate initiative or an occasional productivity tool. We use it as part of how we investigate, build, document and improve our work.

In this role, you’ll have the freedom to use AI to:

  • Accelerate technical discovery and research.

  • Generate and test scripts.

  • Automate repetitive integration tasks.

  • Build internal agents and tools.

  • Improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Monitor integrations and identify problems earlier.

  • Help non-technical teams access technical answers faster.

We’re interested in what you can build with AI—not whether you use a particular tool.

The goal is to create leverage for the whole company, not simply complete your own work faster.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

  • Production experience with at least two major ecommerce platforms.

  • Experience working with APIs, product feeds, webhooks, authentication, carts or checkout flows.

  • Ability to read unfamiliar code, write working scripts and debug browser or network behavior.

  • Experience working directly with customers, merchants or external technical teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Good judgment about effort, risk and commercial value.

  • Comfort working independently within a distributed, international team.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience with live shopping, social commerce, video commerce, marketplace apps or large international retailers is a strong advantage.

French is valuable for our EMEA accounts.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, you will:

  • Build a clear picture of Terrific’s current integration landscape.

  • Take ownership of live customer integration work.

  • Create a repeatable approach to technical discovery and feasibility.

  • Reduce the time between signed agreement and customer launch.

  • Improve how Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success work together.

  • Move new platform integrations into production.

  • Help define which marketplace and partner integrations we build next.

  • Introduce automations and AI-powered workflows that save the team time.

  • Create a roadmap for how Terrific’s integration ecosystem should grow.

Success is not following a process perfectly.

Success is leaving us with a better process than the one you joined.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Many technical integration roles begin with a ticket and end when the ticket is closed.

This one begins with a customer opportunity.

You’ll see how technical decisions affect sales, launch timelines, customer experience and revenue. You’ll work across teams and countries, with direct access to the people making product and commercial decisions.

You’ll have meaningful freedom to decide how problems should be approached, which tools should be built and what Terrific’s integration function should become.

There is no process set in stone—and that is the opportunity.

jobs.excerpt: Commercial Roofing EstimatorPosition OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join our commercial roofing team in a fully remote capacity.
jobs.description:
Commercial Roofing Estimator

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join our commercial roofing team in a fully remote capacity.

This is a highly specialised estimating position focused on commercial roofing takeoffs, estimating, and bid preparation.

The successful candidate will independently review commercial construction plans, specifications, drawings, and bid documents; complete detailed roofing takeoffs; develop accurate labour and material estimates; identify scope requirements and risks; and prepare competitive bids for submission.

This is not a general construction estimating position. We are specifically seeking a professional with demonstrated commercial roofing estimating expertise who understands commercial roofing systems, installation requirements, roofing components, labour production, material requirements, and the details that can materially affect the profitability and competitiveness of a bid.

The ideal candidate can take a project from a commercial bid platform, determine whether the opportunity is appropriate to pursue, download and analyse plans and specifications, complete the roofing takeoff, develop the estimate, identify scope gaps and risks, and deliver a complete bid package by the required deadline.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Roofing Takeoffs & Plan Review

  • Review commercial construction plans, specifications, drawings, addenda, scopes of work, and bid documents.

  • Perform accurate and detailed material and scope takeoffs for commercial roofing projects.

  • Identify roofing areas, system types, dimensions, quantities, assemblies, transitions, penetrations, and related components.

  • Interpret architectural, structural, mechanical, and roofing details as they relate to the roofing scope.

  • Review project specifications to identify applicable roofing requirements, standards, manufacturers, assemblies, and installation requirements.

  • Identify exclusions, alternates, allowances, owner requirements, and other conditions that may affect the roofing estimate.

  • Review addenda and revised documents and incorporate changes into the takeoff and estimate.

Commercial Roofing Systems

Demonstrate the ability to estimate and quantify commercial roofing systems and components, including:

  • TPO

  • PVC

  • EPDM

  • Built-up roofs

  • Metal roofing

  • Roof insulation

  • Tapered insulation

  • Roof coatings

  • Sheet metal

  • Flashing

  • Copings

  • Drains

  • Edge metal

  • Adhesives

  • Sealants

  • Roof accessories

  • Other commercial roofing components and accessories

Estimating & Bid Preparation

  • Prepare detailed estimates for labour, materials, equipment, accessories, subcontracted requirements, and other project costs.

  • Apply appropriate labour production rates and installation requirements.

  • Research and incorporate current material and labour pricing when necessary.

  • Obtain or validate supplier pricing and material costs as required.

  • Develop competitive and accurate commercial roofing bids.

  • Prepare bid proposals based on project plans, specifications, and scope.

  • Review completed estimates for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.

  • Identify cost drivers and estimating assumptions that may materially affect the bid.

  • Ensure estimates accurately reflect the actual roofing scope rather than relying solely on generic allowances or assumptions.

  • Provide allowances post-estimate.

Bid Platform & Opportunity Identification

Independently navigate commercial construction bidding and plan-room platforms, including:

  • ConstructConnect

  • Bid Express

  • Dodge Construction Network

  • Similar construction bid and plan-room platforms

Responsibilities include:

  • Locate relevant commercial roofing opportunities.

  • Review project information and determine whether opportunities are appropriate to pursue.

  • Download plans, specifications, addenda, and other bid documents.

  • Review project requirements and identify the applicable roofing scope.

  • Track bid dates, deadlines, and document updates.

  • Identify opportunities that align with business capabilities, market strategy, and commercial roofing expertise.

Scope Review & Risk Identification

  • Identify discrepancies, conflicts, omissions, or missing information in plans and specifications.

  • Identify scope gaps that could create cost exposure.

  • Flag unusual or high-risk project requirements before bid submission.

  • Identify requirements that may require clarification from the general contractor, architect, manufacturer, supplier, or commercial team.

  • Prepare clear questions or requests for clarification when information is incomplete or inconsistent.

  • Identify exclusions, qualifications, alternates, and assumptions that should be reflected in the estimate or bid.

  • Communicate material estimating risks to the commercial team before submission.

Organisation & Bid Management

  • Maintain organised digital estimating files, takeoffs, pricing documentation, and supporting information.

  • Manage multiple commercial roofing bids simultaneously.

  • Prioritise bids according to deadlines, project value, strategic importance, and pursuit criteria.

  • Meet established bid deadlines consistently.

  • Maintain accurate records of bid status and estimating activity.

  • Provide regular updates regarding active estimates, upcoming deadlines, outstanding information, and completed bids.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated professional experience estimating commercial roofing projects.

  • Strong understanding of commercial roofing systems, materials, components, and installation methods.

  • Proven experience performing detailed construction takeoffs.

  • Ability to independently read and interpret commercial construction plans and specifications.

  • Experience preparing competitive and accurate commercial roofing bids.

  • Strong understanding of commercial roofing labour and material requirements.

  • Ability to accurately quantify roofing systems and associated components.

  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard of estimating accuracy.

  • Ability to identify scope gaps, inconsistencies, exclusions, and estimating risks.

  • Ability to manage multiple bids and strict deadlines independently.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with a commercial roofing team in a fully remote environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of commercial roofing estimating experience.

  • Experience estimating large commercial roofing projects.

  • Experience with both public and private commercial construction bids.

  • Experience using ConstructConnect, Bid Express, Dodge Construction Network, or similar platforms.

  • Advanced experience with Bluebeam Revu and/or PlanSwift.

  • Experience with On-Screen Takeoff, Procore, or similar construction software.

  • Experience with roofing estimating databases.

  • Experience working with roofing supplier pricing and material databases.

  • Strong understanding of labour production rates and commercial roofing installation requirements.

  • Extensive experience with TPO, PVC, EPDM, metal roofing, and other commercial roofing systems.

  • Experience estimating complex roof assemblies, insulation systems, sheet metal, edge metal, flashing, penetrations, and other commercial roofing components.

Software & Technology

The candidate should have strong working experience with digital construction takeoff and estimating technology, including:

Primary Platforms:

  • Bluebeam Revu

  • ServiceTitan

  • PlanSwift

  • On-Screen Takeoff

  • Procore or similar construction software

Bid & Plan-Room Platforms:

  • ConstructConnect

  • Bid Express

  • Dodge Construction Network

  • Similar commercial construction bidding platforms

Experience with multiple takeoff, estimating, plan-room, and construction management platforms is a strong advantage.

Remote Work Requirements

Because this is a fully remote position, the successful candidate must have:

  • Reliable high-speed internet.

  • Appropriate computer hardware capable of efficiently handling large construction plans and digital takeoff software.

  • Consistent availability during established working hours.

  • Ability to meet strict bid deadlines without direct supervision.

  • A professional and distraction-controlled remote work environment.

  • Strong written communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate efficiently with the commercial team.

  • High levels of organisation and self-management.

  • Ability to provide regular updates on estimating activity, active bids, completed estimates, and upcoming deadlines.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable estimating and bid-production results, including:

  • Takeoff Accuracy: Roofing quantities and scope are accurately identified and quantified.

  • Estimate Accuracy: Labour, material, equipment, accessories, and other applicable costs are properly incorporated.

  • Bid Volume: Consistently completes an appropriate number of qualified commercial roofing bids based on workload and opportunity volume.

  • Deadline Compliance: Maintains a high percentage of bids completed and submitted before required deadlines.

  • Estimate Quality: Estimates are complete, organised, clearly documented, and commercially usable.

  • Risk Identification: Consistently identifies scope gaps, discrepancies, exclusions, unusual requirements, and potential cost risks.

  • Responsiveness: Responds promptly to questions and requests from the commercial team.

  • Opportunity Prioritisation: Focuses estimating resources on high-value and strategically relevant projects.

  • Documentation: Maintains consistent, organised, and easily accessible estimating files and supporting documentation.

  • Independence: Demonstrates the ability to manage the estimating workload with minimal supervision.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means the commercial team can confidently rely on the estimator to:

  1. Find and evaluate relevant commercial roofing opportunities.

  2. Quickly understand the project and determine whether it is appropriate to pursue.

  3. Thoroughly review plans, specifications, addenda, and bid requirements.

  4. Complete a precise commercial roofing takeoff.

  5. Accurately quantify roofing systems, materials, accessories, and labour requirements.

  6. Identify scope gaps and potential estimating risks before they become costly problems.

  7. Produce a competitive and commercially sound estimate.

  8. Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, alternates, and qualifications.

  9. Complete the estimate ahead of the bid deadline.

  10. Deliver a bid package the commercial team can use with confidence.

The successful candidate will function as a commercial roofing estimating specialist and technical resource, rather than a general administrative or general construction employee.

jobs.excerpt: Button’s mission is to empower the companies shaping the creator and affiliate economy - fueling mobile growth with innovation and new paths to monetization.
jobs.description:
Button’s mission is to empower the companies shaping the creator and affiliate economy - fueling mobile growth with innovation and new paths to monetization. Today, we work with some of the largest and most interesting businesses in the world to connect shoppers, creators, and retailers with what they love at the tap of a button. We build with the consumer experience in mind, have a reputation for paving the future of mobile, and have a good time doing it.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will own the end to end ML lifecycle at Button, from the data and feature pipelines that feed models, through training and evaluation workflows, to deployment, scoring, monitoring, and retraining. You will work closely with product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to translate ambiguous business problems into reliable production ML systems that integrate with our platform and power real product decisions.

You will help build the infrastructure and patterns that allow models to move quickly from research to production while meeting real world requirements for latency, scalability, cost efficiency, reproducibility, and safety. This role works closely with our Data Teams and plays a central role in how machine learning powers Button’s commerce and monetization products.

AS A SENIOR MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

  • Own the full ML lifecycle including feature pipelines, training workflows, model deployment, inference services, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Design and build reliable data and feature pipelines, including feature store patterns that support reproducible training and consistent features across training, batch scoring, and online inference.
  • Build and optimize machine learning models including regression, classification, ranking, and recommender systems.
  • Implement and manage batch scoring pipelines and online inference services with clear performance, reliability, and latency standards.
  • Partner with data scientists to operationalize models and build the tooling needed to run consistent evaluation, experimentation, and model iteration.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to ensure smooth integration of models into production services and APIs.
  • Establish observability for ML systems including monitoring of data freshness, feature drift, model performance, and pipeline health.
  • Design systems that support rapid experimentation and safe rollout of new models.
  • Document architecture clearly, establish best practices for ML engineering at Button, and mentor teammates through thoughtful code reviews and design discussions.
  • Contribute to the design of decisioning systems that power ranking, recommendations, and commerce optimization across Button’s platform.

WE LOOK FOR TEAMMATES WHO:

  • Write clear, maintainable code with strong software engineering practices including testing, documentation, debugging, and thoughtful system design.
  • Have experience building and operating production machine learning systems rather than only training models.
  • Understand the full ML lifecycle including feature generation, training pipelines, deployment strategies, and monitoring.
  • Have practical experience designing scalable data pipelines and feature generation workflows.
  • Have experience building or working with feature pipelines or feature stores that support both training and online inference.
  • Think deeply about reliability, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency when building ML systems.
  • Are comfortable working in cloud environments, especially AWS. Familiarity with Amazon SageMaker, Redis, Spark, streaming systems, or distributed data processing frameworks is a plus.
  • Have experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with engineers, data scientists, and product managers and can clearly communicate technical tradeoffs and design decisions.
  • Are comfortable working in ambiguous problem spaces and translating product questions into measurable ML solutions.

EXPERIENCE LEVEL:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or similar roles.
  • Fluency with Python and SQL.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating data pipelines at scale.
  • Hands on experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
  • Experience working in cloud environments, especially AWS.
  • Familiarity with orchestration and data modeling tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar systems.
  • Experience building ranking, recommendation, or decisioning systems is a plus.

Button provides employees with a RemotePlus workplace, which blends “work from anywhere” with in-person collaboration. Button has a “hub” workspace in New York City as well as team members distributed across the United States and beyond. The salary range for this role is expected to be between $153,000 - $198,000 (offered salary is based on a number of factors including skills and experience relative to the job description listed above).

In addition, Button provides employees with a 401(k) plan and automatically contributes 3% of an employee’s salary annually. We also want our employees to be well-rested and live balanced lives–Buttonians enjoy unlimited time off (including birthdays off) and periodic Mental Health Weeks which allow the entire company to take a breath and recharge, as well as an employee assistance program. For many of the health, vision, and dental insurance plans offered by Button, the company covers 100% of the premiums for employees and 75% for dependents. Button offers all employees and their dependents complimentary memberships to One Medical as well as a monthly stipend for mobile phone/internet and an annual lifestyle stipend. Button also offers employees in select markets “All Access” memberships to WeWork as well as regular “coworking days” and social events. Most of all, Button offers our employees the opportunity to live our company values–Grow & Learn, Experiment, Adapt, and Deliver–and to be a part of an incredible team of humans working together to build a better internet, fueled by commerce.

Button is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

Button is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON-U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

Staff Architect

About the Role:

Scentbird is scaling fast – across ecommerce, subscriptions, personalization, and a growing portfolio of brands. Our platform powers everything we build, and we're looking for a Staff Platform Architect to shape its evolution while helping drive AI-enabled capabilities across the engineering organization. Our goal is to scale the business through technology and AI without proportional growth in engineering headcount.

This is a senior hands-on technical leadership role reporting to the Director of Engineering. You'll own platform architecture, establish engineering standards, guide cross-team technical decisions, and identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

You'll lead a small platform team while remaining deeply involved in system design, architecture, and implementation. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, writes excellent code, and has practical experience applying modern AI technologies to solve real business problems.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

  • Platform Ownership: Own platform architecture and AI enablement across the company — defining service boundaries, integration patterns, shared infrastructure components, and the standards other teams build against.
  • System Design & Architecture: Lead the design of platform services — APIs, data contracts, async messaging patterns, and foundational components that span the engineering organization.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Identify, prioritize, and implement AI opportunities that measurably improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, customer experience, or business outcomes. Design and implement AI-augmented workflows — including agent orchestration pipelines, agent skill/tooling integration, and memory management strategies — as a first-class part of our platform.
  • Cross-Team Standards: You will serve as the primary architectural authority for platform-level technical decisions and help shape the long-term technical direction of the company.
  • Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor the platform team (2 engineers) — setting direction, running reviews, unblocking, and growing their technical capabilities.
  • Operational Readiness: Ensure the systems you design are production-ready — instrumented, scalable, fault-tolerant, and operable by the teams who inherit them.

What We'll Love About You:

  • You think in tradeoffs, not absolutes — and you can articulate why clearly
  • You write code that others are glad they inherited
  • You bring architectural conviction without ego: you can defend a design and also let a better idea win
  • You're fluent in English and can communicate complex technical concepts clearly — written and verbal — to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • You're self-directed, async-comfortable, and thrive in a distributed team environment
  • Russian language skills are a plus — part of our team communicates in Russian

What You'll Need to Have (Required Qualifications):

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3–4 years in a principal, staff, or platform architecture role
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise in Java — including modern JVM performance, concurrency, and service design; experience with Micronaut or Spring Boot strongly preferred
  • Proven architectural breadth: distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API design (REST/GraphQL), service mesh, and cloud-native patterns on AWS
  • AI-Powered Systems Experience: Hands-on experience designing, evaluating, or building AI-powered systems using modern LLM technologies. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool integration, retrieval systems, or memory architectures is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, async messaging (Kafka or similar), and caching strategies at scale
  • Experience setting and enforcing cross-team architectural standards — not just building things yourself, but shaping how others build
  • Excellent English communication skills — written and verbal — sufficient to lead technical conversations, write design proposals, and collaborate with a distributed team
  • Timezone availability: minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with New York (ET)

Nice to Have (Optional Qualifications):

  • Experience with Rust (not mandatory, but valued)
  • Familiarity with GraalVM native images and JVM profiling
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and production EKS environments
  • Background in ecommerce, subscription platforms, or high-scale consumer products
  • Russian language proficiency

What You'll Love About Us:

  • Competitive base compensation
  • Bonus program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Wellness Days Off
  • A focused, senior team that moves fast and trusts you to own your domain
  • Real platform scope — you'll shape how the platform evolves, not just execute tickets

About Scentbird

Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 1000+ designer perfumes each month.

About the Brands:

  • Scentbird: The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment
  • Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.
  • Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.

Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you.
  • Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake.
  • Drift: Drift began as an alternative to all of the tacky air care products on the market. Our products are designed to blend in, with amazing scents that stand out. We take pride in our fragrances, keeping them free from the traditional chemicals used in the fragrance industry. We are always phthalate and paraben free. We never skimp on quality of our scents or the products that deliver them. Our design ethos is simple but effective. We love our community, those who won’t settle for ordinary, and we want to deliver a best in class experience.

Scentbird is committed to bringing individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives into the Nest. We strive to uphold an inclusive environment where individuals of all different backgrounds, ages, colors, ethnicities, gender, or gender identities, genetics, physical or mental abilities, protected veteran status, race, religious or sexual orientation, thrive. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated internally to going above and beyond in fostering diversity. Come as you are - we’re excited to meet you.

jobs.excerpt: Reports to: Chief Financial Officer Location: Remote in U.
jobs.description:
Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: Remote in U.S

Nice to meet you!

Pepper is an innovative, fast-growing DTC intimate apparel brand designed to celebrate small-chested women. Our iconic solution-driven undergarments, swimwear, and clothing are thoughtfully designed to make every outfitting moment a confident and authentic expression of your best self. Pepper has been obsessed with uncompromising fit for small chests since our 470% funded Kickstarter launch 2017, and has grown to a global community of millions of women united by a mission to inspire women to feel perfectly enough as they are. We’re reshaping the conversation around fit, style, and confidence for small-chested bodies everywhere.

What we’re proud of:

  • Remote-first, flexible, and human: We’re a fully remote-first team that values ownership, balance, and trust. Pepper is built for people who want to do their best work from wherever they thrive. Without sacrificing connection, collaboration, or career growth.
  • Women-founded & Self-funded: As a women-owned company that never took traditional VC funding, we’ve scaled to eight-figure revenue through focus, profitability, and scrappiness. People come here to help rewrite what success looks like in DTC, and to build alongside a team that loves breaking the “rules” of how startups should grow.
  • Mission-driven with real impact. Everything we do is rooted in empowering small-chested people to feel confident and celebrated. Our mission shapes our products, our culture, and our decisions, from inclusive design to responsible manufacturing and community giving. Joining Pepper means using your work to make the world a little more comfortable, confident, and kind.

This is where you come in.

We’re looking for a strategic, data-driven Director of Planning to own our end-to-end inventory planning strategy, purchasing, and sales planning. Reporting into the executive team, you will lead the company’s Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, balancing demand forecasts, inventory investment, production capacity, and supply constraints to support profitable growth.

This role will build bottom-up forecasts rooted in SKU and size-level insights and translate those into sales plans by channel, inventory buys, and operational strategies that enable us to capture demand, scale new categories, and efficiently replenish our core business.

You’ll operate seamlessly between detail and strategy: diving into SKU and size-level performance, customer behavior, trend patterns, production lead times, and supply risks, while connecting those insights to broader business planning and growth objectives.

As a key cross-functional leader, you’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Merchandising, Finance, Production, Sourcing, and Supply Chain to align commercial demand with operational execution and ensure the business is positioned to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Own the company inventory sales plan forecast across seasonal launches, replenishment businesses, and new category expansion
  • Build and manage bottom-up forecasts at the SKU, color, and size level using historical performance, customer behavior, trend analysis, and business inputs
  • Develop forecasting methodologies that account for lifecycle dynamics including launch ramps, replenishment curves, cannibalization, and demand decay
  • Partner with Marketing and Merchandising to incorporate promotional activity, product launches, and customer acquisition trends into forecasts
  • Lead forecast reviews and continuously improve forecast accuracy across channels and categories

Supply Planning & Inventory Management

  • Translate strategic sales forecasts into inventory buy plans and vendor production plans that optimize in-stock rates, inventory productivity, freight optimization, warehouse storage, and cash flow
  • Own inventory targets including weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points, and inventory health metrics
  • Balance forecasted inventory needs by category against operational constraints including production capacity, lead times, MOQ requirements, vendor capabilities, and raw material availability
  • Partner with sourcing and production teams to ensure timely replenishment and successful execution of product launches
  • Manage inventory risk mitigation, scenario planning, and contingency planning to reduce stockouts and excess inventory

S&OP & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead the company’s Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, aligning inventory efficiency, product sales forecasting by style, and inventory health and turn
  • Facilitate recurring cross-functional planning meetings and drive alignment on forecasts, risks, opportunities, and operational tradeoffs
  • Serve as the central point of coordination between marketing, operational, and financial teams
  • Own departmental planning objectives and communicate clear recommendations and perspectives during executive and cross-functional meetings
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to executive leadership on inventory investment, capacity planning, growth opportunities, and operational risk

DTC & Channel Optimization

  • Own in-stock rates and size-level availability to ensure a strong customer experience across e-commerce and marketplace channels
  • Optimize inventory allocation across DTC, marketplaces, Amazon, and wholesale partners based on demand signals and channel performance
  • Partner with Merchandising to align inventory with product lifecycle strategies including launch, growth, replenishment, and markdown optimization

Analytics, Systems & Process Improvement

  • Track and report on key metrics including forecast accuracy, fill rate, inventory turns, stockouts, excess inventory, and service levels
  • Build dashboards, reporting tools, and scalable planning processes that improve visibility and decision-making
  • Identify operational risks and opportunities early and recommend data-driven actions
  • Partner with leadership to implement and improve planning systems, forecasting tools, and operational workflows to increase efficiency and scalability

Requirements

  • 8-12+ years of inventory planning experience displaying career progression, leadership and profit optimization.
  • Foundation in bottoms up inventory management with both core and fashion styles managing lifecycle efficiencies across categories.
  • Experience with DTC or vertically designed products with end-to-end inventory planning ownership for apparel, intimates, or other size intensive consumer products preferred.
  • Strong understanding of apparel planning fundamentals including size curves, replenishment models, lifecycle planning, and inventory optimization
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end S&OP or Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes
  • Experience balancing commercial demand with operational and supply chain constraints
  • Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills; advanced proficiency in Excel and planning systems
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration capabilities
  • Experience building scalable planning processes in high-growth environments preferred

Pepper values.

  • Curiosity 🤔: We’re relentless in our quest to understand the community we serve. We’re challengers who ask questions, pursue perspectives, and set the new standard.
  • Resilience 🌊: We embrace the ups and the downs, learn from our mistakes, and courageously persevere to achieve our goals.
  • Community 🤝: We champion each other the same way we champion our customer. We do big things together and are passionate about what we do, and how we do it.

Benefits

  • Robust health benefits including 100% company covered option for medical, vision, dental insurance, and supplemental insurance options
  • Company matched 401K plan up to 3%
  • Generous paid time off program including flexible PTO days, federal holidays, and sick days
  • Flexible remote workplace
  • Paid parental leave for qualifying employees
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Annual company-wide offsite
  • Have a huge role in the growth of a company with a meaningful mission

Diversity

Pepper is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Pepper's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful.

Pepper will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal history, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

What Personal Information We Collect

Professional, employment-related, or schooling information. Current or past job history, performance evaluations, and educational background, including grades and transcripts.

How We Use Your Information

For professional, internal analysis, or employment-related purposes, including job applications.

The expected salary for this role is $150,000-180,000, though the final offer will reflect several factors such as your experience, skills, and the role’s location and may be outside of this number. Candidates should expect offers that reflect their individual qualifications, experience, and location. The salary provided is directional and actual compensation may vary. At Pepper, we know that compensation is just one part of the package. That’s why we offer a robust total rewards package, including health and wellness benefits, remote work stipends, a generous flexible paid time off policy, product discounts, and more, that are designed to support your journey both inside and outside of work.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar com Code Review e Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), apoiando as atividades de segurança de sistemas desenvolvidos em uma organização global.

A posição terá como foco a análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas de SAST (Static Application Security Testing) e SCA (Software Composition Analysis), avaliação de propostas de mitigação, identificação de falsos positivos e orientação técnica às equipes de desenvolvimento para a correção de vulnerabilidades.

Procuramos um perfil com sólida compreensão de desenvolvimento de software, arquitetura de aplicações e segurança, capaz de atuar com autonomia, avaliar riscos técnicos e propor soluções práticas em um ambiente global e colaborativo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Monitorar e gerenciar filas de chamados, selecionando demandas de forma proativa, definindo prioridades e acompanhando os casos desde a abertura até a resolução.
  • Analisar vulnerabilidades e apontamentos identificados por ferramentas de SAST e SCA, avaliando sua relevância, criticidade e impacto na segurança das aplicações.
  • Avaliar propostas de mitigação de vulnerabilidades, verificando se os controles implementados são suficientes para reduzir os riscos de segurança.
  • Investigar possíveis falsos positivos, analisando código-fonte, comportamento das aplicações, arquitetura e fluxos de dados.
  • Orientar equipes de desenvolvimento sobre boas práticas de segurança e estratégias de correção de vulnerabilidades identificadas no código.
  • Interagir diretamente com equipes técnicas por meio de Microsoft Teams, reuniões e comunicações escritas, esclarecendo dúvidas e apoiando decisões relacionadas à segurança.
  • Colaborar com profissionais de Desenvolvimento, QA, Infraestrutura, Operações e Segurança para garantir a resolução adequada dos problemas identificados.
  • Contribuir com sugestões de melhorias nos processos, serviços e utilização de tecnologias emergentes, buscando maior eficiência e qualidade nas atividades de segurança.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento sólido em Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), incluindo arquitetura de software, funcionamento de aplicações e fluxos de dados.
  • Domínio dos conceitos do OWASP Top 10, com capacidade de identificar vulnerabilidades comuns e relacioná-las às respectivas estratégias de correção no código.
  • Experiênciaem Desenvolvimento de Software, Arquitetura de Software, Quality Assurance (QA) ou Engenharia de Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Conhecimento prático em pelo menos uma linguagem ou tecnologia de desenvolvimento, como C#, C++, Java, .NET, ou Python.
  • Capacidade de analisar resultados de ferramentas SAST e SCA, avaliar possíveis falsos positivos e validar propostas de mitigação de riscos.
  • Capacidade de interpretar código-fonte e compreender o comportamento das aplicações para investigar vulnerabilidades e orientar correções.
  • Autonomia para gerenciar demandas, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar chamados e conduzir atividades até sua conclusão.
  • Inglês avançado, com boa comunicação verbal e escrita para explicar riscos técnicos, apresentar recomendações de correção e interagir com equipes internacionais e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, atuação em cenários com informações incompletas e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Requisitos desejáveis (diferenciais)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
